izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.stress.name: Perceived Stress Scale
izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.stress.summary: Are you stressed? Take the test to find out how stressed you are.
izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.stress.description:
The Perceived Stress Scale (PSS) is the most widely used psychological instrument for measuring the perception of stress. It is a measure of the degree to which situations in one's life are appraised as stressful. Items were designed to tap how unpredictable, uncontrollable, and overloaded respondents find their lives. The scale also includes a number of direct queries about current levels of experienced stress. The PSS was designed for use in community samples with at least a junior high school education. The items are easy to understand, and the response alternatives are simple to grasp. Moreover, the questions are of a general nature and hence are relatively free of content specific to any subpopulation group. The questions in the PSS ask about feelings and thoughts during the last month.
 Evidence for Validity: Higher PSS scores were associated with (for example):
 failure to quit smoking
 failure among diabetics to control blood sugar levels
 greater vulnerability to stressful life-event-elicited depressive symptoms
 more colds
 Because levels of appraised stress should be influenced by daily hassles, major events, and changes in coping resources, predictive validity of the PSS is expected to fall off rapidly after four to eight weeks.

This app helps you easily catalog and manage your personal blu-ray and dvd collection, including movies and TV series. Designed for simplicity and speed, it works completely offline with no accounts, ads, or tracking.

fdroid:app.auriel.nocean.summary: Offline rich-text notes with fonts, media and no cloud
fdroid:app.auriel.nocean.description:
All the notes, none of the cloud. 
 Nocean is a small, fast, fully offline rich-text notes app. Your notes and media stay in the app's private storage. The app doesn't even request the Internet permission.
 Features 
 Rich text: H1, H2 and H3 headings, bold, italic, and a font per text range
 Fonts, offline: Inter, Lora, Playfair Display, DM Serif Display, Nunito, Oswald, Caveat and Geist Mono ship inside the app. No network or Play Services needed
 Inline media: insert images, videos and audio. Tap one to open a full-screen viewer with pinch-zoom, or a player
 Zip backup: export every note and its media to one .zip and restore it on any device. On import, a note replaces an existing one only if it's newer
 Pinned notes: long-press a card to pin it to the top of the list. Pinning doesn't change the note's edited date
 Three ways to search: plain substring, fuzzy subsequence matching, or a case-insensitive regular expression. Tap the badge in the search field to cycle; the choice is remembered
 Share: send a note's text to any app, or share text into Nocean to save it as a new note
 Note info: word, character and paragraph counts, media totals, and created/edited dates
 Four themes: Ocean, Pepper, Cherry and Tokyo Night, with a frosted-glass look (real blur on Android 12+)
 Light and dark: an Auto / Light / Dark toggle. Ocean and Pepper follow it; Cherry is light-only and Tokyo Night is dark-only

fdroid:audio.omgsoundboard.description:

You are free to use whatever sounds you want because it is possible to import sounds you love. A backup is also integrated of course so that you can keep your collection forever. The software is simple and straightforward to use. You can also layer the sounds by adding effects and playing several sound effects at once.
 OMGSoundboard works offline, offers a good search function, and the ability to set sounds as ringtones and/or alarms.
Please note that OMGSoundboard has just a very limited amount of sounds available by default because of copyright reasons.
The following are some of the app's main features:
* You have the option of making as many soundboards as you want.
* Your personal tunes can be imported
* You have complete control over when the sound starts and stops.
* Sounds can be played back at the same time, allowing you to layer them if desired.
* OMGSoundboard will back up your sounds so they don't get lost.
* All apps that allow sharing can be used to share the sounds. (Bluetooh, Wifi, NFC, Social Networks, and so on.)
* You get to select Ringtone, Alarm, and Notification sounds.
* You can save your favorite sounds as bookmarks.
* Allows for word-filtering for a more useful and fast search inside a large number of sounds.
* Supports Wear OS by Google smartwatches.
* No ads and no trackers.

fdroid:com.alexisgordr.icdetector.name: ICdetection
fdroid:com.alexisgordr.icdetector.summary: Offline cellular anomaly auditor and radio monitor for Android
fdroid:com.alexisgordr.icdetector.description:
ICdetection is an open-source tool for auditing the cellular environment from Android, without root.
It shows what Android's public telephony APIs report (cell identity, MCC, MNC, TAC, PCI, ARFCN, signal and Timing Advance when available) and combines conservative heuristics to flag anomalous behaviour. Alerts need temporal confirmation to reduce false positives.
It does not guarantee IMSI-catcher detection: Android apps cannot inspect RRC or NAS traffic or the modem. An alert is an anomaly worth reviewing, not proof of surveillance.
Works without Internet: no Internet permission, no ads, analytics or trackers. History stays on the device unless you export it.
Permissions:
• Location: Android requires it for cell information; also used for geographic checks.
• Phone state: reads the network and visible cells.
• Network state: only to know if data uses Wi-Fi or mobile data.
• Foreground service, notifications and wake lock: keep monitoring running and visible.
• Run at startup: only for the optional reminder after a reboot (off by default).
Results depend on the phone, modem, firmware and Android version. Requires Android 12 or later.

fdroid:eu.droogers.smsmatrix.name: SmsMatrix
fdroid:eu.droogers.smsmatrix.description:
This app bridges all sms messages to matrix. For every (new) text
conversation contact the bot will open a private 1:1 room and sends the
incoming messages to that room. Any messages sent in that room by the
matrix user will then be sent to the contact via SMS.
As currently there is no end-to-end encryption implemented in this app, for
privacy reasons it is preferable to use it with your own Matrix server.
Your data-in-transit however will always be safe as they are encrypted
using https over matrix -- provided the Matrix server is configured
properly.

fdroid:org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.name: Track Work Time
fdroid:org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.summary: Record your work time. Categorize it with different tasks. Generate reports.
fdroid:org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.description:
This app can track your work time easily! You can automate time tracking using geo-fencing functions (see below). You may also categorize each recorded interval by a predefined client/task and a free text. Of course, the list of clients/tasks can be edited to suit your needs, and the app has a widget for your home screen.
Additionally, if you wish, your flexible time account is taken care of: you always see how much you worked. You can also keep an eye on how much work time is left for today or for the current week (by a notification which you can enable).
The app enables you to modify the planned working time effortlessly - just tap on the date you want to edit in the main table.
You may provide the geo-coordinates of your work place and the app can automatically clock you in while you are at work. This is done without using GPS, so your battery won't be emptied by this app.
You also may provide a Wi-Fi network name which is visible at your work place the app can use to clock in automatically when this SSID is in range (you don't need to be connected to this network). Of course you should have Wi-Fi enabled for this to work.
You don't want to open the app for clocking in and out? No problem - there are at least three ways to do that: add the widget to your home screen, use launcher shortcuts (long press the app icon for that) or add a new quick settings tile to your panel by tapping on the pencil below and dragging the "Track Work Time" tile up which then can toggle your clocked-in state.
If you prefer to use other apps like LlamaLab Automate or Tasker for tracking your movements, that's fine - TWT can be triggered from other apps and just do the book-keeping of your work time. In this case, you have to create broadcast intents called org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.ClockIn or org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.ClockOut. When using ClockIn, you can also set the parameters task=... and text=... in the "extra" section of the intent so your events are more meaningful. You can also use the action org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.StatusRequest to get the current state of TWT: is the user clocked in, and if so, with which task and how much time remains for today? For more details on this, see the web site.
It's also possible the other way around: TWT generates broadcast intents on event creation/update/deletion. Automation apps can listen for the actions org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.event.Created, org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.event.Updated and org.zephyrsoft.trackworktime.event.Deleted. See the web site for more details and some screenshots on how to use it.
If you have a Pebble smart watch, the app will notify you on clock-in and clock-out events which is especially useful if you want to be in the know about automatic time tracking via location and/or WiFi.
For other smart watches you can enable some options regarding notifications to help you. Firstly, you can enable the notification generally. Without any other related option, this will only display a notification on your phone in case you're clocked in. To also display this notification on your phone when not clocked in, select to always show it. Now, if you want it also on your watch, you also have to switch notifications to non-persistent (otherwise Android won't synchronize them). This is kind of a compromise because with this option notifications won't be pinned at the top of the list and also can be closed unintentionally (but will be displayed again after a minute). In addition you can silence all notifications so you are not distracted by them (this will be applied on your watch as well as on your phone, Android doesn't differentiate here).
If you want to back up your data, you have the choice: use Google's mechanism or do it on your own. To use Google's servers just enable the corresponding option. And if you don't want to give your data to Google: The app automatically creates a backup each day which is written to the directory you allowed for the app (if you didn't allow

Immerse your little ones in the ocean adventure of “Toby, the Lost Whale” — an educational bedtime story app perfect for preschool and kindergarten children! Designed for kids (ages 3–7), this animated adventure storybook delivers valuable lessons right to your home or school classroom.
— DIVE INTO INTERACTIVE LEARNING
* Read-Aloud & Read-Along: With professional voice narration, children can listen to the story aloud as they follow along or read along with the text. The entire book features clear English audio and text, helping them build vocabulary and reading comprehension.
* Offline Adventures: All activities and educational lessons in this book work completely offline. Your child can enjoy these tales anytime, anywhere, with no internet connection required.
* Beginner Reading Support: Designed for beginner-level learners, this interactive story uses basic words and simple sentence structures to help young children build confidence in early reading.
* Interactive Storytelling: This engaging app invites early learners to tap, pull, pop, and drag objects within the interactive picture book, bringing Toby’s ocean adventure to life. Children can explore the ocean while enjoying a fun, interactive game-like experience.
* Biblical Parable: “Toby, the Lost Whale” draws inspiration from the Bible parable of the Prodigal Son, teaching important Christian lessons about God’s unconditional love and forgiveness. The Bible verse from Luke 15:32 reinforces this powerful message: “It was fitting to celebrate and be glad, for this your brother was dead, and is alive; he was lost, and is found.” This app is designed to inspire children in nursery school, preschool, pre-K, grade 1, and grade 2.
* Kid-Safe Environment: Rest easy knowing this app is 100% kid-safe, with no ads, in-app purchases, or external links. It provides a secure space for little ones to explore, learn, and enjoy a meaningful children’s book.
* Perfect for Any Time: Ideal for 5-minute bedtime stories or engaging activities for kids (ages 3–7). Whether at home or in the classroom, kids can enjoy a fun and educational reading experience.
* Explore and Learn: Help children learn words, improve reading skills, and explore a heartwarming whale story inspired by the teachings of Jesus. Follow Toby’s ocean adventure and encounter fascinating sea creatures, including humpback whales and orcas.
* Build Reading Skills: Build vocabulary and reading comprehension skills while enjoying a fun, interactive experience. Simple text, professional narration, and engaging activities make the story accessible to beginner readers!
— AN EDUCATIONAL JOURNEY THROUGH THE SEA
This educational reading app helps kids develop empathy, communication skills, and an understanding of unconditional love through Toby’s journey to reunite with his family. The vivid picture book captures the imagination and provides an exciting ocean adventure for young readers.
As children explore the ocean with Toby, they can enjoy an engaging storybook experience filled with animation, sound, and interactive activities. The combination of reading, listening, and play encourages kids to discover the story at their own pace.
— AVAILABILITY
Available on iPad, iPhone, and Mac, “Toby, the Lost Whale” is a storybook app for young learners who enjoy Bible stories, Christian themes, and engaging interactive adventures.

flathub:io.github.Querz.mcaselector.name: MCA Selector
flathub:io.github.Querz.mcaselector.description:
MCA Selector is an external tool for Minecraft Java Edition that lets you visualize, select,
 export, or delete world chunks and region files.
 Common uses: trim large worlds, remove corrupted chunks, and export/import regions.
 Key features:
 Top-down map view — visual overview of regions and chunks for quick navigation and selection.
 Customizable overlays — display per-chunk values as color gradients with configurable min/max
 to visualize world data.
 Dimension switching — open/edit Overworld, Nether, and End (DIM-1/DIM1) region folders.
 Select/edit chunks individually or in groups
 Powerful chained filters — select chunks/regions by data version, last updated time, player
 inhabited time, coordinates, modification date and more (even scripting custom filters); multiple
 conditions can be combined for precise queries.
 Chunk Editor — view and edit the full NBT structure of a chunk, including POI and entity
 data; supports rename, add, delete, and drag‑and‑drop moves.
 Easy chunk import/export — copy chunks from one world to another.
 NBT Changer — modify specific NBT values directly in world files.
 Chunk regeneration (delete to let Minecraft regenerate with new terrain)
 Note that you should always back up your world before editing it with MCA Selector.

flathub:io.github.dxx_rebirth.dxx-rebirt.name: DXX-Rebirth
flathub:io.github.dxx_rebirth.dxx-rebirt.summary: Modern cross-platform port of the Descent engine
flathub:io.github.dxx_rebirth.dxx-rebirt.description:
DXX-Rebirth is a modern port of the Descent game engine, based on the late D1X and D2X source
 ports (which, in turn, were based on the original Descent source release and LDescent).
 The Rebirth Team has spent a lot of time working to improve the source code by fixing old bugs
 and adding some improvements, while always staying true to our philosophy:
 Keep it Descent! 
 DXX-Rebirth has every little feature you may remember from the original Descent 1 & 2
 and much more. For example:
 Full compatibility with Descent and Descent 2, including all expansions and third-party levels.
 DXX-Rebirth runs on your favourite Operating System. We officially support Linux (and other *NIXs),
 Mac OS X and Windows. The source code can also be compiled on many other systems!
 OpenGL provides fast and smooth rendering - even on low-end systems.
 Optionally you can enable several effects like Transparency, Colored Lighting, Texture Filtering,
 FSAA, etc.
 Thanks to SDL, a wide variety of Joysticks are supported. Also you can use more Joysticks,
 buttons and axes than you can ever operate in your state of evolution.
 Joystick, Keyboard and Mouse can be used simultaneously.
 The games can display all resolutions and aspects supported by your monitor, including an
 option for VSync.
 Besides MIDI and CD-Audio (Redbook), you can play your own custom Music from your hard drive
 or a separate AddOn.
 Both games can utilize special AddOn packs to replace or expand the original game content.
 Multiplayer via UDP protocol provides a fast and easy-to-use LAN and Online action. This includes
 reliable communication causing less glitches due to lost packets.
 The ingame Demo-recording system has been improved. Demos are less glitchy and smaller while
 still still being backwards-compatible to earlier versions of the games.
 Higher game speed will not cause glitches such as unacceptable fast homing projectiles,
 incredible high damage caused by several collisions or Fusion cannon, etc.
 Player files, Savegames, Demos and Missions from DOS-Versions of the games can freely be used
 in DXX-Rebirth and vice versa.
 Mac Command keys are now working - see F1 Help. Command-Q works much like a normal Mac program
 Multiplayer support over UDP/IP (using port 42424 by default)
 Even more ...

firefox-addons:1004866.name: SYSTRAN Translator
firefox-addons:1004866.summary: SYSTRAN Translator can translate any webpage in one click.
firefox-addons:1004866.description:
Translate any webpage in one click with SYSTRAN Translator! 
The extension helps you translate all your web browsing content into the language of your choice with the best quality and precision. Choose a method depending on your need and benefit from our fast machine translations:
 Translate a text selection Select any text on your page then click on the SYSTRAN Translator icon to instantly see the translation
 You can also right-click on your selection and choose “Translate selection with Systran” in order to get your translation in a new tab.
 Translate a full page Select a target language and click on “Translate This Page”, then the translation will progressively display the translated page while keeping the formatting. You can then switch easily between the original text and translation.
 You can also activate the Auto-translation in order to keep translating while navigating on the web!
 You can also activate the Auto-translation to keep translating while navigating the web with a preference mode (auto-translation to be enabled tab by tab or for all new tabs).
 Translate some text input You want a translation for a sentence you have in mind while surfing the web without leaving your browser? Then directly enter some text in the translate box of the extension and visualize the translation instantly.
You can change the source and target language anytime to tailor the translation to your needs.
To use Systran Translator, you need a SYSTRAN Translate or SPNS account. Learn more about SYSTRAN Products and check our latest blog post at systran.net 
SYSTRAN Translate users have access to 50 languages .
This extension adds a dedicated icon to your browser toolbar, you can pin it to keep it at your fingertips and quickly use it whenever you need it.
 NB. Some limitations apply: 
 Images and iframe are currently not supported for translation
 Page translation is not possible with strict CSP due to a known issue on Firefox side

firefox-addons:2964449.name: Avoid Google Translate
firefox-addons:2964449.summary: Automatically redirects Google Translate pages to their original URLs.
firefox-addons:2964449.description:
Automatically escape the translation wrapper and get back to the original source. 
Tired of search results or shared links trapping you inside the Google Translate interface? Avoid Google Translate instantly detects when you are viewing a page via translate.goog and redirects you to the original, untranslated URL.
Key Features:
 Instant Redirection: Automatically escapes the Google Translate "frame" to restore the original website experience.
 URL Cleaning: Strips away Google Translate-specific query parameters (like _x_tr_sl , _x_tr_tl , etc.) for a clean destination link.
 Simple Control: Use the popup menu to quickly toggle the redirection on or off whenever needed.
 Lightweight & Fast: Built with performance in mind using modern extension APIs.
Privacy & Transparency:
 Open Source: This project is transparent and open source. You can review the code, contribute, or report issues on GitHub .
 No Data Collection: This extension does not track your browsing history, collect personal data, or communicate with external servers.
 Permission Transparency: Uses standard web request permissions solely to perform the redirection locally on your browser.
 How it works: 
When you click a link that leads to a translated version of a site (e.g., example-com.translate.goog ), the extension extracts the original domain ( example.com ), cleans the path, and moves you there immediately. Perfect for users who prefer their browser's native translation tools or want to view the source content directly.

firefox-addons:2705058.name: Tureng Translate
firefox-addons:2705058.summary: Translate words and phrases by using Tureng
firefox-addons:2705058.description:
The extension supports all of four dictionaries of Tureng.
You can select a word or phrase that exists in Tureng's database, and the extension will translate it in-place. By right-clicking on a selection, you can use the context menu to navigate to the Tureng page in a new browser tab. Finally, you can click on the extension icon, which is at the top-right corner of your browser, and open a pop-up that can translate words and phrases.
You can click on flags which are in the panel and the pop-up to listen pronunciations.
In case of a misspelling, the pop-up will suggest corrections which you can click on.
You can disable the panel button and the context menu on the extension's "Preferences" page.
This extension has some shortcuts for ease of use:
 Ctrl + Shift + Space Opens the pop-up blank.
 Ctrl + Space Opens the pop-up and translates selection.
 Shortcuts can be changed in the shortcuts page.

firefox-addons:2854587.name: Rotate that Video Player
firefox-addons:2854587.summary: Improve your video experience by effortlessly rotating your video clips by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
firefox-addons:2854587.description:
Unlock the power to effortlessly rotate any video player with the Rotate That Video Player browser extension. Say goodbye to straining your neck to watch sideways or upside-down videos. Whether you are streaming content, watching tutorials on YouTube, or enjoying personal videos, this handy extension ensures optimal viewing orientation with just a click.
The Rotate That Video Player is a lightweight and useful add-in designed to enhance productivity. Say goodbye to awkwardly tilted videos and hello to a smoother viewing experience. Thanks to this browser extension, you can finally fix the well-known VVS problem that you sometimes see in YouTube videos. You can rotate, change the position vertically and horizontally, and even increase or scale up the current video player, allowing you to enjoy it on a larger scale.
Never heard of Vertical Video Syndrome (VVS)?
Vertical Video Syndrome (VVS) is a fictitious condition that satirically claims that those afflicted can only shoot videos in a portrait orientation, as opposed to the more viewer-friendly landscape mode. Download Rotate That Video Player now and seize full control of your video orientation. Elevate your browsing experience today!
Browser extension features:
◆ Video Rotation:
Rotate videos in any direction - clockwise or counterclockwise - to match your preferred viewing angle instantly. This feature is supported by a slider that works on both desktop and mobile touch screen devices.
◆ Vertical Video Adjustment:
Adjust the vertical positioning of the video player, moving it up or down as needed.
◆ Horizontal Video Adjustment:
Modify the horizontal positioning of the video player, shifting it left or right according to your preference.
◆ Video Scaling:
Resize the video player to your desired dimensions, increasing or decreasing its size as required.
◆ Intuitive Controls: With a simple and user-friendly interface, rotate videos hassle-free with intuitive controls.
◆ Cross-Platform Support:
Compatible with a wide range of video players across various websites, including YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Bilibili, and more.
◆ Customizable Settings:
Select which elements to showcase in the panel, including rotation, transition, or scaling choices, ensuring you have all the video transformer buttons tailored to your preferences.
◆ Custom Toolbar Icon:
Select your preferred toolbar icon in either light or dark mode, adapting to your visual preferences.
◆ Shortcut Key:
The shortcut key rotates 90 degrees clockwise and counterclockwise, and resets it.
◆ Support for Dark Mode
Project Information:
 https://www.stefanvd.net/project/rotate-that-video-player/browser-extension/ 
Required Permissions:
◆ "contextMenus": Add a context menu to instantly browser button menus.
◆ "activeTab": The currently open tab allows for rotating the video player.
◆ "storage": Save settings locally and sync with your web browser account.
<<< Option feature >>>
Unlock an option feature to protect your eyes at night and focus on the video player, such as YouTube™, by installing Turn Off the Lights browser extension for YouTube and Beyond.
 https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/turn-off-the-lights/ 
Note: YouTube is a trademark of Google Inc. Use of this trademark is subject to Google Permissions.

bluejetty:00097106:ios.description:
In an age where myths dim and faith falters, you emerge as the prophesied Wayfarer destined to unite with legendary goddesses from myriad traditions. Together, you will purge the blight known as Shadow‑Blight and restore light to a world veiled in despair.
Summon Divine Goddesses
Complete specific tasks to freely receive up to two new cards, plus generous amounts of Golden Feathers for summoning, enhancement materials, and other vital resources. Everything you need to empower your team is provided.
Effortless Growth
Build and develop your favorite goddesses based purely on your preference. Idle gameplay automatically collects gold, experience, and gear for you. Exchange cards and cooperate with friends to create your ideal formation, all designed for a smooth and relaxed journey.
Strategic Depth, Roguelite Thrills
Beyond the beauty lies a world of tactical choices. Card combinations, random events, and resource management will challenge your judgment. In roguelike challenges such as the Delusion Lair, fortune can betray you, while clever planning can secure victory.
Constantly Refreshed Content
Take on new trials like the Maze of the Old Ones, testing both your combat and resource management skills. Engage in collaborative social activities, seek blessings at sacred shrines, and explore a steady stream of new gameplay modes, ensuring no two adventures feel the same.
Art Crafted with Splendor
Immerse yourself in a world shaped by thousands of hours of artistry. Every goddess’s garment is woven with intricate detail, every temple stone radiates life. This is a realm where divine beauty is rendered in breathtaking clarity.
Goddesses as Companions
Advanced AI technology transforms how you interact with your cards. Use simple prompts to reimagine a goddess’s look, or converse with them as true companions. Seek gacha guidance from Athena, discuss fate with Freyja, or share reflections with Amaterasu.
A Card Made Only for You
Connect your zodiac sign at launch to obtain a personalized card, uniquely designed and empowered to surpass ordinary limits.
We await your arrival in the world of Motto Immortal. May our paths soon unite under a renewed sky.

For over 25 years, Identity Guard has been an industry pioneer and leader in identity theft and credit protection services. Welcome to Baby Panda World. 
Here, you can make food, run your own food store, become a fashion designer, go on an adventure with dinosaurs, and interact with them to create your own stories!

Kiki is waiting for your help! Visit the Supermarket to buy Fruits and vegetables with them!

Dinosaur Planet presents brand new dinosaurs feed them and play with them. 
* Auto Repair Shop 
Little Panda's Auto Repair Shop is now open!

Come and embark on a flying adventure with our cute baby panda!

The music party is starting now! Come and join us! Let's enjoy the exciting atmosphere!

Do you know how fruits and vegetables grow? Come to Super Panda's Fruit Farm, play games with fruits and vegetables and learn about them! 
* Earthquake Safety
Hurry up, let’s use earthquake safety tips to keep animals safe.

Ever dreamed to be a host of a Café? Ever Wanted to be a cook and make coffee, flower tea, yummy cakes and more dishes on your own!
* Ice Cream Shop
Summer is the most loved and hottest season. Friends really love ice cream, popsicles, smoothies... Ice Cream Shop is now open in a beautiful seaside resort. 
* Fashion Dress Up Game
Kiki's fashionable clothing store is now open for business!Choosing clothes: Dresses, T-shirts, hats, shoes... Which outfit would the customer like?
* Pet House Design
Super Panda has 6 pets: Rabbit, hippo, cow, chicken, octopus, and penguin, and he decides to design a house for each pet. Would you like to help Baby Panda and his pets? 
* Food Party Dress Up
Super Panda is not at home today, and the foods have decided to hold a dress-up party. Would you help dress up the foods? The foods will invite you to the dress-up party! 
* Train Captain!
Are you ready to drive your train together with Super Panda and begin your adventure? Let's set off! 
* Super Panda Captain!
It’s time to explore the sea! Follow Kiki, our little captain and see what we encounter out there.
* Super Panda Dream Town
The new stores are opening up in Super Panda's Dream Town! 
* Fashion Flower DIY
Do you like flowers? Then come to Super Panda's Fashion Flower Shop for flower-based products DIY! 
* Princess Makeup!
Come and run the princess makeup salon with Super panda!

- Enjoy 240+ interactive games and 100+ animated shows in multiple languages.

- Weekly Updates

bluejetty:00060684:ios.summary: Presented in a day-by-day format, the MAGNIFICAT App puts a treasury of beautiful prayers at your fingertips. Each day includes prayers for the morning, evening, and night inspired by the Liturgy of the Hours; the entire text of daily Mass;
bluejetty:00060684:ios.description:
Presented in a day-by-day format, the MAGNIFICAT App puts a treasury of beautiful prayers at your fingertips. Each day includes prayers for the morning, evening, and night inspired by the Liturgy of the Hours; the entire text of daily Mass; meditations on the daily Gospel drawn from classic writings of the Church Fathers as well as insights from recent spiritual masters; essays on the lives of the saints, both well-known and obscure; and sacred art masterpieces with commentaries.
As it does for the hundreds of thousands already reading and praying with MAGNIFICAT, this unique App will accompany your spiritual journey and enrich your daily prayer life. 
Now 2 editions in one:
- The American English Edition of MAGNIFICAT (Fr. Sebastian White, OP, Editor-in Chief) contains readings, texts, and the Liturgical calendar appropriate for the USA using the New American Bible Lectionary. 
- The International English Edition of MAGNIFICAT (Léonie Caldecott, Editor-in-Chief) contains readings, texts, and the Liturgical calendar appropriate based on the English Standard Version Lectionary which is now used in England, Wales, and Scotland. 
Subscribers to the print edition receive complimentary App access. For first-time users, the App is free from the day it is installed until the end of that month, at which time you can subscribe on our website or through the App*. 
We pray that using this one-of-a-kind app will draw you closer to Jesus, his Blessed Mother, and his Church. 
*Subscriptions to MAGNIFICAT purchased through the App are on a monthly or yearly basis. As per Apple’s policy, annual subscriptions automatically renew and will be charged for the renewal unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription. After purchase, annual subscriptions may be managed, and auto-renewal may be turned off by accessing the user's Apple ID Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. 
Information about Magnificat’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Use can be found at http://bookstore.magnificat.net/privacy-policy-cookie-restriction-mode.

bluejetty:00014088:ios.description:
The Field Service mobile app by Salesforce is a brand new way to bring the full power of Field Service management to your mobile workforce. Improve first visit resolution by arming employees with this best-in-class mobile solution. Built to be offline first, Field Service presents information in a clean and easy-to-use user interface and arms your workforce with the latest information with in-app notifications.
Backed by the Salesforce1 platform, this application lets you customize and extend the app to empower your mobile employees with whatever they need to easily resolve issues in the field.
Note: This application requires your Salesforce org to have Field Service. Individual users must be provisioned with Field Service Technician licenses to use this application. Please contact your Salesforce Account Executive for more information on purchasing Field Service and user licenses.
Features:
- Easy-to-use thanks to an optimized, clear, and beautiful user interface to view service appointments, work orders, inventory, service history and other important information from anywhere.
- Mapping, navigation, and geolocation capabilities let you know where you are, where you’ve been, and where you’re headed next.
- Offline-first design with intelligent data priming and offline actions to let you finish work regardless of network connectivity.
- Collaborate in real-time with dispatchers, agents, managers, and other technicians or mobile employees using messages and photos through Chatter.
- Access relevant Knowledge Articles to help you finish tricky tasks.
- Stay informed with the most up-to-date information with automatic push notifications to relevant users.
- Easily obtain proof of service using your touch screen to capture customer signatures.
- Quickly generate and send Service Reports to your customers after completing jobs.
- Seamlessly manage your Van Stock inventory or record product transactions using a Price Book.
- Plan ahead by viewing the parts required to complete a job, and easily record the products consumed after completing a job.
- Extend and customize this application using configurable layouts to reorganize information, and list views to control user schedules. Custom tailored quick actions, Salesforce Flows, and deep-links to other apps allow users to tackle any case.
- Declare your time off by recording it in the application
- Scan barcodes and QR codes directly from the app
- Intuitively visualize the different steps required to finish complex jobs with work order line items
- Quickly get up to speed by viewing asset service history information.

bluejetty:00005400:ios.name: Video Merger Pro-music editor
bluejetty:00005400:ios.summary: VideoMerger Pro app is a pro version of “Video Merger FREE” app. In this VideoMerger Pro version, you will see lot of extra features compared to our free video merger app. This app can do more than just join multiple videos into one video.
bluejetty:00005400:ios.description:
VideoMerger Pro app is a pro version of “Video Merger FREE” app. In this VideoMerger Pro version, you will see lot of extra features compared to our free video merger app. This app can do more than just join multiple videos into one video. In general, with this video merger app, you can do- combining multiple videos, cropping video, adding background music for videos, add background color & Patterns to videos, add Overlays to videos and you can also add lot of effects to videos easily from this application.
Key Features of our Pro Video Merger App:
* Easily add a lot of different Effects to videos with our “Effects” option on this app 
* Very simple user interface, easy to understand
* Supports Portrait, Landscape and Square orientation Video output
* Combine multiple videos right on your device
* Add music to your video at a specified time.
* You can change the background color of the video
* You can also add Patterns to your video
* You can add stickers and text to the video at a specified duration.
* You can change the video speed 
* You can add audio to video from the library, default audios and use your files app .
* You can Reverse Video
* You can trim and cut videos
* You can Flip Videos
* Save the combined video to your device or share it on any Social networking sites
* Crop: Now we added a crop option to our VideoMerger app. You can now crop your video easily. We also provided aspect ratio as well.
Steps to Merge videos by adding effects with our Video Merger Pro App:
1. Select orientation of your output video( Landscape , Portrait , Square)
2. Click on the 'Add' button to select videos
3. Select your music from the music library by clicking on the 'Music' button
4. Click on Edit (Pencil icon) to add effects, overlay, or crop the video 
5. To watch the preview click on the 'Play' button
6. Share your merged video by clicking on the 'Share' button
So now you can combine many videos easily on your mobile just by using our simple video merger app. You not only combine many video clips into one video clip, but you can also add background music for videos, crop the video, and add a lot of effects to the video and thus you can make your video even more awesome. 
*********
If you would like to check our Free Video Merger app then visit this link: https://itunes.apple.com/app/id880953154

bluejetty:00131816:ios.description:
Ballistic-X: The Easiest Way to Calculate Shot Groups and Zero Your Rifle!
Designed by shooters, for shooters, Ballistic-X offers a simple, intuitive interface allowing users to customize their experience through the Options Menu. Whether you prefer MOA/MIL or INCH/CM, the app works seamlessly with any target, including Steel.
Key Features:
 - Included: Gain access to the core functionality of Ballistic-X with a single purchase. No subscriptions required for full access to essential tools!
 - Sync settings across multiple devices by signing in (optional, not required to use the app).
 - Offers useful data and labeling options that aid in Load Development.
 - The ATZ (Adjustment To Zero) feature helps you precisely adjust your turrets to bring your rifle to zero, saving you rounds and time. ATZ works dynamically at any range and supports all turret options.
Simple Workflow:
 - Take an image of your target (within the app or from your library)
 - Designate reference size via Settings (default is 1")
 - Mark two points on the target corresponding to the reference (for grid or steel targets)
 - Input the distance from the target
 - Select the caliber used
 - Mark Point of Aim and Impacts
 - Add overlay, label, crop, and export/share
 - Adjust your optic according to ATZ
Upgrade to the Advanced Toolkit (In-App Purchase): Unlock additional pro-level features with the Advanced Toolkit:
Advanced Overlay Display Options:
 - Mean Radius
 - Circular Error Probable (CEP)
 - Radial Standard Deviation (SD)
 - Vertical SD
 - Horizontal SD
 - Mean Windage
 - Mean Elevation
 - Impact Selector
 - Export to CSV for further data analysis
Ballistic-X is a community-driven app, committed to providing the best user experience possible, along with unbeatable customer service.
Join the Ballistic-X community today and elevate your shooting precision!

bluejetty:00069115:ios.description:
DrumComputer is the new specialist for synthetic drums, combining classic and modern synthesis with flexible modulations and luxurious sequencing. Intelligent randomizers, elegant pattern editing and import of your own samples are just a few of the mind blowing possibilities. Enjoy new drums everyday and get inspired by all the creativity that DrumComputer sets free. Just because, there still is all the unheard of... More than 400 global presets and 450 engine presets are shipping with DrumComputer. Add the Sound Randomizer and you have an unlimited source of cool sounds.
::FEATURES:: 
• 8 Sound Engines, each one layering a Resonator, Wavetable/Analogue, Resynth and Sampler
• Filter, Compressor, Overdrive and 2 kinds of Send Reverbs: Room and Hall
• 2x Env/LFO, plus Synth-Engine-Modulators, Sequencer-Modulators, ModMatrix
• Intelligent Randomizers for endless Drum Sounds
• 16 Step Sequencer and Pattern Generator, Probability, Rolls, +/- Step Delay, Swing, Humanize
• Auto- und Manual Remixing/Fills
• Easy Keyboard Mapping for Patterns, Mutes and Engine Triggers
• Keyzones for Rolls, Pitch and Modulation
• AUv3 plug-in with MIDI FX support & Standalone
• Audio Bounce
• MIDI File Export
• Multiple Audio/MIDI Outputs
• Virtual, Network, External & Bluetooth MIDI
• Ableton Link
• MIDI Learn & Host Automation
• Preset iCloud Sync
• Preset Share
••• Sound Engines •••
8 individual 3-layer synth engines to design, shape and sculpt powerful drum hits.
Depth modulation area with envelopes, LFOs, and a complex modulation matrix to change most parameters using a wide array of sources.
Finest noise table conversion technology, followed by a filter, distortion and side chain compressor.
••• Sequencer •••
Enjoy smart randomization to create patterns that feel natural and organic and add some feeling to the pattern with swing and 'humanization'. 
Move various parameters along to match the notes, such as velocity, pitch, decay, probability, roll and offset.
••• Kit Page •••
Bring all the individual sounds together in one place, select new sound presets or even randomly generate new sounds based on various sound type profiles and give your kit some character, punch and an analogue feel! 
••• Mix •••
With Volume, Mute, Solo, Pan as well as two reverb return channels you can send any of your sounds to at any time and also assign the mixer parameters as modulation destinations.
The Room reverb gives you a nice familiar space, letting you glue together multiple drum sounds, while the Hall reverb gives a massive space you can use either as a utility, or as way to fire your sounds off into the cosmos!
••• Mapping •••
Create up to 16 individual patterns (from scratch, or using the easy copy/paste function), and chain these together into a sequence, up to 16 patterns long. Use your MIDI keyboard or controller to send values that quickly and seamlessly switch between patterns on the fly.
Quickly remove and add the individual hits, trigger rolls of different speeds, or even have them as pitch modifiers.
••• Auto- and Manual Remixing/Fills •••
Mash up your patterns with one simple parameter and produce all sorts of automatic and random edits to your sound. 
Add creative fills and variations to your loop to keep it constantly moving with fresh ideas - great for jamming or to prevent audio stagnation.
••• Wavetable/Resynth Import & Sampler •••
Import your own audiofiles to create Wavetables. Resynthesize Hihats, Snares, even Chords with the Resynth import feature or switch to Sampler mode to play back samples the ordinary way.

::FEATURES:: 

•	8 Sound Engines, each one layering a Resonator, Wavetable/Analogue, Resynth and Sampler
•	Filter, Compressor, Overdrive and 2 kinds of Send Reverbs: Room and Hall
•	2x Env/LFO, plus Synth-Engine-Modulators, Sequencer-Modulators, ModMatrix
•	Intelligent Randomizers for endless Drum Sounds
•	16 Step Sequencer and Pattern Generator, Probability, Rolls, +/- Step Delay, Swing, Humanize
•	Auto- und Manual Remixing/Fills
•	Easy Keyboard Mapping for Patterns, Mutes and Engine Triggers
•	Keyzones for Rolls, Pitch and Modulation
•	AUv3 plug-in with MIDI FX support & Standalone
•	Audio Bounce
•	MIDI File Export
•	Multiple Audio/MIDI Outputs
•	Virtual, Network, External & Bluetooth MIDI
•	Ableton Link
•	MIDI Learn & Host Automation
•	Preset iCloud Sync
•	Preset Share

••• Sound Engines •••
8 individual 3-layer synth engines to design, shape and sculpt powerful drum hits.
Depth modulation area with envelopes, LFOs, and a complex modulation matrix to change most parameters using a wide array of sources.
Finest noise table conversion technology, followed by a filter, distortion and side chain compressor.

••• Sequencer •••
Enjoy smart randomization to create patterns that feel natural and organic and add some feeling to the pattern with swing and 'humanization'. 
Move various parameters along to match the notes, such as velocity, pitch, decay, probability, roll and offset.

••• Kit Page •••
Bring all the individual sounds together in one place, select new sound presets or even randomly generate new sounds based on various sound type profiles and give your kit some character, punch and an analogue feel! 

••• Mix •••
With Volume, Mute, Solo, Pan as well as two reverb return channels you can send any of your sounds to at any time and also assign the mixer parameters as modulation destinations.
The Room reverb gives you a nice familiar space, letting you glue together multiple drum sounds, while the Hall reverb gives a massive space you can use either as a utility, or as way to fire your sounds off into the cosmos!

••• Mapping •••
Create up to 16 individual patterns (from scratch, or using the easy copy/paste function), and chain these together into a sequence, up to 16 patterns long. Use your MIDI keyboard or controller to send values that quickly and seamlessly switch between patterns on the fly.
Quickly remove and add the individual hits, trigger rolls of different speeds, or even have them as pitch modifiers.

••• Auto- and Manual Remixing/Fills •••
Mash up your patterns with one simple parameter and produce all sorts of automatic and random edits to your sound. 
Add creative fills and variations to your loop to keep it constantly moving with fresh ideas - great for jamming or to prevent audio stagnation.

••• Wavetable/Resynth Import & Sampler •••
Import your own audiofiles to create Wavetables. Resynthesize Hihats, Snares, even Chords with the Resynth import feature or switch to Sampler mode to play back samples the ordinary way.

bluejetty:00021791:ios.description:
Docker Server Admin – Comprehensive Docker and Linux Host Management. Monitoring and management of Docker containers, images, and Linux hosts through a secure SSH connection.
Docker Container Stats. Gain valuable insights into your Docker containers with detailed statistics:
* CPU Usage: Visualize real-time CPU data with comprehensive charts.
* Memory Usage: Track memory consumption with intuitive graphical representations.
* Disk I/O: Monitor disk read/write operations through detailed charts.
* Network I/O: Analyze network traffic with line charts showing data transfer rates.
Linux Host Stats Dashboard. Keep your Linux hosts in check with a robust stats dashboard:
* Load Averages: View load averages over 1 minute, 5 minutes, and 15 minutes.
* CPU Load: Access charts displaying overall and per-core CPU load.
* Memory, Swap & Disk Usage: Monitor memory, swap, and disk utilization in real-time.
* Disk I/O: Get insights into disk transactions per second and read/write rates.
* Network I/O: Track transmission (TX) and reception (RX) rates for comprehensive network monitoring.
Docker Container Management. Easily manage your Docker containers with a user-friendly interface:
* Container Overview: View a list of containers with names, IDs, statuses, and port mappings.
* Container Control: Start, stop, restart, or remove containers as needed.
* Inspect & Logs: Inspect container details and access logs for troubleshooting.
Docker Image Management. Manage your Docker images with powerful tools:
* Image Overview: Access a list of images, including names, IDs, and versions.
* Image Control: Run containers from images, inspect image details, pull new images, or delete unwanted ones.
SSH Terminal: The built-in SSH client offers full access to your host system's command line, empowering you to perform administrative tasks remotely:
* Jump Host & Proxy Support: Connect securely via SSH jump hosts or SOCKS5 proxies, enabling you to manage servers in layered network environments.
* Interactive Terminal: Experience a fully interactive terminal that supports real-time command execution, run complex scripts and commands with ease.
* Command Management: Benefit from features such as command snippets, making it easy to reuse previous commands.
* Copy and Paste Functionality: Quickly copy and paste text between your device and the terminal, simplifying the workflow when working with scripts or configuration files.
* Startup & Batch Snippets: Automate your routine tasks with predefined startup snippets or execute batch commands across multiple sessions, saving time and increasing productivity.
* Session Persistence: Keep your sessions active for long-running tasks, allowing you to disconnect and reconnect without losing your place.
SFTP Explorer: Efficiently manage files on your server:
* File & Directory Management: Upload, download, edit, move, rename, and delete files easily.
* Streamlined Workflow: Perform operations on files and folders effortlessly, ensuring efficient handling of file transfers or system updates.
* User-Friendly Navigation: Browse directories smoothly while managing file permissions directly from the app.

bluejetty:00179875:ios.summary: Provides a list of LUNAR PHASES, a CALENDAR view, a FLAT VIEW COMPASS, a MAP VIEW and an AUGMENTED REALITY CAMERA 3-D VIEW showing the lunar path and its hour intervals. Also includes detailed description of event timing for solar and lunar
bluejetty:00179875:ios.description:
Provides a list of LUNAR PHASES, a CALENDAR view, a FLAT VIEW COMPASS, a MAP VIEW and an AUGMENTED REALITY CAMERA 3-D VIEW showing the lunar path and its hour intervals. Also includes detailed description of event timing for solar and lunar ECLIPSES, such as local visibility, exact start and end times and maximum magnitude.
* Ideal for photographers and anyone involved in outdoor nighttime activities. 
* Great for planning optimal light conditions.
Note - if you are interested in daytime light conditions, please look at the "Sun Seeker" app, which provides related functionality for the sun.
Main Features
* Uses GPS and magnetometer to find the correct lunar position and path for your current location, or for any location on earth
* Flat compass view showing current lunar position, diurnal lunar angle and elevation (separated into above and bow horizon segments)
* 3D augmented reality camera overlay view showing the moon's current position, its path with hour points marked
* Map view showing lunar light direction and elevation at all hours, for any location, scrollable for any date and time
* Ability to choose any date and view lunar path for that day
Notes
* The compass accuracy depends on having an undistorted magnetic field around your device. If you use it close to metallic objects or electrical equipment, directional accuracy may be impaired.

bluejetty:00022023:ios.summary:

Everybody learns differently and visual learners often struggle with new l
bluejetty:00022023:ios.description:
Learn to read, write and speak Japanese Hiragana & Katakana, Korean Hangul, Arabic and Chinese Mandarin in record time with Dr. Moku's bite-sized animated lessons. 
Everybody learns differently and visual learners often struggle with new languages.
Mnemonics are memory tricks that help you remember and retrieve abstract concepts.
Dr. Moku's visual and verbal mnemonics help you to learn auto-magically.
You will forever remember the sound and meaning of each character without the pain of rote memorization.
How will Dr. Moku work for you?
• Mnemonics are a proven language-learning technique.
• Learn how to write each character with animated stroke orders.
• Sample words with audio to aid pronunciation.
• Practice Modes: Reading, Listening, and Combo quiz modes.
• Audio Charts: each alphabet has a handy reference chart.
• Save favorite characters and phrases to a list and revise them easily with Autoplay.
• Phrasebooks 
• Offline mode
• No annoying third-party ads. Nice!
Dr. Moku's teaching method is perfect for complete beginners.
Learn the Japanese alphabets (Hiragana and Katakana) on your own and in record time. Master the Korean alphabet (Hangul) quickly and slickly with minimal effort. And we’ve just added Mandarin Chinese!
---------------------------------
Don’t you hate when companies claim to make learning fun?
There really is nothing "fun" about learning languages.
There’s definitely satisfaction in impressing friends, passing exams, and using your language skills in the real world but the fun comes in the time you save by finding the right learning method.
Dr. Moku strives to make learning languages painless and effective so you have more time to create your own fun.
Studying sucks. Memorization stinks. Mnemonics work.
The first Dr. Moku app was published way back in 2010, it was primitive and clunky but it helped tens of thousands of people to learn Hiragana and Katakana without the pain of rote memorization.
This new app is the start of a whole new chapter. The vision is to gradually add new languages and subjects using the same mnemonic techniques.
Download it now and start learning in seconds.

You’ll find slick deals and can compare prices on apparel, home items, shoes, tablets, laptops, TV’s, Smartphones deals, and more. 
FIND LOWEST PRICES
BuyVia helps you find the lowest prices on products, it also aggregates all of your favorite deals in one place so you can compare prices. UPC Barcode scanner, QR code, and search function allow you to find the lowest price. BuyVia app/website lets you securely purchase products or save your searches for later shopping.
RECEIVE ALERTS WHEN PRICES FALL
Set a shopping alert to receive a push notification or email when sales occur, whether the deal is online or local. Excludes amazon.

We value feedback! If you have an issue with the app, do not leave a review, immediately contact us.
===
How does the BuyVia App work?
Install the BuyVia App from the App store, launch it, after initial opening screens you can view 24/7 updated curated lists of the real deals from top stores like Amazon, eBay, Target, Walmart.
Why do you need BuyVia?
BuyVia helps you find hidden discounts and coupon codes that allow you to save money. You can also get alerts when products fall in price.
How is BuyVia different than a deal apps?
BuyVia, founded in 2012, focuses specifically on deals for major online stores. Promo codes are tested and clearly marked. We only feature deals on well reviewed products that are in demand. No expired deals or codes. We filter out smaller stores or 3rd party sellers we would not want to buy from ourselves.
Is BuyVia a Free app?
Yes, BuyVia is free to download. You do not need to create an account. It is an ad supported app with an in-app purchase option to remove ads.

- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- All prices are subject to change without notification. We occasionally run promotion prices as incentives or limited time opportunities for qualifying purchases made during the promotional time period. Due to the time sensitive and promotional nature of these events, we are unable to offer price protection or retroactive discounts or refunds for previous purchases in the event of a price reduction or promotional offering.

bluejetty:00083534:ios.description:
First Choice America Community Federal Credit Union – Weirton, WV proudly announces an updated version of our Mobile Banking. First Choice America Mobile provides a customized approach to mobile banking in a sleek, convenient, on-the-go package. And best of all, it’s FREE! Any First Choice America Online banking user will have instant and automatic access to mobile banking – there’s no enrollment process. Your First Choice America Online log-in will be the same for mobile banking. Stay on top of your finances wherever you are. With First Choice America Mobile, you’ll delight in the freedom of one-touch access to many of your most important banking functions.
 With First Choice America’s Mobile App, you can:
• 24/7 Account Access
• Check Your Balances – View up to the minute balances and detailed transactional history on all of your deposit and loan accounts.
• Make Transfers – Transfer funds between your credit union accounts and loans.
• Pay Bills via Bill Payer – Pay bills, view payment history, and check pending payments.
• Contact Us – Need help? We’re here for you.
• Promotions – View current Credit Union promotions.
SECURITY IS IMPORTANT TO US. Rest assured your mobile banking session is safe and secure. First Choice America Mobile uses the latest in 128 bit SSL encryption, multi-factor authentication, and no personal or account data will be stored on your mobile device. 
No matter where you are, with First Choice America Mobile, your Credit Union account is available to you, 24/7. So, download the First Choice America Mobile App today and see how easy mobile banking can be. 
Not yet a First Choice America Online banking user? Contact us at 1-800-427-4835 to get started. 
Not a member of First Choice America? Stop by any of our 8 convenient locations or visit us at https://fs4.formsite.com/fcacfcu/form2/secure_index.html www.firstchoiceamericacu.org to join.
The First Choice America Mobile App is Free of Charge; your wireless provider’s messaging and data rates may apply.
Consummation of transactions and delivery of alerts may be delayed for various reasons, including service outages affecting your phone, wireless or internet provider; technology failures; and system capacity limitations. 
When reviewing your account balances, please keep in mind it may not reflect all transactions, i.e. recent debit or credit card transactions or checks you may have written.
To learn how to protect your privacy, please visit http://www.firstchoiceamericacu.org/privacy.htm.
First Choice America CFCU is federally insured by the NCUA and an Equal Housing Lender. Membership eligibility required.

No internet? No problem
Always up-to-date maps even work offline
Every step of the way
A step-by-step guide means you’ll never get lost again

An ad-free experience
Proper VIP treatment, with no ads, ever
Priority support

Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased, where applicable.

bluejetty:00175073:ios.description:
Cubtale is an all-in-one pregnancy and baby tracking app built for families who want one continuous system from pregnancy through babyhood.
Track pregnancy week by week, log feeding and sleep, monitor growth, manage routines, sync caregivers, and preserve memories - all in one app. No switching after birth.
Pregnancy
Structured tools for every trimester.
Development
 • Week-by-week baby updates
 • Baby size comparisons
 • Due date tracking
Monitoring
 • Kick counter
 • Contraction timer
 • Weight tracking
 • Symptom logs
 • Appointment and test reminders
 • Visit notes
Pregnancy Memories
 • Weekly photos
 • Milestones
 • Personal notes
 • Timeline view
Baby
Continue seamlessly after delivery.
Feeding
 • Breastfeeding logs (side, duration)
 • Bottle feeding
 • Pumping sessions
 • Solid food tracking
 • Custom reminders
Sleep and Care
 • Sleep sessions
 • Diaper logs
 • Daily summaries
 • Pattern charts
Growth and Health
 • Weight tracking
 • WHO growth percentiles
 • Milestones
 • Vaccination logs
Breastmilk Inventory Management
Advanced milk stash tracking built for pumping families.
 • Track exact quantities
 • Log pump date and time
 • Manage multiple stash locations
 • Automatic expiration tracking
 • FIFO rotation guidance
 • Track thawed milk deadlines
Numbered Milk Bags
 • Assign unique numbers to each bag
 • Locate specific bags instantly
 • Know exactly which bag to use next
 • Maintain accurate freezer totals
Smart Milk Labels
 • Scan QR labels to log milk instantly
 • Link each bag to quantity, date, and location
 • Reduce manual entry errors
Milk usage and inventory stay aligned.
Smart and Connected
 • Apple Watch logging
 • Real-time sync across devices
 • Custom notifications
 • Cub integrations
 • Smart Milk Label integration
 • Customizable dashboard
 • Dark mode
Fast logging. Connected tracking.
Family Sharing
Built for shared parenting.
 • Add parents, grandparents, caregivers
 • Real-time updates
 • Multiple child profiles
 • Export logs for pediatricians
Everyone sees the same data. No duplicate tracking.
Memories
 • Pregnancy timeline
 • Baby milestones
 • Monthly photos
 • Important dates
One continuous record from pregnancy to babyhood.
Cubtale combines pregnancy tracking, baby tracking, advanced milk inventory management, smart integrations, and family coordination in one app designed to grow with your family.
One app. From pregnancy to baby. Built for families.

bluejetty:00146854:ios.description:
StrikeOut is a competitive first-person shooter. Choose your team and lead it to victory. Your reaction and skill are crucial here.
Gameplay:
This is a first-person shooter with no auto-aiming—only skill will lead you to victory. Defeat the opposing team or be the top player in two different game modes.
Multiplayer:
StrikeOut is a multiplayer FPS where you compete against real players on various maps and in different game modes.
Cases:
Open cases to get weapon skins. There are three types of skins: COMMON, RARE, and EPIC. The Common case contains standard skins, while Rare and Epic cases offer more exclusive designs.
Game Modes:
- Classic Mode
Two teams, one goal—eliminate the enemy team. Show your skill, speed, and tactics. It won’t be easy!
- Gun Game
A brand-new mode with 16 weapon levels. Earn 3 points to advance to the next weapon. Your team won’t harm you, but only one can be the winner!
SOM: Creator
Unleash your creativity! Design your own weapon skins by choosing from available textures or uploading your own.
SOM: Gallery
A creative hub for artists. Share your skins with the community! The best skins will be featured and sold in the next season.
Maps:
The game offers 9 unique maps: Skyscraper, Train Station, Overkill, Tram Depot, Desert 2, Desert City, Trix, Warehouse, and 3000$. Each map has its own unique features—pick one that suits your playstyle!
Victory awaits!

bluejetty:00168347:ios.description:
EL Tracker is an app by CTA riders, for CTA riders. 
We are the only completely free Chicago transit app that offers: 
- Customizable widgets displaying departures, with SmartWalk delay
- Siri support and low-vision accessibility
- Multiple languages (including Spanish and Polish)
- Tailored alerts with push notifications
We are Chicagoans, who were irritated by the lack of a simple Chicago transit app. One night, we said, "Why can't I have a widget that shows me when the train is coming?" And from there, EL Tracker was born. We strive to create technology that has a positive impact on the lives of everyday Chicagoans. We also want to make traveling around the city as accessible as possible, which is why we provide low-vision support, ADA accessibility notations, elevator outage push notifications, and multiple languages. 
EL Tracker is not an official CTA app, nor are we endorsed by the CTA.

bluejetty:00179572:ios.name: Bus Games : Driving Master 3D
bluejetty:00179572:ios.summary:

Are you ready to take on the responsibilities of a city bus driver and transport passengers to their destinations? Do you have what it takes to become the top bus driver
bluejetty:00179572:ios.description:
Completely revamped Bus Games : Driving Master 3D is on the App Store.
Are you ready to take on the responsibilities of a city bus driver and transport passengers to their destinations? Do you have what it takes to become the top bus driver in the city?
Experience the daily life of a real bus driver with a combination of bus driving on busy streets and bus parking on tight parking spots. Feel the thrill of bus simulation and get ready to enjoy hours of driving with beautiful environments.
DON’T FORGET TO WEAR A SEAT BELT!
Bus Simulator Gameplay & Features:
Select your favorite bus from the garage and get ready to explore the city streets and parking lots. Pick up passengers from bus terminals and drop them at their destination. Move from one bus station to another until all the bus stops are empty. Park your bus in different designated spots in the city and level up your bus parking skills. Complete all the missions to earn coins & rewards which you can use to buy new buses or upgrade your bus. Modern Bus Driving Simulator also brings its players a thrilling opportunity to showcase their creativity through a new user creative mode.
Game Modes:
Easy Parking: In this mode, practice the art of parking buses in designated spots around the city. Complete multiple challenges and become a professional bus driver 2023.
Offroad Driving: In this mode, drive buses on crazy off-road tracks and rough terrain. Show your pro driver skills and transport passengers safely while hill climbing.
City Traffic Mode: Maneuver your bus through busy streets and avoid collisions with other vehicles. Follow all the traffic rules and deal with real life traffic situations.
Hard Parking: This mode is specially designed for pro drivers who love to take challenges. Avoid roadside hurdles and park the bus in tight spots with a limited amount of time.
User Creative Mode: Create your own custom tracks, roadside hurdles, start and finish lines as well as weather selection in user creative mode of bus simulator game.
Terms & Privacy Policy
https://www.theknights.com.pk/privacy-policy/
Disclaimer
Bus Games : Driving Master 3D is completely free to play, but some in-apps such as buses, customization items within the game may be available for purchase. To disable the payment feature, you can go to your device settings and turn off in-app purchases.
Download free and play now!

Escape from a laboratory with a precious formula, save the world and overcome the archaeological traps of a lost island!
***/***
This application will allow you to experience the extraordinary adventures of Unlock! - an adventure cooperative board game - based on the escape rooms model.
Infiltrate a Cold War laboratory and recover the serum that will save mankind! Thwart the plans of the despicable Professor Noside in this crazy cartoon-style adventure! Escape from the island of an eccentric antique collector and overcome its traps! ...
Unlock! is a board game based on the escape rooms model.
Search the rooms, find hidden objects, combine them, solve riddles, avoid traps ... and exit before the end of the countdown!
The Unlock! application is a free “companion app”: you must use the Unlock! board game to enjoy it. This application will allow you to get valuable clues and enter secret codes you deciphered. 
It will also contribute to the atmosphere around the table with its music tailored to each adventure, awful penalties ... and fatal countdown!
At the end of the game, it will give you your score calculated on the time you spent to complete the adventure, the number of penalties you collected, the number of clues you requested, etc.
Unlock! is a game created by Cyril Demaegd, published by Space Cowboys and distributed by Asmodee (Game’s POS list available at www.asmodee.com .)
Try the Unlock! game for free: Download “Elite” cards; game rules and tutorial available at www.spacecowboys.fr

bluejetty:00165610:ios.summary:
Enlarge photos, enhance detail, and retouch portraits with AI Enlarger. Give small images more room on screen, refine your favorite portraits, or create a new look with color presets and LUTs.
Choose offline AI processing on your device or
bluejetty:00165610:ios.description:
Enlarge photos, enhance detail, and retouch portraits with AI Enlarger. Give small images more room on screen, refine your favorite portraits, or create a new look with color presets and LUTs.
Choose offline AI processing on your device or online enhancement tools. From a single photo to a batch of images, you control the model, scale, and finishing touches.
AI IMAGE UPSCALING
- Enlarge photos and anime artwork at 2x, 4x, or 8x, where supported.
- Choose from three offline models: Fast, Sharp, and General. Compare results to find the look that suits your image.
- Preview the original and processed image before saving.
- Prepare larger images for wallpapers, creative projects, and sharing.
BATCH UPSCALING
- Import up to 10 images at a time and upscale them at 2x or 4x.
- Use offline AI models to process photo collections, illustrations, and product images on your device.
- Follow each image's progress and save your results without repeating the same steps for every photo.
PORTRAIT RETOUCHING
Make subtle changes or build a more polished portrait with adjustable controls:
- Smooth skin, adjust brightness, balance skin tone, and lighten facial shadows.
- Refine eye brightness and sharpness, eyebrow detail, and lip color.
- Adjust eye size and face width to suit your preferred look.
- Compare before and after as you edit.
COLOR, LIGHT, AND CREATIVE LOOKS
- Explore presets and LUT filters, then adjust their intensity.
- Combine a preset with manual adjustments and a LUT to make the look your own.
- Balance exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, and blacks.
- Fine-tune white balance, temperature, tint, saturation, vibrance, and hue.
- Adjust sharpness, clarity, noise reduction, dehaze, fade, and vignette.
- Use online AI enhancement and sharpening tools when you want another processing option.
ONLINE OR OFFLINE: YOUR CHOICE
Offline upscaling processes images on your device without uploading them for enhancement. Online tools upload your image and require an internet connection. Check online tasks and available results in History.
Available scales and output sizes depend on the tool, input image, and device resources. Large images may be resized for processing. Retouch and adjustment exports are limited to 2048 pixels on the longest edge. Results vary with the source image and selected settings.
PREMIUM OPTIONS
Some features require an in-app purchase or credits. Premium options include monthly and yearly subscriptions and a one-time lifetime purchase. See the app for current prices and plan details.
Choose a photo, compare your results, and find the right finish with AI Enlarger.
Support: support@imglarger.com
Website: https://imglarger.com
Privacy Policy: https://imglarger.com/blog/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://imglarger.com/terms/

bluejetty:00180300:ios.description:
Rideshare by women, for women.
HERide connects you with women drivers across metro Atlanta, so you can get where you're going feeling safe, respected and unbothered. Whether it's your morning commute, a late night out, or a 6 a.m. flight, there's a woman behind the wheel.
WHY WOMEN CHOOSE HERIDE
• Women drivers only — every driver is a woman, reviewed by our team before her first ride
• Your number stays private — calls between you and your driver go through a masked line
• Live trip tracking — watch your ride on the map from pickup to drop-off
• Emergency button — reach your emergency contacts in a tap during a trip
• Clear pricing — see your fare before you book, no surprises
RIDE YOUR WAY
• Ride now or schedule ahead — lock in tomorrow's pickup tonight
• Airport rides — add your flight number and we time your pickup to your real arrival, even when your flight runs late
• Multiple stops — school drop-off, groceries, then home, all in one trip
• Favorite drivers — save the drivers you love and request them again
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Nights out: get home safe with a driver you feel comfortable with
• Moms and families: a ride you can trust for the people you love
• Students: affordable, safe rides to campus and back
• Seniors: friendly, patient drivers for appointments and errands
• Business: corporate accounts for teams and employees
HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter your pickup and destination
2. Choose your ride and see your fare up front
3. Meet your driver — her name, photo and car are in the app
4. Pay by card, no cash needed
DRIVE WITH HERIDE
Are you a woman who wants to earn on your own schedule? Download the HERide Driver app to apply.
Questions? We're here to help at heride.com.
HERide. Ride unbothered.

bluejetty:00160376:ios.description:
Track what goes in, what comes out, and what happens in between. Spot possible triggers. Bring your doctor real data.
Track bowel movements, symptoms, food, stress, sleep, and more in seconds with Plop—the smart poop and gut symptom tracker. Built for IBS, IBD, Crohn’s disease, ulcerative colitis, constipation, diarrhea, and everyday gut health, its machine-learning engine analyzes your personal tracking history—not generic averages or one-size-fits-all advice—to reveal possible triggers and meaningful changes. Bring clearer data to your doctor and build a more complete picture of your gut health. 
QUICK LOGGING. PERSONALIZED TRACKING
Free includes:
Use the Bristol Stool Scale to log bowel movements and common symptoms, including bloating, gas, nausea, mucus, blood in stool, and pain. Add notes whenever you need them.
• Unlimited logs and history
• Calendar view
• Detailed charts and basic analysis
• CSV export
• Apple Health integration
With Premium:
Create unlimited custom categories and tracking factors based on your needs or your doctor’s guidance, including specific foods or meals, pain severity, bleeding severity, medications, stress, sleep, mood, activity, and more. Add photos whenever you want to provide additional context.
Premium also unlocks:
• Advanced machine-learning analysis
• Monthly PDF reports
• Cloud backup and sync across devices
BRING DATA, NOT JUST MEMORIES
Create clear reports to review before an appointment or share with your doctor, gastroenterologist, or dietitian. Reports can include bowel movement frequency, Bristol Stool Scale distribution, symptoms, custom factors, and trends over time.
MADE FOR YOUR GUT HEALTH JOURNEY
Plop can help you track:
• IBS, including IBS-C, IBS-D, and IBS-M
• Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis
• Constipation, diarrhea, bloating, and abdominal discomfort
• Food sensitivities and elimination diets
• Low-FODMAP tracking
• Digestive symptoms for a family member or loved one
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your digestive health information is personal and stored locally on your phone by default. Plop does not sell your personal health data. You choose what to track, export, and share. Premium includes optional cloud backup and sync across devices.
Download Plop today and start understanding your digestive health with clearer, more organized data.
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy:
https://plopdiary.com/en/privacy.html
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Plop is a personal tracking and wellness tool, not a medical device. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Insights are for informational purposes only and do not replace professional medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional about your health.

bluejetty:00019286:ios.description:
One of the most realistic OffRoad simulation game with HD Graphics and Free Roam Mode. Drive real suspension offroad vehicles on challenging Desert terrains requires different real life offroad Techniques. OffRoad Drive Desert is the ultimate off-road experience for gamers of all skill levels. It's about pushing your limits, testing your skills, and forging your own path through the wild. So buckle up, adventurer, and get ready to conquer the most immersive off-road simulation ever created!
Enjoy the 4x4 OffRoad Experience with real Suspension of vehicles and real Graphics like PC games. Use Orbit camera and other different camera’s to check each tyre is on accurate place and maintain Traction on steep slopes to avoid FlipOver.
Realistic Vehicle Damage: Take care of your vehicle! Every crash and scrape leaves its mark. Physical Damage is applied on vehicles so you have to drive carefully like real life Off-road driving to avoid Damage and complete Level. 
Day/Night Mode in FreeRoam: Sunlight illuminates the environment making it easier to see obstacles and navigate the terrain. Traction, visibility, and even challenges respond to the sun's position. OffRoad Driving is easier in daylight with better visibility and traction. The Night mode makes the game more Challenging the darkness presents new challenges. Reduced visibility makes navigating more difficult, requiring players to use headlights strategically and be extra cautious. Certain obstacles, like hidden rocks or steep drop-offs, become harder to spot.
Diverse Landscapes: From sun-baked canyons to winding mountain passes and raging rivers, conquer a variety of breathtaking environments, each with its own unique challenges.
Free Roam Mode: Explore the desert at your own pace, discover hidden secrets, and create your own off-road adventures.
Game Main Features
• Ride every where and any car in FreeRoam Mode.
• Recover stuck vehicle using Winch Feature.
• Engage Diff-Lock if wheels loose Traction.
• Realistic Vehicle Suspension and Physics.
• Day/Night Mode selection in FreeRoam Mode.
• 13 High Quality OffRoad Vehicles.
• 11 Desert type Challenging Large Maps.
• 15 Challenging Levels.
• Realistic manual transmission can be used to tackle any type of terrain and steep hills by engaging the 4wd or 4x4 and Diff-Lock in 1st gear.
• Tune Game Settings for Best Performance and Smooth Control for different devices.
• No In-App purchases just one time Payment.
Other Features
• Complete Levels to Unlock Maps and Vehicles for FreeRoam Mode.
• Select any Map and Vehicle in FreeRoam Mode.
• Select Day/Night mode in FreeRoam Mode.
• Rock Crawling.
• Traction Control.
• Roll, Pitch Meters.
• 5 different Cameras:
 1 - Near Orbit Camera
 2 - Far Orbit Camera
 3 - Internal Camera
 4 - Follow Camera
 5 - Bumper Camera
Vehicle Features
• Stunning Graphics like PC games.
• Realistic Manual Transmission with Tachometer.
• Diff-Lock to rotate all wheels on same speed.
• 2WD, 4WD or 4x4 Gear for providing Power to all wheels.
• 1st Gear for more Power.
• 2nd Gear is useful for moderate speed and 3rd Gear is used for more Speed.
• Tachometer for proper shifting.
• Physical Body Damage.
