Stay connected to the San Francisco 49ers all year long.
The official San Francisco 49ers app brings the team closer than ever – whether you're at Levi’s® Stadium on gameday or cheering from anywhere in the world. Get breaking news, explore exclusive content, browse the roster and player stats, manage your tickets, and unlock a personalized fan experience built around you.
With an entirely new navigation experience and powerful features, the app makes it easier than ever to follow the team, access gameday essentials, and connect with the global 49ers Faithful community, with support for both English and Spanish.
Key Features
• Personalized Fan Experience: Sign in with your NFL account to unlock a customized experience tailored to your fandom. Your Fan Profile tracks your engagement, milestones, favorites, and achievements as you interact with the team and the app.
• Tickets & Gameday Access: Access and manage your tickets with secure Ticketmaster integration, making it easy to view and present your tickets for stadium entry. Browse upcoming games and find tickets for future matchups directly in the app.
• Season Ticket Member Hub: Season Ticket Members can access a dedicated hub designed just for them, with member benefits, account information, renewal updates, and exclusive experiences all in one place.
• Niners Network: Discover and connect with the 49ers Faithful community through Niners Network, where the Faithful can explore events, fan groups, and activities happening near them.
• Media & Content: Stay up to date with the latest 49ers news and storytelling through videos, galleries, podcasts, and articles. Follow your favorite players and enjoy content curated around your interests.
• Shop & Explore: Browse official 49ers merchandise through the in-app team store and discover additional experiences connected to Levi’s® Stadium and the 49ers community.
Download the official San Francisco 49ers app today and experience the team like never before.

bluejetty:00022189:ios.name: Qlone 3D Scanner
bluejetty:00022189:ios.summary: Qlone is an all-in-one 3D scanner app. We have made it easy and fast to create 3D models from real objects, edit them with built-in editing tools and seamlessly export the result to popular platforms, 3D file formats and 3D printers. You ca
bluejetty:00022189:ios.description:
Qlone is an all-in-one 3D scanner app. We have made it easy and fast to create 3D models from real objects, edit them with built-in editing tools and seamlessly export the result to popular platforms, 3D file formats and 3D printers. You can even animate your models in Augmented Reality! A perfect tool for AR/VR content creation, 3D Printing, STEM Education, eCommerce showcase and many other uses.
SCANNING
If you choose to scan with the Qlone mat, simply print it from the included mat file, place your object in the middle of the mat and let the AR dome guide you through the scanning process. You can also scan the object from two different angles and it will be automatically merged for a better overall result which includes areas such as the bottom of the object.
You can now also scan without a mat in two different modes - AR mode which makes it easy to scan with our familiar AR dome or Photo mode, which takes higher quality 4K images in both manual or automatic modes.
When scanning with the mat, there is no waiting time, all processing is done in real time on your phone in seconds. In the new option to scan without a mat, processing is done in minutes on our blazing fast Qlone Cloud but we value your privacy so we don't store or view any of your models!
MODIFYING
With the integrated tools in the app you can optimize and modify your 3D model without needing to export them to other sophisticated software.
Texture - Change the Brightness, Saturation and Sharpness of the 3D model. Pick colors from the scanned object and apply them by painting directly on the 3D model. Blur areas or transitions for smoother results.
Clean - Fill holes in the model, erase unwanted areas such as the background surface or smooth certain parts. 
Sculpt - Improve or alter the shape of your object by pressing or pulling a selected area and adjust the transition.
Shape - Fix the orientation, enhance the mesh details or set the scale size of your model for 3D printing. You can also simplify the mesh for lower file size export.
Art - Turn your object into scaled cubes or meshed objects of art, ready to be printed.
AR View + ANIMATION:
You can beam your 3D models back to reality and bring them to life with automatic rigging and animation.
EXPORTING and IMPORTING:
Export your model directly to platforms like SketchFab, i.materialise, Lens Studio, Shapeways and CGTrader. Models can be exported in a variety of formats for use in other 3D tools – OBJ, STL, FBX, USDZ, GLB (Binary glTF) which includes animation, PLY, X3D. 
Share your models with friends as an image, video or GIF through Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, WhatsApp, Email and iMessage.
You can import any 3D model into Qlone. Import in any 3D format (40+ formats) to view, modify or bring it to life in AR with our automatic animation!
PREMIUM UPGRADE (ONE-TIME PURCHASE):
Qlone is free to download and scan but exporting the 3D models, AR view with Animations and scanning in 4K resolution are premium features that require an upgrade to premium. Such upgrade is a one-time purchase fee and is not based on an annoying subscription. 
Also, there is a new premium feature that allows scanning without a mat! Since processing for scanning without the mat takes place on our Qlone Cloud, when you upgrade to premium you unlock this new option and receive 50 cloud credits for 50 such scans. You can later purchase more credits in highly affordable packs if needed.
When you upgrade to premium, all models in your gallery and future models will be unlocked for unlimited exports in any format and it will work across all your Apple devices. 
PRIVACY POLICY:
http://eyecue-tech.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=143
TERMS OF USE:
http://eyecue-tech.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=142

bluejetty:00136393:android.summary: Open your own beauty parlor business in Hollywood with Beauty Tycoon, an engaging idle beauty salon tycoon game! As a budding hair stylist and beauty parlor owner, your mission is to transform your modest spa into a luxurious haven of beaut
bluejetty:00136393:android.description:
Open your own beauty parlor business in Hollywood with Beauty Tycoon, an engaging idle beauty salon tycoon game! As a budding hair stylist and beauty parlor owner, your mission is to transform your modest spa into a luxurious haven of beauty, catering to the stars. This fashion and beauty management simulation game isn't just about haircuts or nail design; it's a comprehensive project makeover that promises endless fun and creativity. Dive into spa games, barber shop games, and salon games to master every aspect of the beauty industry.
🌟 Explore the Diverse Services of Your Beauty Business Empire
Dive into the heart of Hollywood and unleash your inner stylist with a range of services including hair cutting, hairstyling, manicures, nail design, makeup application, spa treatments, and much more. Each service is an opportunity to show off your creativity and make your clients look and feel like celebrities.
🌸 Master the Art of Beauty and Fashion
From the perfect haircut to the most intricate nail designs, become a master of your craft. Offer your clients a complete makeover experience - from spa treatments to wedding preparations, ensuring every detail is perfect for their big day. Engage in fashion games, dress-up challenges, and makeup stylist competitions to keep up with the latest Hollywood trends.
💖 Engage in a Captivating Hollywood Storyline
Your journey is not just about managing a salon; it's about building relationships and living your own Hollywood story. Interact with a cast of characters, including clients and staff, making strategic decisions that will determine the success of your beauty empire. Will you find love, friendship, or rivalry amidst the glamour?
🚀 Grow Your Spa Business and Become a Beauty Tycoon
Make strategic decisions to expand your services, upgrade your salon, and attract more high-profile clients. From hair cuttery to nail polish games, every decision you make will bring you one step closer to becoming a renowned beauty tycoon in Hollywood.
🌈 Experience the Magic of Beauty Tycoon
Enjoy a free idle salon game experience with an easy-to-navigate interface and captivating gameplay.
Dive into a rich storyline filled with vibrant characters and unexpected twists.
Choose from a vast array of beauty treatments and upgrades to dazzle your clientele.
Revel in the detailed 2D graphics and well-designed animations, bringing your salon to life.
Participate in various events that will shape your Hollywood story and the fate of your beauty empire.
Beauty Tycoon is more than just a time-management game; it's a journey into the world of fashion, beauty, and glamour, where every decision can lead to fame or failure. Whether you're designing the perfect nail, styling hair fit for the red carpet, or transforming your salon into a luxurious spa, this game offers a unique blend of idle tycoon gameplay and interactive storytelling. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure in Hollywood's beauty scene, where your stylist skills will shine, and your beauty salon will become the talk of the town. From skincare games to haircut games, become the ultimate hairdresser and parlor owner in this hairdresser simulator.

bluejetty:00126147:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00126147:ios.description:
By Joel Thielke, C.Ht. — the only hypnosis app in his catalog that tells you what to play next instead of leaving you at a shelf.
START WITH WEEK ONE
Twelve sessions out of the library are laid across four weeks, three to a week, and the next of them is named at the top of Home. Week one goes after cravings. Week two is about eating on purpose rather than on autopilot. Week three makes moving your body something you want instead of owe. Week four is the stretch most plans leave out: staying where you got to. None of it is locked to a date — play week four tonight if you like, and begin the whole thing again whenever you want. A session counts wherever you start it, so reaching a step through Browse or a playlist credits it just the same.
CRAVING SOS
A craving will not wait twenty minutes for an induction. One tap, high on Home, drops you into the middle of Cravings Buster — the patter is talking within a second, with nothing to set up and no menu in the way — and five minutes later it fades itself out and gives you your day back. It plays that session, so it opens as soon as Cravings Buster is yours.
THE WEIGH-IN LOG, IF YOU WANT ONE
One weight, one date, in whichever unit you think in, with a trend under them and the difference since your first entry. It lives in one file inside this app, flagged so that neither iCloud nor a computer backup copies it: this iPhone holds it and nothing else does. No sign-in, nothing uploaded. Leave it empty and the rest of the app behaves identically. Settings can add a bedtime nudge at an hour of your choosing; it stays silent until you turn it on.
111 SESSIONS, NOT A DIET SHEET
Eleven areas, and the body work sits inside them — Cravings Buster, Healthy Weight Loss, Metabolism Boost, Stay Slim Hypnosis, Thinner Thighs Hypnosis, Get in Beach Body Shape, Stop Hiding Weight, Anti-Aging Hypnosis, Be In The Moment, Love Your Workout, Runner's Hypnosis, Raise Your Energy Levels, The New You. Around those: confidence, calm, focus, sleep, relationships, money — because what usually comes apart is not the plan. Sleep Better plays free the first time you open the app.
YOU ASSEMBLE EVERY SESSION
• Six ways in — the original Short, Long and Sleep inductions, plus Beach (a calm walk along the shore), Speed (a fast way in) and Staircase (counting down step by step)
• Four ways out — Wake for daytime, Sleep to stay under until morning, Delay to sit in silence for five minutes before a gentle wake-up, or no ending at all
• Thirteen beds can sit behind the voice: the three rains, water, fire, insects, wind, snowfall, chimes, green noise, binaural beats and a 528 Hz tone, each on a volume of its own so the words stay in front
• Change the way in, the way out or the bed while a session is already running
• Zen mode — leave it half a minute and the controls melt away, leaving sky and voice
THE REST OF THE NIGHT
Queue several programs and they run as one. Leave Repeat on and it goes round until you stop it; set the timer and it closes with a soft fade. It plays on with the phone locked. On iPhone Duo it fits both displays, and Nightstand mode makes it a calm bedside view when the phone stands half-open. A session played once lives on the phone and needs no signal.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR, YOU KEEP
No subscription, nothing that renews. Take a session at a time, or take all 111 together. Purchases ride along with your Apple Account onto every device you use, and a reinstall takes one tap: Restore Purchases.
WHO IS SPEAKING
Joel Thielke, C.Ht. narrates all 111 of these sessions. Eating, moving and the habits wrapped around both have been his subject since 2010; he trains other practitioners in the method.
What is on offer is hypnotherapy: deep relaxation, and steady work on habits that are already yours. It is not a medical or a psychological treatment, and no reason to postpone one.
From the maker of Easy Meditation & Hypnosis · Weight Loss - Sleep Learning · Spirit Guide Sleep Meditation — on the App Store.

bluejetty:00015115:ios.description:
Classic Words is the best word game to play against your iPhone or iPad (solitaire mode). Scrabble for victory and enrich your vocabulary thanks to the built-in word definitions!
6 languages are supported: English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, and Dutch.
Tired of stumbling across cheaters or waiting for hours for your online opponent to play in multiplayer games?
Try out Classic Words for instant fun, no matter if you are a beginner in crossword games or a tournament player!
Choose the difficulty level (from beginner to expert), pick a word list, and use your strategy skills and vocabulary to try and defeat the iPhone. The English word lists included in the game are inspired by the official lists used in Scrabble tournaments: NWL and SOWPODS.
Classic Words gameplay is classical to crosswords board games: create and place words on the board and boost your score by placing letters on the high-scoring Double Letter, Double Word, Triple Letter, and Triple Word squares.
Use all 7 letters from your rack to play a Bingo and get a 50-point bonus.
This game is a great time killer for all fans of board games and strategy games. It is also an educational game that will allow kids (and adults :-) ) to improve their spelling and vocabulary. 
Thanks to the fast reactivity of the artificial intelligence (AI) and to the official word lists, Classic Words can be used by traditional word game enthusiasts to play quick training matches and learn new words from the computer's moves.
Unlike with multiplayer board games, where some dishonest players use anagram solvers, there is no cheating possible when playing in solitaire... Letters and blanks are always picked randomly, and the computer's artificial intelligence does not have more information than you do.
Only your tactics and creativity can make the difference...
Will you play strategically enough to outwit the computer and its extensive vocabulary?
EXCLUSIVE FEATURES:
- 6 levels of difficulty
- Automatic display of the definition of the iPhone words
- Distribution of letters and points are adapted to the language
- Supports offline play
Languages and dictionaries supported:
 - English (SOWPODS 2025 + NWL 2023)
 - French
 - German (with support of Umlauts, and Ezset to be replaced by two 'S')
 - Italian
 - Spanish
 - Dutch

bluejetty:00151207:ios.description:

• Guided and Self-paced Meditations
• Audio and Video Lectures

• 21-Day Challenge
• In-App Purchase
• Notifications

About Dhyan Vimal
Since 1991, Dhyan Vimal has dedicated his life to the study of human consciousness and the evolution of mankind, sharing his teachings to a vast global audience. The core of his work has been to put down the right understanding, tools, techniques and insights to help pave the way for individuals seeking their fulfillment. A selection of his teachings, writings, meditations, lectures and programmes are available for all to learn from.

Accounts - View and manage all your cash accounts digitally. Review recent transactions, see current balances, and search for specific payments or deposits.
Bill Pay - Schedule or manually make payments on your bills through our easy-to-use bill pay system.
Fund Transfers - Send funds to and from your connected accounts through our easy to use fund transfer capability.

bluejetty:00062061:ios.description:
Install Pingo on your kid's phone to see their location on the map and ease your worries. Pingo works together with the parent app, Findmykids.
It’s easy to set up! First, install Findmykids on your phone. Then, install Pingo on your kid’s phone and enter the code from Findmykids.
Stop worrying about where your kid is!
KEY FEATURES:
• Kid’s location and route 
View your kid’s current location and a list of places they visited throughout the day.
• Movement alerts 
Add Places (school, home, park, etc.) and receive notifications when your kid arrives or leaves.
• SOS signal 
In an emergency, your kid can notify you by pressing the SOS button.
• Bypass silent mode 
Send a loud signal that can be heard even if the phone is on silent or in a backpack.
• Battery control 
Receive notifications when your kid’s device battery is low, so you can remind them to charge it.
• Chat with your kid 
Exchange text and voice messages, along with fun stickers.
Enjoy all features free for 7 days after the app's first launch. After the trial period, only the real-time location feature will remain available. To access all features, you’ll need to purchase a subscription.
THE APP WILL NEED ACCESS TO:
— Location, including background location: to determine your kid’s whereabouts
— Camera and photos: to set up a profile picture when registering your kid
— Contacts: to set up GPS watches and choose numbers from the contact list
— Microphone: to send voice messages in chat
— Notifications: to receive chat messages
If you encounter any technical issues using Pingo, you can always reach Findmykids’ 24/7 support through the app’s chat or via email at support@findmykids.org. We are always here to help!

bluejetty:00024565:ios.name: Stanford Children's
bluejetty:00024565:ios.summary:
Using our home app, you can
Find a Doctor – Ability to look up all the doctors in our network by geo location and zip code with contact capability and user-friendly search. The app lists by all our locations including the Network location
bluejetty:00024565:ios.description:
Using our home app, you can
Find a Doctor – Ability to look up all the doctors in our network by geo location and zip code with contact capability and user-friendly search. The app lists by all our locations including the Network locations, with Google map integration. Location detail page is integrated into “Find a Doctor”. Users can view services provided at each location, and directions with Google maps
Doctor Profile – Summary of Doctor profile (from Stanford School of Medicine’s CAP profile system) including Doctor’s all available locations, specialties, services provided, conditions treated, board certifications and publications.
Patient Portal – Stanford Children's patients and families can manage their MyChart health account and securely access test results, mail their doctors and health information.
Symptom Checker - Use this symptom checker to learn what steps you can take to relieve your symptoms at home.
Call For Appointment – Easy access to clinics and services with ability to call for appointment with integrated calling number capability.
Pay Your Bill - The Online Billing Manager makes your billing and payment process simple and convenient. You can make a payment on a bill without logging into MyChart or having a MyChart account.
Navigate The Hospital – Dynamic 3-dimensional way finding and navigation inside the hospital with access to maps and locations on each floor.
Attend a Class – Comprehensive classes and online video libraries to enhance the lives of parents, children, and caregivers.
Hospital Art – Promoting patient engagement with
• Incrediball - A journey through Stanford,
• Cafe Mural -Iconic photo-montage of Stanford imagery and
• Eco Mural Animals from various ecosystems throughout California
SpellBound Interactive Mural - This app provides a real life/augmented reality experience of the eco system animals when viewed through the Eco mural located at the main hospital.
Grubhub On-site Food Ordering & Pick-Up – Use Grubhub App you can order food at Harvest Cafe located at Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford
Our Blog – Promotes Patient and Family engagement. We are improving lives every day. Read our stories and ideas for making yours a healthier, happy life.
Patient Health Education – Comprehensive Information on Children’s Health Conditions
Other functionality available within the home app -
• Learn More – Learn more about StanfordChildren’s. org
• Personalize - Settings in the app menu allows the user to customize the apps according to their needs and preferences. The custom settings will enable our users to select only the “Stanford Children’s” apps they need and remove the ones that are not needed as well as re-ordering the apps.
• App Information - shows the user which version of our App they are using, and view our terms of use and privacy policy
• Push Notifications and Geo Fence Capability – this feature enables custom notifications sent to patients and families, reminders from MyChart etc. including greeting when they arrive at a hospital, or a clinic based on the geo location. Our mobile app will detect and send messages when you arrive at Packard Hospital.
Integration with HealthKit allows Stanford Children’s MyChart for iOS to collect data, such as daily steps walked, calorie intake, blood pressure, or blood glucose, from “Health” app and incorporate it into a patient's medical record, providing a more complete picture of the patient's health.

bluejetty:00099147:ios.description:
Hole Drop Puzzle – Slide the Hole, Drop Away Every Block!
Dive into the world of Hole Drop Puzzle, the ultimate hole drop challenge!
As the puzzle master, your mission is to drag and slide holes across the board to guide colorful and numbered blocks into the right spot. Experience the thrill of a true drop puzzle as you plan each move, clear the board, and watch every block drop away in perfect order.
This hole puzzle is made for players who love block puzzles with a satisfying drag and drop twist.
 Hole Drop Gameplay
- Control the Hole, Not the Blocks: Move the hole cube beneath each piece and let gravity do the work. It’s a fresh take on classic drop puzzle mechanics.
- Drop Away with Logic: Plan your moves carefully — one wrong slide and your blocks won’t drop away where they belong.
- Color + Number Puzzles: Enjoy clever color drop challenges where every move tests your brain and timing.
 More Key Features
- Unique Drop Mechanic: Slide, plan, and drop with satisfying drag and drop physics.
- Vibrant Design: Relax with clean, colorful visuals and smooth hole cube animations.

bluejetty:00095106:ios.summary:
CodeWords Cryptogram Puzzles – The Ultimate Word Puzzle Game for Cryptogram Puzzle Lovers!
Prepare to challenge your mind and have fun as you crack cryptograms and solve puzzles! In this exciting word puzzle game, each phrase is encrypte
bluejetty:00095106:ios.description:
CodeWords Cryptogram Puzzles – The Ultimate Word Puzzle Game for Cryptogram Puzzle Lovers!
Prepare to challenge your mind and have fun as you crack cryptograms and solve puzzles! In this exciting word puzzle game, each phrase is encrypted with numbers, and it’s up to you to decode the cryptogram and uncover the hidden message. Sharpen your thinking, test your logic, and enjoy the thrill of solving clever word puzzles in a game designed for all skill levels.
More Than Just a Puzzle – A Journey of Discovery
With every puzzle, you unlock inspirational quotes, famous sayings, famous lyrics, and hidden messages, adding an extra layer of fun and knowledge to your experience. Each completed level brings a sense of achievement as you decode, discover, and learn along the way!
Why You’ll Love This Puzzle Game:
1. Addictive Word Puzzles – Solve thousands of puzzles, each with unique cryptograms that challenge your decoding skills.
2. Engaging Cryptogram Challenges – Every puzzle is a mystery waiting to be unraveled. Can you decrypt the words and reveal the phrase?
3. Fun & Brain-Boosting – Strengthen logic, pattern recognition, and problem-solving skills while having fun.
4. Hints & Smart Assistance – Stuck on a tough cryptogram? Use hints to reveal letters and keep the game going.
5. New Puzzles Regularly – Stay engaged with fresh challenges added frequently.
6. Offline Play Available – No Wi-Fi? No problem! Enjoy this word puzzle game anytime, anywhere.
7. Wisdom Score & Wordsmith Skills – Track your progress as you become a master codebreaker.
8. No-Ads Option – Play distraction-free with an ad-free upgrade for uninterrupted fun.
How to Play This Cryptogram Puzzle Game:
Each puzzle hides a secret message, where letters are replaced with numbers. The challenge lies in deciphering which number corresponds to which letter.
1. Every letter in the phrase is assigned a unique number, like ""9 = E.""
2. Patterns and familiar words create clues to help uncover the hidden text.
3. As more letters are deciphered, the full message begins to emerge.
4. A satisfying moment of discovery awaits when the final letter gets revealed.
A Sneaky Clue for the Curious Decoder!
Start with Common Letters – Look for frequent letters like vowels to get a head start.
Whether you're a cryptogram enthusiast, puzzle solver, or word game lover, CodeWords Cryptogram Puzzles is the perfect game to challenge yourself while enjoying endless hours of fun and learning.
Download "CodeWords Cryptogram Puzzles" today and start decoding your way to fun & victory!

bluejetty:00157124:ios.description:
Take CCV with you wherever you go! Whether you’re at home, the gym, or sitting in service, we’ve placed the tools for staying connected right in the palm of your hand. Take message notes and save them for later, check-in and let us know you’ve joined us, and find upcoming events and classes that are picked just for you.
The addition of the My Family section will keep you up-to-date on what your kids are learning in service each week. You will also find discussion topics for use at home, and resources to help navigate the different stages of parenting.
We’ve also included quick access to resources that will help you continue to grow in your faith. Life Training resources can help you through some of life’s most difficult seasons, a media library with thousands of videos for personal growth and entertainment, and Bible reading plans provide daily encouragement.
The app isn’t only a resource for you. It’s a tool to introduce your friends and family to your church by inviting them to join you for a service or share a favorite message with them.
We hope this app will help you stay connected to your church and community no matter where you are.

bluejetty:00122459:ios.description:
¡Bienvenidos a Móvil APAP! 
Descarga la aplicación móvil de tu Asociación Popular de Ahorros y Préstamos para que estés siempre conectado con tus planes financieros y dispongas de más tiempo para estar cerca de los tuyos, mientras realizas transacciones de manera sencilla en tu celular o tableta. Conoce todo lo que puedes hacer a través de Móvil APAP: 
- Hazte cliente.
- Programa de confianza SOMOS APAP.
- Solicitud de Tarjetas de Crédito, opción disponible para clientes de APAP. Restricciones aplican. 
- Activación de la nueva Débito Digital APAP, opción disponible para clientes con Cuenta de Ahorro Digital. Restricciones aplican. 
- Apertura de Cuenta de Ahorro Digital, opción disponible para clientes de APAP. Restricciones aplican. 
- Acceso rápido mediante pin, huella o reconocimiento facial. 
- Autorización de transacciones a través reconocimiento de huella, facial o con el PIN Mi Llave APAP, 
- Solicita tu acceso a Móvil APAP y APAPenlíne@ a través de la aplicación. 
- Activa o bloquea temporalmente tus Tarjetas de Crédito APAP en caso de que lo necesites. 
- Paga a tiempo tus facturas de servicios, impuestos y recarga tus celulares. 
- Ubica nuestras sucursales, Cajeros APAP y Cajeros de UNARED. 
- Reporta tus viajes para que puedas disfrutarlo tranquilamente. 
- Solicita asesoría o pre-calificación para tus necesidades financieras y recibe asistencia inmediata a través de ChatAPAP. 
- Conoce los Ceritos acumulados en tu Plan de Lealtad y solicita el canje de los mismos para ahorrar más o pagar tus Tarjetas de Crédito APAP.
- Monitorea el progreso de tus metas de ahorro con los gráficos de comportamiento de tus balances al final de cada mes en tus Cuentas de Ahorro APAP. 
- Realiza consumos inteligentes con tus Tarjetas de Crédito APAP, monitoreando tus gastos mensualmente. 
- Revisa tus movimientos y transacciones en todos tus productos APAP. 
- Administra de manera sencilla tu lista de beneficiarios para transacciones financieras. 
- Consulta las tasas de productos y servicios APAP para que puedas elaborar tus planes y metas. 
- Si aún no eres cliente de APAP, puedes realizar solicitud para que te acompañemos en cada uno de tus planes.

bluejetty:00080561:ios.name: TCheckr: Gift Card Manager
bluejetty:00080561:ios.summary: TCheckr is your ultimate solution for managing all your TCN, Ultimate, Vanilla, Coles and Woolworths gift cards in one secure and convenient app. Easily check balances, update card details, and make in-store purchases with just a few taps.
bluejetty:00080561:ios.description:
TCheckr is your ultimate solution for managing all your TCN, Ultimate, Vanilla, Coles and Woolworths gift cards in one secure and convenient app. Easily check balances, update card details, and make in-store purchases with just a few taps. Say goodbye to juggling multiple cards and struggling with balance checks—GiftCard Manager makes it effortless and secure.
******Key Features******
Add and Manage Gift Cards: Effortlessly add and organise your TCN, Ultimate (including ACTIV, Restaurant Choice, Cafe Choice, OnlyOne), Vanilla Giftcards (Vanilla visa card, mastercard and Coles prepaid mastercard), Coles / Kmart, and Woolwoths / Big W / WISH gift cards. Keep all your cards in one place for easy access and management.
Quick Balance Checks: Instantly check and update your gift card balances in a few taps. Stay on top of your gift card balances without hassle.
Scan to Add Coles or Woolworths Gift Cards: Simply scan your Coles or Woolworths gift cards using your phone's camera to add them to the app. No more manual entry—just scan and go!
In-Store Barcode Display: Generate and display barcodes for your Coles or Woolworths gift cards directly in the app. Use the barcodes at the checkout for seamless in-store purchases.
******Privacy and Security******
Your data security is our top priority. All your gift card information is securely stored within the app and is not synced or shared remotely.
For users with heightened security concerns, there's an option to skip entering the PIN or CVV during card setup. However, you will need to enter the PIN or CVV when checking the balance via the gift card issuer's secure webpage.
******Why TCheckr?******
Convenient: Manage all your gift cards in one app.
Secure: Your data stays on your device, ensuring maximum privacy.
User-Friendly: Simple interface and easy-to-use features.
Download TCheckr today and take control of your gift cards like never before!
******Disclaimer******
This app is not affiliated with TCN, Ultimate, Vanilla, Coles or Woolworths. Please use the app responsibly at your own risk.

bluejetty:00016091:ios.description:
100% FREE! DOWNLOAD NOW and start having fun with your favorite solitaire card games!
• Classic (Klondike) • Spider • Double Deck • Pyramid • FreeCell • Forty Thieves • Tri Peaks
• Classic Solitaire mode now has Solvable Deals where every starting deal of cards is guaranteed to be winnable!
• Solvable Deals includes a Hint Button if you get stuck!
• Or you can play Random Deals that may or may not be solvable if you want a traditional solitaire experience!
• Fast and intuitive controls - Just tap on a card or stack and watch as it magically moves where you want it to go!
• You can also drag and drop cards and stacks if you want to!
• Beautiful, easy to read cards!
• No timers at all! Just relax and have fun!
• Unlimited undo support, with no penalties if you want to go back and try things a different way!
• Auto-highlight shows which cards can be moved and which cards are "stuck" under others until you free them up
• Global high score leaderboards with Game Center
• Your progress is automatically saved, all the time, so go ahead and take that call or jump out to any other apps - you can come back and pick up playing right where you left off!
• Sounds can be disabled if you want a quiet game
• You can even listen to your own music while you play
Thanks for playing!
Search for Boy Howdy to see all our free games!

bluejetty:00184560:ios.description:
Change the speed of videos. Make them faster or slower. Download the Video Speed Changer app for free now!
With this app, you can change the speed of videos and adjust the playback speed. Make your videos faster for timelapse, Timewarp, or Hyperlapse effects, or slow videos down and turn them into slow motion. Just open the video in the app and change the video speed in a few simple steps.
The app works with videos recorded on iPhone or iPad, and also with videos from external cameras such as drones, action cams, dash cams, or other cameras. Common video formats like MP4 and MOV can be made faster or slower afterward.
If you recorded a long clip while driving down a road, for example, you can simply speed up that video and create a time-lapse. Or if you have a video of someone that you want to slow down, you can turn it into slow motion later.
If you are wondering how to speed up a video, accelerate a video, slow down a video, turn a normal video into a time-lapse, or change the playback speed of a video on iPhone or iPad, the Video Speed Changer iOS app is made for exactly that.
Tip:
If you want to create a funny video, try this:
Record a video of someone speaking in front of the camera. Slow the playback speed down to 0.5x with the app, and it will sound as if the person is drunk.
A simple slider and preset buttons make it easy for anyone to create slow motion or time-lapse from an existing video. Just open the app, choose a video from your iPhone or iPad, and drag the slider to the right to make it faster or to the left to slow it down. This lets you change the playback speed of your video without using complicated video editing software.
In the editor where you adjust the video speed, there is also a preview feature. You can see the original playback duration of the source video and the new duration after your selected video-speed change.
The finished video is saved without a watermark or logo. The original video resolution is preserved: 1080p videos stay 1080p, and 4K videos stay 4K. This lets you change the speed of your video without reducing its resolution or quality.
Videos are processed securely and privately, only locally on your own device. There is no upload to the cloud or to external servers. This is ideal if you want to edit videos privately and directly on your iPhone or iPad.
The finished changed video can be saved and sent via iMessage, WhatsApp, or other messengers, or shared on social media such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Stories, or Status.
Download the app for free now!

bluejetty:00178209:ios.description:

• FILME

A tabela CHPM 2026, atualizada com as alterações de 2025 e 2026, deverá ser adquirida opcionalmente dentro do aplicativo por um dólar.

Quaisquer dúvidas entre em contato com a OAZEZ que teremos o maior prazer em atendê-los e sanar quaisquer dúvidas!
Obrigado!

bluejetty:00179814:ios.description:
Learning languages has never been so easy! More and more people learn languages with LENGO every day. Join today and be part of our growing community!
LENGO IS FREE TO USE
Our goal is to make education accessible to anyone. Thus, all basic features are permanently free to use. We are continuously extending paid content as well as free content to make LENGO even better.
WHAT TO EXPECT
LENGO equips you with everything you need to learn the language you want. It has been shown that you can significantly reduce the time invested in learning a new language by using instant feedback, recurrent material, and other methodologies that LENGO supports. Another aspect that is likely to improve your learning success is the motivation methods, which are often missing from traditional language-learning methods. However, you still have to bring some initiative.
EXTRA CONTENT? THAT'S PREMIUM
With LENGO Pro, you unlock your full potential. You unlock everything you need to learn languages as quickly and successfully as possible.
ABOUT LENGO
LENGO is a language learning platform that strives to enrich global human interaction by improving people’s ability to communicate.
Privacy policy: https://www.lengo.io/about/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.lengo.io/about/terms
Questions? Contact us:
contact@lengo.io
---------------------------------------------------------------
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription
A subscription is not essential to get access to the full learning materials. You can also gain access by uploading content that adds value to the community. Otherwise, content can be unlocked through in-app-purchases. However, subscriptions are useful for users who want full access without any further action required. The subscribed user does not have to pay attention to our digital currency. Therefore, full access to the app is Lengo Pro.
Each subscription will be automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Your iTunes account will be automatically charged at the same price for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your iTunes Account Settings. When a subscription is canceled, access to the app’s courses and features will expire at the end of the current payment period.

bluejetty:00131095:ios.name: Wingspan: The Board Game
bluejetty:00131095:ios.summary: Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your
bluejetty:00131095:ios.description:
Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. 
You are bird enthusiasts—researchers, bird watchers, ornithologists, and collectors—seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. Each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats. Each habitat focuses on a key aspect of the growth of your preserves.
In Wingspan up to 5 players compete to build up their nature preserves in a limited number of turns. Each beautiful bird that you add to your preserve makes you better at laying eggs, drawing cards, or gathering food. Many of the 170 unique birds have powers that echo real life: your hawks will hunt, your pelicans will fish, and your geese will form a flock.
Features
- Relaxing strategy card game where your goal is to discover and attract the best birds.
- Single player and multiplayer modes for up to five players.
- Based on award winning, competitive, card-driven, engine-building board game.
- Hundreds of unique, animated birds with their real life sound recordings.
- Multiple ways to accumulate points with birds, bonus cards and end-of-round goals.

bluejetty:00042145:ios.description:
Earn accounting CPE credits for listening to podcasts. Earmark is a free, audio-based continuing professional education app for accounting and tax professionals, including CPAs, CMAs, and EAs.
HOW IT WORKS
Earn CPE whenever you want, wherever you go:
1. Choose a course. Complete each learning activity at your own pace.
2. Learn by listening to podcast episodes. Listen while driving to work, working out, doing chores, etc.
3. Confirm you’ve learned the material by taking the short quiz at the end of the course. Score 75% or higher to pass.
4. Email yourself a CPE certificate. Earmark helps by keeping track of all your CPE earned through the app.
CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION FOR ACCOUNTANTS ON THE MOVE
When was the last time you took a free CPE course that taught you something you didn’t already know?
Most CPAs these days prefer to earn CPE from live webcasts. The problem is, we end up picking courses based on what fits our schedules, not what’s most relevant to our professional development needs.
With Earmark CPE, you can earn credits whenever you want, wherever you go. Multitask and be more productive while listening to accounting and tax podcasts. When you’re done listening, complete the handful of quiz questions to access your CPE certificate.
EARN FREE CPE
As a profession, we all benefit when knowledge is shared. That’s why Earmark offers all of our users free credits to use on courses each week.
UNCHAIN FROM YOUR DESK
With the rise of remote and hybrid work, we’re spending more time in front of our computers than ever before. Get out from behind your desk and learn while you listen to podcasts on our mobile app.
STOP STRESSING ABOUT GETTING CPE
By using our mobile app every week for free, you’ll be sure to earn enough CPE credits to make your license renewal a breeze. Say goodbye to the pain of cramming in courses at the last minute.
LEARN SOMETHING NEW
Let’s be honest. Most free CPE courses aren’t that great. We aim to change that with a growing library of educational, entertaining, and on-demand accounting and tax podcasts — so you can actually learn something new while you check that CPE box.
HELP US IMPROVE
Report any bugs to support@earmarkcpe.com. Also, let us know what you think and what we should build next!
Terms of use: https://earmarkcpe.com/terms

bluejetty:00013844:ios.name: Bank of Palestine
bluejetty:00013844:ios.summary: Bank of Palestine provides the Mobile Banking services to its customers to enable them to communicate with the Bank, manage their accounts, and execute various banking services through their portable devices, including smartphones and table
bluejetty:00013844:ios.description:
Bank of Palestine provides the Mobile Banking services to its customers to enable them to communicate with the Bank, manage their accounts, and execute various banking services through their portable devices, including smartphones and tablets, operating without the need to visit the Bank or one of its branches.
Services currently provided by the Bank through this service:
1. Self-registration using only your debit card information.
2. Inquire about account balance and details.
3. Inquire about the cards’ balance.
4. Settle credit card account.
5. Add balance to credit cards.
6. Stop a card if stolen.
7. Change your debit card's main account.
8. Transfer between the customer accounts.
9. Transfer to other accounts within the bank or internationally(must pre-define the accounts you wish to transfer to through the Online Banking service).
10. Pay bills for various services (mobile phone, electricity, university, etc.)
11. Pay to Friend within Bank of Palestine Group (Bank of Palestine - Arab Islamic Bank - PalPay Wallet), which is a service to transfer small payments for beneficiaries through their mobile phone numbers registered at the bank (without prior definition).
12. Check AlWasata Portfolio through the app.
13. Check and manage the new loyalty program PointCom.
14. Ana Ow Shatarti campaign. 
15. Subscribe in the BOP saving campaign “Tawfeerkom”.
16. Transfer Loyalty Points to Cash in PointCom campaign. 
17. Top-up the PalPay wallet (Mahfazati).
18. Pay to merchant.
19. Accounts Management ( Add - Close - Activate)
20. Become a BOP customer.
21. New Manage Beneficiaries screens.
22. Delete account/subscription option.
23. Facilities Follow Up
24. iBURAQ service to instantly transfer money in Palestine to any bank using an IBAN or Alias, or to wallets using a mobile number.

bluejetty:00023868:ios.description:
Coordinate global meetings, calls, and events without the timezone math. Standard world clocks only tell you what time it is right now. World Calendar goes further: it’s a powerful timezone converter and international meeting planner that lets you look into the future to find the perfect time for everyone.
Whether you are scheduling a global team sync, planning an international trip, or calling family overseas, World Calendar integrates directly with your iOS Calendar to make cross-timezone scheduling effortless.
CROSS-TIMEZONE SCHEDULING
Compare multiple timezones side-by-side to instantly pinpoint the ideal meeting time. Tap anywhere to set a target time, and tap twice to seamlessly create an event directly in your calendar.
VIEW YOUR CALENDAR IN MULTIPLE TIMEZONES
World Calendar displays your existing events across all your selected timezones. Create, edit, and share events with a single tap, ensuring your global schedule is always perfectly aligned.
KEY FEATURES:
• Time Travel: Scroll into the future to plan days, weeks, or months ahead.
• No Limits: Add and compare as many timezones as you need.
• Day/Night Indicators: Instantly see if your contact is awake or asleep.
• Home Screen Widget: Check your favorite timezones at a glance without unlocking your device.
• Watch Widget and App: Put your recently selected timezones on your wrist
• Easy Search: Find locations by city name, timezone abbreviation (e.g., EST, GMT), or UTC offset.
• Global Sharing: Send event invites to other users that automatically adapt to their local timezone.
• DST Accuracy: Fully automatic adjustments for daylight saving time changes globally.
• Nautical Time Zones: Full support for standard UTC offsets without DST adjustments.
• Landscape View: Turn your device for a wider, comprehensive timeline view.

bluejetty:00075504:ios.description:
EL CANAL OFICIAL DEL HINCHA ECUATORIANO
Vive el fútbol como se siente en Ecuador: con pasión, identidad y en vivo.
Disfruta de los partidos de la Selección Ecuatoriana, las Eliminatorias Sudamericanas y los mejores torneos nacionales e internacionales desde un solo lugar. En El Canal del Fútbol reunimos la emoción de La Tri, el fútbol ecuatoriano y grandes competencias como la Copa del Rey, el Brasileirão, la Copa de Portugal, la Superliga Femenina y mucho más.
Con tu suscripción mensual accedes a una experiencia deportiva completa, con más de 100 partidos transmitidos cada mes, contenido exclusivo y cobertura pensada para el hincha que vive el fútbol dentro y fuera de la cancha.
También podrás disfrutar de eventos oficiales de la FEF, incluyendo fútbol sala, fútbol playa, fútbol femenino y otras disciplinas que llevan la bandera ecuatoriana al corazón de cada partido.
En la app encontrarás:
Partidos en vivo
Mira tus eventos favoritos cuando y donde quieras.
Resúmenes y goles al instante
Revive las mejores jugadas, goles y momentos clave.
Noticias actualizadas
Mantente informado con novedades del fútbol nacional e internacional.
Estadísticas y clasificaciones
Consulta datos, posiciones y rendimiento de los equipos en tiempo real.
Archivo de la Selección
Accede a contenido histórico y revive grandes momentos de La Tri.
El fútbol ecuatoriano tiene una casa.
Y esa casa está en tu bolsillo.
El Canal del Fútbol: EL CANAL OFICIAL DEL HINCHA ECUATORIANO.

Welcome to Rebeca’s BRAND NEW beauty salon! Will you help her make her way to the TOP in this amazing time management game? Come and meet Taylor, this HOT SHOT fashion EXPERT that will guide you and Rebeca in your way to owning the GREATEST beauty salon in town!

With a little help from Taylor, be AS FAST and AS TALENTED as you can so all your customers will be PRETTY and SATISFIED! In your salon, only the most meticulous and greatest services will be offered: from AMAZING nail polish to FLAWLESS hair dye, you will use impeccable equipment as hair straightener and roller!

HIGHLIGHTS
• Upgrade your salon as your customers PAY YOU for the great job
• Make every client happy by serving them FAST and GOOD
• Face challenging levels that get more and more complex
• Buy improved equipment and make your your salon is the best!

Will you leave Rebeca by herself? Show all your energy in creating BEAUTY! Come and play!

Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00127224:ios.summary:

Download our car racing game Racing Ferocity RF3D now and prove your car racing sk
bluejetty:00127224:ios.description:
Are you ready to unleash your inner racer and conquer the race tracks like a champion? 
Do you have what it takes to beat the clock and set new lap records?
Download our car racing game Racing Ferocity RF3D now and prove your car racing skills!
Feel the adrenaline rush as you speed through the tracks with stunning graphics and intense gameplay that will keep you engaged. Whether you're a passionate racer or just looking for some thrilling fun, this game has everything you need. Start your engines and get ready to show off your car racing skills and conquer the race tracks!
Game Modes
RACE MODE: Choose your favourite racing car from a wide range of sports cars and compete against other racers in Race Mode. Cross the finish line first and be the ultimate race master.
TIME TRIAL: Push your car racing limits and complete the track as fast as possible in Time Trial Mode. Race against the clock and beat your own lap records.
CHALLENGE MODE: Test your car driving skills on endless tracks and complete various racing challenges. Unlock special cars and earn rewards as you progress in the car racing game.
POLICE CHASE: Experience the thrill of being on both sides of the law in Police Chase mode. Escape the police chase as you race through city streets. Avoid collisions with other cars to outrun the police.
TRAFFIC RUSH: Navigate through busy traffic and overcome the chaos in Traffic Rush mode. Your goal is to race against the clock, drifting through tight spaces, avoiding collisions and reaching the finish line before time runs out. 
Features
- Stunning 3D graphics and high quality sound effects
- Wide range of high performance cars, ranging from sports cars to lightning-fast Formula One cars
- Beautiful 3D racing games environments
- Intense head-to-head races and challenging missions
- Intuitive and responsive controls
- Regular updates and new content to keep the game exciting
Ready to take your racing skills to the next level? Download Racing Ferocity RF3D now and embark on an unforgettable racing adventure.

bluejetty:00043916:ios.description:
Trust Money – Safe. Simple. Smart.
Trust Money is the official digital banking app of Trust Bank PLC, designed to offer a secure, seamless, and convenient banking experience anytime, anywhere. With a modern interface and powerful features, Trust Money puts complete control of your finances right in your hands.
Whether you’re managing daily transactions or accessing essential banking services, Trust Money ensures everything is just a few taps away.
What is Trust Money?
Trust Money is a comprehensive digital banking platform that allows you to manage your accounts, transfer funds, pay bills, and access banking services without visiting a branch. It also offers a web-based module (Trust Money Web) for those who prefer desktop banking.
Key Features:
Modern User Interface – Clean, intuitive, and easy to navigate
Account Management – Check balances and view transaction history
Fund Transfers – Transfer money within Trust Bank and to other banks
Utility Bill Payments – Pay electricity, WASA, and gas bills instantly
Debit & Credit Card Management – Monitor and manage your cards
Trust Money Web (iBanking) – Access banking services via web browser
Enhanced Security – Secure transactions with advanced safety features including Transaction PIN
Real-Time Alerts – Stay updated with instant notifications
Certificates & Service Requests – Access and download bank certificates (rolling out)
Tuition Fee Payments – Pay school and college fees (coming soon)
Why Trust Money?
Banking today is all about convenience. Trust Money is designed to simplify your financial life by offering fast, secure, and user-friendly digital services—so you can bank anytime, from anywhere.
Download Trust Money today and experience banking that is truly Safe. Simple. Smart.

Shuttle cargo: a range of lethal weapons, from axes and chainsaws to blasters and BFGs. Anything might come in handy in Plutonia, the Federation's most remote colony.
Scientists, miners, guards – all sorts of civilian personnel worked there until recently. A week ago, the Center received a mayday signal from the settlement. Demonic roars and screams of terror filled the comm channel, and then it fell dead silent.
It's time to descend into the infernal abyss and show the demons who's the boss here. Fight your way through all the circles of hell to reach the very bottom. Look cosmic evil in the face and emerge victorious.

- Full range of weapons

bluejetty:00082004:ios.description:
Introducing Solaris VPN – Your Ultimate Solution for Secure and Private Internet Access
Solaris VPN is designed to protect your online privacy and security with ease. By changing your real IP address and location, encrypting your internet traffic, and ensuring your anonymity, Solaris VPN provides a safer and more secure browsing experience. Whether you’re shopping online, using public Wi-Fi, or simply browsing the web, you can rest assured that your data is fully protected.
Key Features:
Multiple Locations: Choose from a wide range of server locations to find the one that best suits your needs. With just a click of the "+" button at the top-right corner of the screen, you can easily switch to your preferred location.
Safe and Secure Browsing: Solaris VPN encrypts all your internet traffic, ensuring that your personal data remains confidential, even when using public Wi-Fi networks at cafes, airports, or hotels. This added layer of security keeps your online activities private and safe from potential threats.
Easy to Use: Connecting to Solaris VPN is as simple as flipping a switch. With a user-friendly interface, you can enable or disable the VPN with just one click.
Improved Online Gaming Experience: Solaris VPN can help reduce lag and provide a more stable connection for online gaming, giving you a smoother and more enjoyable experience.
Public Wi-Fi Security: Public Wi-Fi networks often lack proper security, making your data vulnerable. With Solaris VPN, your data is encrypted, safeguarding you from potential threats and ensuring that your online activities remain private.
Why Choose Solaris VPN?
Complete Anonymity: Keep your personal data safe from prying eyes. Solaris VPN ensures that your online activities are completely anonymous.
Strong Protection: Protect yourself from cyber threats and avoid monitoring by internet service providers.
No-Logs Policy: We strictly adhere to a no-logs policy, meaning we don’t track, store, or share your browsing history.
Private Location: Your physical location remains hidden, keeping your privacy intact from third parties.
Fast and Reliable Connection: Enjoy exceptional connection speeds, allowing for faster and smoother browsing.
Subscription Options:
Choose from flexible subscription plans: monthly, weekly, or yearly.
Payments will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.

Todos los servicios que necesitas: ¡Viaja en carro, moto o bus! Realiza envíos de paquetes y cuenta con asistencia vial, todo en una sola app. 
 ¡La app de movilidad con más beneficios! 
Paga como gustes: Selecciona el método de pago de tu preferencia; Yummy Rides te ofrece una amplia gama de opciones para tu conveniencia. 
¿Tienes más de un destino?: puedes añadir hasta 4 paradas a tu ruta. 
Sé parte del club más exclusivo: Únete a Yummy Club para recibir beneficios y descuentos increíbles.
Agenda tus próximos viajes: Mantén tu semana en orden al agendar viajes con hasta 3 días de antelación.

Pide Delivery ¡sin salir del app!: explora Yummy Delivery, ahora desde Yummy Rides. Agiliza tu día; ordena tu comida a casa mientras estés en camino.
Seguridad 24/7: Todos tus viajes en Yummy Rides cuentan con cobertura de accidentes, para que viajes tranquilo ya sea en moto o en carro. 
Envía lo que quieras, cuando quieras: ¿Necesitas enviar un paquete? ¡Mandaditos es la solución! Realiza envíos rápidos y seguros en moto, carro o camioneta. 
Tu mejor opción como conductor: 
Sé el dueño de tu tiempo: Trabaja cuando quieras, y donde quieras. Yummy Rides está disponible en más de 20 ciudades del país. 
Máxima rentabilidad: Entérate de cuáles son las zonas de alta demanda con nuestras herramientas exclusivas. Aprovecha cada minuto de tu día. 
Sube tu nivel con cada viaje: Desbloquearás recompensas especiales entre más viajes completes.
Saca el mayor provecho con Yummy Retos: completa los desafíos disponibles y recibe premios por ellos. ¡Comparte tus resultados con tus colegas Yummers y demuestra que eres el mejor!
Ten el control de tu tiempo; organiza tu semana de trabajo: Tendrás acceso a una lista de viajes disponibles para completar durante la semana. Acepta los que más te convengan y comienza a ganar. 
Siempre a tu lado: Nuestra flota está disponible las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana. ¡Solicita tu viaje y llega a tu destino en minutos!
¿Qué esperas para unirte a la comunidad Yummy Rides? Descarga la app ahora y disfruta de una experiencia de movilidad ÚNICA.

¿Necesitas un viaje rápido y seguro? ¿O prefieres generar ingresos mientras conduces por tu ciudad? ¡Yummy Rides es la app que necesitas! 
La app de transporte #1 de Venezuela: Con presencia en más de 20 ciudades y disponible los 365 días del año, Yummy Rides te conecta con la mayor red de conductores en el país. ¡En donde estés, Yummy te lleva! 
Dos apps en una: ¿Necesitas movilizarte? Escoge el modo Pasajero y solicita el viaje de tu preferencia. ¿Quieres generar ingresos? Selecciona el modo Conductor y aplica a través de la app. 
Todos los servicios que necesitas: ¡Viaja en carro, moto o bus! Realiza envíos de paquetes y cuenta con asistencia vial, todo en una sola app. 
 ¡La app de movilidad con más beneficios! 
Paga como gustes: Selecciona el método de pago de tu preferencia; Yummy Rides te ofrece una amplia gama de opciones para tu conveniencia. 
¿Tienes más de un destino?: puedes añadir hasta 4 paradas a tu ruta. 
Sé parte del club más exclusivo: Únete a Yummy Club para recibir beneficios y descuentos increíbles.
Agenda tus próximos viajes: Mantén tu semana en orden al agendar viajes con hasta 3 días de antelación. 
Viaja hoy, paga después: ¡ahora puedes pagar tus viajes en cuotas con Cashea! (solo para miembros de Yummy Club)
Pide Delivery ¡sin salir del app!: explora Yummy Delivery, ahora desde Yummy Rides. Agiliza tu día; ordena tu comida a casa mientras estés en camino.
Seguridad 24/7: Todos tus viajes en Yummy Rides cuentan con cobertura de accidentes, para que viajes tranquilo ya sea en moto o en carro. 
Envía lo que quieras, cuando quieras: ¿Necesitas enviar un paquete? ¡Mandaditos es la solución! Realiza envíos rápidos y seguros en moto, carro o camioneta. 
Tu mejor opción como conductor: 

Sé el dueño de tu tiempo: Trabaja cuando quieras, y donde quieras. Yummy Rides está disponible en más de 20 ciudades del país. 
Máxima rentabilidad: Entérate de cuáles son las zonas de alta demanda con nuestras herramientas exclusivas. Aprovecha cada minuto de tu día.  
Sube tu nivel con cada viaje: Desbloquearás recompensas especiales entre más viajes completes.
Saca el mayor provecho con Yummy Retos: completa los desafíos disponibles y recibe premios por ellos. ¡Comparte tus resultados con tus colegas Yummers y demuestra que eres el mejor!
Ten el control de tu tiempo; organiza tu semana de trabajo: Tendrás acceso a una lista de viajes disponibles para completar durante la semana. Acepta los que más te convengan y comienza a ganar. 
Siempre a tu lado: Nuestra flota está disponible las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana. ¡Solicita tu viaje y llega a tu destino en minutos!
¿Qué esperas para unirte a la comunidad Yummy Rides? Descarga la app ahora y disfruta de una experiencia de movilidad ÚNICA.

bluejetty:00198428:android.summary:
★ Winner of “Excellence in Gameplay” Award in IMGA SEA 2017 ★

bluejetty:00198428:android.description:
★ Winner of “Excellence in Gameplay” Award in IMGA SEA 2017 ★
Alien Path combines RPG, Puzzle, Path-Planning and Strategy for an out-of-this-world gaming experience. Players must eliminate enemies by cleverly navigating the aliens on a path to destroy the invading robots. Every move counts, so set a path and pave your way to rescuing your planet and eventually the galaxy.
Travel from planet to planet as you face of the invading Robots who are hell-bent on destroying all living civilization. Hatch new ascended Aliens, discover legendary powers and set your self on a path of robot destruction - all life in the universe is counting on you!
Features
• Unique Gameplay : A completely fresh, never before seen RPG Puzzle game
• Hatch New Aliens : 16 different Aliens to hatch and upgrade, each with unique strengths
• Power Cards : Collect over 100 Alien Power cards with thousands of skill combinations
• Card Evolution : Break the upgrade limit and further strengthen your cards with runes!
• Everchanging Levels : More than 300 levels with unique enemies, obstacles and power-ups to challenge your strategy!
• Mind Blowing Strategy: Limitless battle tactics to employ with hundreds of passive and active skills
• Character customization: Multiple ways to develop your Aliens and Power Cards
• Guild System : Join a guild to earn exclusive Bolts to upgrade cards, share decks and compete in weekly world rankings!
• Face fearsome Giant Boss Robots and against their numerous Robot Tech
• A Whole New Dimension: Unlock Parallel Planets take your battles to the next level
• Fresh Challenges: Participate in special daily events and unique planets with set rules and challenges
• Friends Spirit : Lend a helping hand to friends with Spirit to explore the whole galaxy
If you face any technical issues on your device, please contact us and we will try to address the issue as soon as possible.
Support Email : support@appxplore.com
For latest news, updates, and events, follow us on:
Facebook : http://www.facebook.com/alienpath
Youtube : http://www.youtube.com/user/appxplore
Instagram : http://www.instagram.com/appxplore
Twitter : http://twitter.com/appxplore

bluejetty:00063799:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Shreveport area with the News Radio 710 KEEL app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from News Radio 710 KEEL Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the News Radio 710 KEEL app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the News Radio 710 KEEL app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00031887:ios.name: Coachly: 1-on-1 Sport Coaching
bluejetty:00031887:ios.summary:
THE ALL-IN-ONE COACHING PLATFORM
Coachly connects athletes across the globe with vetted sports coaches for online & in-person lessons—while giving coaches every tool needed to run and scale their entire business from one app. 
FOR COACHES
bluejetty:00031887:ios.description:
THE ALL-IN-ONE COACHING PLATFORM
Coachly connects athletes across the globe with vetted sports coaches for online & in-person lessons—while giving coaches every tool needed to run and scale their entire business from one app. 
FOR COACHES
 • Pro-grade video analysis tools, client chat & video file management
 • FREE to list and sell your lessons—Coachly takes no percentage of your revenue
 • 0% platform fees —keep 97% (only 3% bank fee via Stripe)
 • Auto-scheduling, automated lesson reminders & instant payouts
 • NEW Business Insights: live revenue, payout tracking, and client trends.
 • Offer one-off lessons or monthly subscription packages with 1-tap checkout.
 • Get found online with an optional public profile.
 • Customize your profile to perfectly match your brand.
 • Create your own prices and lesson packages. Your business, your way. 
FOR ATHLETES & PARENTS
 • Find background-checked coaches with verified client reviews in seconds.
 • Cancel one-off lesson requests or monthly subscriptions in seconds. Zero risk. 
 • Book local in-person sessions, live video calls, or send footage for professional breakdowns.
 • Secure Apple Pay & card payments and transparent pricing—no surprises or price negotiations.
 • All coach feedback—video breakdowns, drills, live call sessions—saved in your personal library.
 • Free access to our best-in-class video analysis and file management tools.
 • Track progress, build confidence.
SPORTS WE SUPPORT
American Football • Archery • Badminton • Baseball • Basketball • Boxing • Climbing • Cricket • Cycling • Equestrian Sports • Field Hockey • Golf • Gymnastics • Ice Hockey • Martial Arts • Motocross • Paddling • Pickleball • Rugby • Ski • Soccer • Softball • Swimming • Table Tennis • Tennis • Track and Field • Volleyball • Weightlifting • Wrestling
And we’re adding more all the time!
WHY COACHES SWITCH
Old way: Use 5 different apps for chat and onboarding, video file-share, video analysis or live calls, scheduling, payments, and all business tracking.
New way: Coachly automates everything—one login, zero headaches.
LESSON TYPES
 1. Analysis – Send clips; receive telestrated, coach face or voice overlayed feedback.
 2. Full Remote – Analysis + custom drills, demo videos & homework.
 3. Live Call – Real-time video call session
 4. In-Person – Book local training; Coachly handles requests & payments.
 5. Chat Subscription – Customized online or hybrid coaching programs done through chat.
COACH OPTIONS & SUBSCRIPTIONS
There are optional subscription options for both athletes and coaches to consider.
Athletes may opt to purchase a monthly lesson or program subscription from a coach of their choosing. This rate will be set by their chosen coach.
There are 2 different account options for coaches. 
1. Video Coach (Pro) – For sports coaches who just want:
 • Unlimited Video Analysis  Tools
 • Text + Video + Link Client Chat 
 • 1TB (near unlimited) Video Gallery Storage
 • Work with 240fps Videos
 • Custom Gallery Folders
 • Invite Clients Via Unique Link
And who do not mind:
 • No Payment Acceptance 
 • No Live Calls  
 • No Automated Admin  
 • No Lesson Packages 
 • No Public Profile Page
2. All-In-One Coach (FREE) – For sports coaches who want:
 • Access to Athletes Around The World  
 • Unlimited Video Analysis 
 • Text-Only Client Chat 
 • Accept & Track Client Payments
 • Offer Video Call Lessons  
 • Automated Admin System  
 • Create Custom Lesson Packages
 • Public Webpage For Your Services  
 • 30GB Video Gallery Storage  
 • Export 5 Gallery Videos per Week
 • Invite Clients Via Unique Link
 • Professional Business Analytics
Trusted & Secure
 • Payments + fraud protection powered by Stripe
 • Background checks on all new coaches
 • 24/7 in-app support
Privacy Policy: https://coach.ly/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://coach.ly/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00116053:ios.description:
Renovamos la app para que viajar sea más fácil que nunca!
Ahora con un nuevo look, pensado para que compres tus pasajes de micro desde la comodidad de tu casa.
Descargá la app y conocé la mejor forma de viajar en micro.
Accedé a miles de destinos nacionales e internacionales, con la confianza de siempre y una experiencia totalmente renovada desde tu celular.
Qué podés hacer desde la nueva app?
- Comprar tus pasajes en minutos, sin vueltas ni registro obligatorio.
- Viajar mostrando el pasaje desde tu celular, sin necesidad de imprimirlo.
- Organizar todos tus viajes desde un mismo lugar.
Cómo comprar en la app?
- Buscá tus pasajes de micro: elegí origen, destino, fecha y cantidad de pasajeros.
- Compará opciones: mirá precios, horarios y empresas disponibles en un solo lugar.
- Comprá fácil y seguro: tenemos múltiples medios de pago.
Recordá siempre llevar tu DNI el día del viaje!
Por qué elegirnos?
- Pagá como quieras: tarjeta de crédito, débito, Mercado Pago, MODO y muchas opciones más.
- Accedé a cuotas sin interés, promociones bancarias y descuentos en la app.
- Atención personalizada antes, durante y después de tu viaje.
Contamos con más de 20 años de experiencia y confianza. Conectamos a más de 20.000 destinos en Argentina y otros países como Brasil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay y Perú.
Trabajamos con las principales empresas del país: Andesmar, Plusmar, Vía Tac, El Rápido, Tramat, La Veloz del Norte, Balut, 20 de Junio, CATA Internacional, Crucero del Norte, y muchas más.
Instalá la app y viajá en bus de forma cómoda y segura. Más de 20 años en el camino, ahora también desde tu celular.
Plataforma 10: Somos compañeros de ruta

bluejetty:00095275:ios.description:
Have fun with your dog like never before!

How it works:
Record your dog’s bark, and our AI analyzes key acoustic features like frequency, pitch, intensity, tempo, and silence patterns. Based on these traits, it estimates the most likely emotion your dog might be expressing and turns it into a fun, fictional message from your dog’s perspective.
Disclaimer: This is a fun simulation app. While the emotional interpretations are powered by real audio analysis, results are for entertainment purposes only.
App Features:
- AI BARK INTERPRETER:
Analyze your dog’s bark in real time! Our AI processes each bark and matches it to an emotional category (like playful or alert), then generates a fun, fictional message from your dog’s “voice".
- AI DOG RECOGNIZER:
Take a photo of your dog and discover its likely breed mix, along with interesting facts, full details and personality insights for each breed detected
- DOG WHISTLE:
Use a high-frequency whistle to support basic training, grab your dog’s attention, or interrupt unwanted behavior.
- SQUEAKY SOUNDS & MORE:
Play realistic squeaky toy noises and other sound effects your dog will love. Great for playtime or quick redirection.
CLICKER TRAINING:
Choose from multiple clicker sounds to assist with positive reinforcement training. A proven way to build habits, reward good behavior, and teach new tricks.
DOG TRAINING VIDEOS:
Browse a growing library of dog training tutorials and guides to strengthen your bond and improve your dog’s behavior.
Download now to enjoy it all!

bluejetty:00087343:ios.description:
Float your script anywhere — now with 4K, Voice-Follow, and full rotation.
FloatText is a teleprompter that floats your script over any app, follows your voice as you speak, and records sharp video. Version 4.0 adds Script Challenge: read a script aloud, get scored, and level up.
TELEPROMPTER & RECORDING
• Floating Prompter — keep your script on screen over other apps with picture in picture, and place it where you want.
• Voice Follow — the script scrolls as you speak. Choose Classic or Adaptive read-along.
• Auto Scroll — set your speed; guide-line and highlight modes for easier reading.
• Portrait & Landscape — the prompter rotates with you.
• Full-Screen Prompter — focus on your script with nothing else on screen.
• Style It Your Way — font size, colours, alignment, line spacing, background opacity and a countdown.
• 4K Recording — with the script right under the camera while you record.
• Scripts & Recordings — save, reuse and organise your scripts and videos in the app.
WHO IT’S FOR
• YouTube creators and vloggers
• TikTok and short-video creators
• Streamers and presenters
• Teachers and online course creators
• Mobile journalists and reporters
• Marketers and content teams
• Anyone practising clear, confident speaking
Challenge scoring uses on-device speech recognition and requires iOS 26 or later. On earlier versions you can still read and record challenges for practice.
Have ideas or feedback? Email: app@floattext.com

bluejetty:00148538:ios.description:
Park easily and find the best parking deals in New York with the iPark iPhone app. Whether you’re searching for parking near your office or home, exploring the city, or need parking close to JFK, you can conveniently reserve your spot with the iPark app. 
iPark gives you access to hundreds of garages, lots, and valets throughout New York (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island and The Bronx).
How iPark works:
1. Enter the dates and times you need parking. Enter your destination’s address or landmark to see available spots nearby.
2. Compare parking garages and rates near your destination.
3. Pre-pay to reserve your spot and enjoy quick access to your reservation information.
4. Follow the directions to the garage provided through your mobile parking pass to your selected garage, easily enter the garage or lot and park in seconds!
App Features:
• Compare pricing for over 130 garages
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to three cars in your account
• Earn points for reservations in your account
• Book reservations across multiple days and access easy rebook functions
• Turn-by-turn directions to the parking garage where you reserved your spot
Have a question? Our team is ready to help you!
Call us at 855-482-7569 or email info@ipark.com
Find us at:
iPark.com: https://ipark.com

bluejetty:00160186:ios.description:
Pass Your ISA Certified Arborist Exam with Confidence
ISA Flashcards is a comprehensive study tool designed specifically for arborists and aspiring ISA Certified Arborists. Whether you’re preparing for the multiple-choice portion of the exam or simply reinforcing your arboriculture knowledge, this app offers expertly curated flashcards covering all key exam topics.
Features
- Over 3000 ISA exam questions based on real multiple-choice tests
- 600+ ISA specific glossary terms to practice
- Covers tree biology, pruning, safety, soil management, and more
- Smart progress tracking to identify weak areas and optimize study efforts
- Shuffle and Wrong Answer modes for improved retention
- Offline access to study anywhere, anytime
- Premium access to unlock full content with one simple subscription
- Ideal for ISA exam candidates, arborists, and tree care professionals, ISA Flashcards provides a structured and effective way to prepare for the ISA Certified Arborist exam.
Why Choose ISA Flashcards?
- Exam-ready questions aligned with ISA standards
- A focused and distraction-free learning experience
- Regular updates to ensure the latest certification guidelines are covered
Master the material needed to pass your ISA Certified Arborist exam with our targeted approach. This app is the ultimate ISA Exam Prep solution, built to help you succeed on the official ISA Exam. Don't leave your certification to chance. Our 2500+ questions cover every topic you'll face on the ISA Test, making it the most comprehensive and focused study tool available for arborists.
Whether you're a veteran professional refreshing your knowledge or facing the big Tree Test for the first time, our platform is your key to becoming a Certified Arborist. Move beyond static study guides and engage with a dynamic flashcard system designed for active recall and long-term retention.- The leading flashcards resource for the Certified Arborist exam administered by the ISA (The International Society of Arboriculture).
Study every ISA exam domain in depth, including tree biology, soil management, pruning, diagnosis and treatment, tree risk assessment, safe work practices, installation and establishment, identification and selection, trees and construction, and urban forestry. This arborist exam prep app lets you drill into specific categories or mix everything together so you are ready for any Certified Arborist test question on the official ISA arborist exam.
This mobile app is not affiliated with the ISA (The International Society of Arboriculture), nor the official Certified Arborist Test, but it is a mock exam, flashcard tool and study material for this arborist exam.
Download now and take the first step toward becoming a certified ISA Arborist!

bluejetty:00081571:ios.summary:
