The
bluejetty:00081571:ios.description:
Welcome to the tribe of LesBeSocial and a brand new more social way to meet lesbian friends from all around the world! LesBeSocial is the best and most popular social network app for gay, bisexual and queer women and non-binary people.
The app is fast and easy to use. Sign up with just one few clicks and become part of our huge worldwide LGBTQ community.
FEATURES
- MEMBERS. Search, find and follow new LGBT+ friends from all over the world.
- GAY MAP. Quickly get an overview of members, groups, posts and events in your city and country. Pick an activity and show yourself on the map to meet queer women near you. Easily change country and city to get your perfect travel guide for everything lesbian.
- THE RAINBOW GAME. Take a daily challenge to rise in the top list.
- EVENTS. Find, create and join LGBTQ events of your interest to meet new gay women.
- GROUPS. Join a group to connect with lesbians sharing the same interests, location, occupation etc.
- PAGES. Follow posts and event updates from your favorite queer clubs, bars, bloggers, organizations, musicians, actors, pride festivals etc.
- LGBT RIGHTS. Read news and learn about the gay rights history and current situation in different countries.
- COMING OUT STORIES. Get inspired in our come out group and post your unique coming out story to your profile to make it more personal.
- MESSAGES. Find online members for unlimited free instant chat.
- PUSH NOTIFICATIONS. Enable push and email notifications to make sure you never miss a message or event invitation.
We are an independent lesbian owned and operated company and our primary mission is to build and strengthen our amazing gay, bisexual and queer women community by creating a safe digital and physical space for lesbians to come together and interact, advocating for gay rights and support others who share our vision and mission.
All of our core features are completely free but if you want to help us grow and support our mission please purchase a premium subscription. It will give you more features and fun including:
* Change location to meet members in other cities.
* Go invisible to visit other members profiles without them knowing it.
* Get read receipts to see see if someone read your message.
* Forever ad free experience.
* Add more photos to your profile to show all your good sides.
* Find your favorite people with more search filters.
We offer 4 types of subscriptions:
1 Week: starting at $4.99
1 Month: starting at $12.99
3 Months: starting at $29.99
12 Months: starting at $99.99
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off in the iTunes Store at least 24hrs before the end of the current period. Prices above are in USD and may vary in countries other than the United States and are subject to change without notice. More details can be found at https://lesbesocial.com/terms
We really want to know what you need in order to make it easier for you to connect with other LGBT+ women and we work hard every day to add new functionality to give you the very best social network experience. If you have any ideas, feedback or problems with the app please send us a message or connect with us on social media:
* Email: hello@lesbesocial.com
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lesbesocial/
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/lesbesocial
* Twitter: https://twitter.com/lesbesocial
* Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/lesbesocial
This is an app for LGBT+ women and non-binary people and we ask everyone kindly to respect that. In order to join we will ask you to upload a clear profile picture of yourself and for your safety we review all profiles to make sure the people you connect with are genuine. If you find a suspicious profile, please report it to us! If you are a LGBT+ man please feel more than welcome to download our ComeOut app instead.
Thanks and lots of love!
Jenny @ Team LesBeSocial.

Welcome to the Ultimate AI-Powered Car Tuning & Customization Studio.
Mody AI is an advanced AI car modification app built for car enthusiasts, tuners, and designers. Download Mody AI today and bring your dream builds to life.

Our mystery games welcome you into a story. It’s Halloween, and your dad has invited you to celebrate with him in your hometown. You are to going to have a great time together, playing hidden objects games, looking for hidden artifacts and trick-or-treating! It’s up to you to play Halloween games to delve into your family’s secret history and stop the evil monsters. Do you have what it takes to save the town from a terrible fate before it’s too late? · NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Be always sure of your next move while enjoying investigation games! A handy Strategy Guide will always help you if you ever get stuck.

CONTROL A BALL
Tap on the screen to roll the ball quickly or balance it carefully traveling through a level. Improve your attention & reaction to finish all the challenging levels on the first try.
OVERCOME OBSTACLES
The more levels you complete, the harder roads you should travel. Ramps, pendulums, trampolines, hammers, and tons of other barriers you should overcome on your way to finish. Don’t let anything knock your rolling ball out of the road!
DON’T WASTE YOUR LIVES
Remember, the ball game doesn't save your progress on the level automatically unless you have spare lives. Play carefully, or you’ll start a level again.

Want to finish the ball race faster? Collect different bonuses along the road to become bigger & stronger! Take every advantage from the boosters to finish all the ball game levels!

- Realistic physics
- Beautiful 3D graphics
- ASMR game experience
- Rolling ball adventure
- Dozens of cool ball skins
- Simple controls
Are you ready for the challenging ball race? Prove your skills and make your ball roll through all the obstacles safe and sound! Play Rollace and have lots of fun in one of the most addicting rolling ball games now!

Do you love fun ball games with realistic physics & tons of obstacles? Join Rollance, the addicting ball race where you should roll the ball through unexpected barriers to finish. Master the ball control and collect the maximum game points to complete all levels like a boss!

CONTROL A BALL

Tap on the screen to roll the ball quickly or balance it carefully traveling through a level. Improve your attention & reaction to finish all the challenging levels on the first try.

OVERCOME OBSTACLES

The more levels you complete, the harder roads you should travel. Ramps, pendulums,  trampolines, hammers, and tons of other barriers you should overcome on your way to finish. Don’t let anything knock your rolling ball out of the road!

DON’T WASTE YOUR LIVES

Remember, the ball game doesn't save your progress on the level automatically unless you have spare lives. Play carefully, or you’ll start a level again.

USE BALL BOOSTERS

Want to finish the ball race faster? Collect different bonuses along the road to become bigger & stronger! Take every advantage from the boosters to finish all the ball game levels!

Why you’ll love this ball game:

- Realistic physics
- Beautiful 3D graphics
- ASMR game experience
- Rolling ball adventure
- Dozens of cool ball skins
- Simple controls

Are you ready for the challenging ball race? Prove your skills and make your ball roll through all the obstacles safe and sound! Play Rollace and have lots of fun in one of the most addicting rolling ball games now!

bluejetty:00142651:ios.description:
Join hundreds of thousands of happy users who enjoy this simple way to stay focused and productive. Use Flow to get things done.
Flow is a tiny but mighty app that helps you work on a task, study for school or simply stay focused without being distracted for a certain amount of time. Flow divides your workflow into sections with defined breaks, making it easy to stay focused. This method has been scientifically proven to be an effective way to increase your concentration and motivation while reducing your stress levels. The use of a Pomodoro timer can be a huge boost to your productivity.
Use Flow to ...
... concentrate
... work on a task
... study for school
... code all night
... work from home
Benefits of this technique
• Improved focus and motivation
• Increased productivity
• Less stress and better health
• Better management of interruptions
Features
• Pomodoro timer with work intervals and breaks
• Statistics to keep track of your completed sessions
• Notifications to remind you of short breaks
• App and web blocking to combat distractions
• Commitment mode for self-control
• Inspirational quotes for motivation
• Metronome for deep focus
• Multiple duration options
• Custom session title
• Apple Calendar sync
• Apple Health sync
• iCloud sync of stats
• Home & Lock Screen Widgets
• Support for Live Activities & Dynamic Island

bluejetty:00076341:ios.summary: Meet ScoreCam, the first Recording and Live Streaming app with embedded scoreboard technology. The best way to record, live stream and score volleyball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, pickleball, baseball/softball, tennis and billiar
bluejetty:00076341:ios.description:
Meet ScoreCam, the first Recording and Live Streaming app with embedded scoreboard technology. The best way to record, live stream and score volleyball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, pickleball, baseball/softball, tennis and billiards/snooker games.
A few reasons you'll love ScoreCam:
- Embedded, Interactive and Configurable Scoreboard - Embed a scoreboard into the video feed and update scores on screen or with our remote, just like a real sportscast.
- Scoreboard Profiles - Save each team's names, colors, logos and scoreboard settings, then switch between them in seconds.
- Team Library - Save team names and colors once and reuse them across any profile.
- Live Streaming (subscription) - Stream to YouTube (including scheduled events), Twitch, or a sharable link so parents and fans never miss the action.
- Instant Replay (subscription) - One tap replays the big moment for your live stream viewers, with customizable transition, hold and speed.
- Branding and Ads (subscription) - Add multiple graphics or ads to your broadcast — a great way to monetize for your program, club or school.
- Team Logos - Add your team's logo to a supported scoreboard and record like a pro.
- Highlights & Highlight Reel - Capture highlight clips as you record, and let ScoreCam stitch them into a single reel with the transition of your choice.
- Pause/Resume Video Recording - Freeze the action during time-outs and reduce a 2-hour game to an hour or less.
- Volume Button Control - Use your device's volume buttons to start, pause, resume and stop recording (iOS 17+).
- External Drive Recording - Record directly to a connected USB drive; files appear in the Files app.
- iCloud Settings Sync - Your settings, teams and profiles are safely backed up to iCloud — even if you delete and reinstall the app.
- Audio Mute - Mute audio during timeouts or between games with a single tap.
- Quickly Share Scores, photos or Messages - Message, email, tweet, or post the score without leaving ScoreCam.
ScoreCam offers the following Subscriptions:
1) Live Streaming/PRO (1 Year): ONE YEAR of access to ScoreCam with Live Streaming and any updates during that period. This includes all PRO features. Comes with 1 week of FREE ACCESS.
2) Live Streaming/PRO (1 Month): ONE MONTH of access to ScoreCam with Live Streaming and any updates during that period. This includes all PRO features. Comes with 1 week of FREE ACCESS.
3) Branding/Live Streaming (1 Year): ONE YEAR of ScoreCam plus ability to add a Branding or Advertising image to a broadcast or video recording. This includes Live Streaming and all PRO features.
4) Branding/Live Streaming (1 Month): ONE MONTH of ScoreCam plus ability to add a Branding or Advertising image to a broadcast or video recording. This includes Live Streaming and all PRO features.
Additional Information on Subscriptions
- Payments will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and after the 1 week trial period.
- Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Price is subject to change at any time but any increase will require direct re-approval by the user.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- All upgrades and downgrades are automatically handled. You will not be double charged as you can only have one subscription at a time.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable.
See our Terms of Use at: http://scorecam.pachyderm.me/terms.html
Questions? Visit our website for FAQs, feedback, tips, tricks and more. (See 'ScoreCam Website' under settings for a link to our support site)

bluejetty:00131909:ios.description:
Ever wanted to know more about ships and boats, or track a vessel around the globe? Boat Watch lets you spot and identify boats and ships in an instant.
The Pro In-App purchase even sends you alerts when a boat you track sets sail or arrives - perfect for people with loved ones at sea, for tracking ferries and rescue vessels - or following cargo across the world!
Boat Watch is free to use for 1 month and offers...
* Spot any boat or ship via real-time AIS network
* See the name, type and destination of each vessel
* Set any boat as a favorite, and track it on the map
* Search and find boats and places 
After 1 month a Pro upgrade is needed to continue getting live ship positions.
Pro upgrade ( lifetime or yearly subscription):-
* Real-time ship positions updates
* Full boat information - picture, speed, where its from, etc.
* Show boats' recent tracks
* Set multiple favorite boats, to find them easily
* Get alerts when a tracked boat arrives or departs
* OpenSeaMap charts with buoys, lighthouses & shipping lanes
* Filter ships on type to declutter the view and show more vessels of the type required.
3 other optional IAP upgrades are also available:- 
Live View upgrade ( one time purchase):-
*Augmented Reality view to identify and spot boats using your camera
*View boats true to scale and with Apple Maps amazing 3D views when zoomed in
PortWatch (subscription):-
- set a radar alarm ring around an area (0.5 to 10nm)
- get notified when any ship is entering or exiting a port or area. Early alert for all ferries, cruise or cargo ships arriving at a port.
- alerts when ships are passing or approaching a location. Great for folks who live by the water and want to know when a ship is approaching. 
You can set your gps position or the current map centre as the PortWatch location and the radar alert range from 0.5nm to 10nm.
Fleet upgrade ( subscription):
* Fleet - set and receive arrival and departure alerts for multiple boats
Boat Watch also gives you the option to buy official NOAA nautical charts for the US and UKHO Admiralty derived charts for the UK&IE so you get the same view of the ocean as the ship's navigator. See the shipping channels, buoys, lights and hazards and why a ship is taking a particular route.
Our ship coverage is global and amongst the best in the world. You can find out how our system works and check our coverage here :-
http://pocketmariner.com/coverage
Pocket Mariner are committed to providing great customer service and continually improve our Boat Watch apps. If you have any questions please email us via help@pocketmariner.com and we'll be happy to help.
Terms of Use: http://seanav.net/termsofuse.php
Privacy Policy: http://seanav.net/privacy.php
Support: help@pocketmariner.com
Subscriptions:-
Pro and Fleet upgrade" subscriptions are yearly and will automatically renew at the end of the subscription period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase, and will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the iTunes account holder and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.  No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
NOT FOR NAVIGATION 
Boat Watch should only be used for basic navigation reference and should not be solely relied upon to determine precise locations, proximity, distance, or direction.

bluejetty:00147114:ios.summary:
JoyFamily – support your loved ones, wherever you are.

bluejetty:00147114:ios.description:
JoyFamily – support your loved ones, wherever you are.
JoyFamily is the family companion app for JoyTV or JoyTablet. It makes it easy to video call an older parent, a grandparent or a loved one with IDD on their tablet or TV, with nothing for them to set up and nothing for them to press. Their screen can answer your call automatically, so you see them in seconds and get instant peace of mind.
Joy works with your loved one's favorite device:
• JoyTablet – turns an everyday tablet into a simple, always-on way to stay connected. Use a tablet you or they already own.
• JoyTV – a small device that plugs into their TV, for calls and photos on the biggest screen in the house.
JoyFamily is your control center. From your phone you can:
• Make video calls that can be answered automatically on their tablet or TV
• Meet Joy, their friendly AI assistant and companion, who chats, answers questions and keeps them company between calls
• Set up reminders for medications, appointments and daily routines, shown on their screen and read aloud by Joy
• Schedule check-ins with Joy and video check-ins, so you know how they are doing each day
• Send text messages and short videos straight to their screen
• Share family photos and manage their photo slideshow on JoyTablet, including how long each photo shows and when the clock appears
• Invite siblings, grandkids, friends and support staff so everyone can stay in touch
• Share YouTube videos, join Zoom visits, and sign them up for Live Events & Classes
• Control their TV and schedule Night Mode, depending on their device
Who it's for:
• Adult children and spouses caring for an older loved one
• Families and support staff caring for adults with IDD
• Long-distance families who want to stay close
• Senior-living communities, group homes, home-health agencies and IDD service providers
Getting started takes a few minutes:
1. Create your account and tell us about your loved one.
2. Choose the screen they will use: on a tablet with JoyTablet, or on their TV with JoyTV.
3. Install JoyTablet on their tablet and log in once, or follow the on-screen steps to connect JoyTV. That's it.
Already invited by a family member? Tap "I have an invitation code" to join them.
Live help is built in. Tap the Help icon in the app to chat with our friendly customer care team.
ONSCREEN JoyFamily – easy, safe and fun communication for seniors, people with IDD and their families.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://onscreeninc.com/pages/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00120294:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120294:ios.description:
This app offers free access to LEO's dictionaries, vocab trainer and forums.
Are you in need of a reliable language reference? LEO’s comprehensive dictionaries include wide-ranging vocabulary, example sentences and audio pronunciation.
Or would you like to take a foreign language to the next level? Why not try our vocab trainer with its tried-and-tested spaced repetition system.
In LEOs Forum kannst du dir zudem Rat zu Sprachfragen holen, die über eine reine Wörterbuchfunktion hinausgehen.
Our dictionaries contain around ­ 2,944,000 entries and is being updated as you read this.
* English ⇔ German (840,000 entries)
* French ⇔ German (280,000 entries)
* Spanish ⇔ German (261,000 entries)
* Italian ⇔ German (258,000 entries)
* Chinese ⇔ German (238,000 entries)
* Russian ⇔ German (373,000 entries)
* Portuguese ⇔ German (171,000 entries)
* Polish ⇔ German (99,000 entries)
* English ⇔ Spanish (232,000 entries)
* Spanish ⇔ Portuguese (77,000 entries)
* English ⇔ French (61,000 entries)
* English ⇔ Russian (54,000 entries)
With LEO you can do more than just look up the meaning of a word in a different language. LEO also provides:
* noun and verb tables
* real voice audio pronunciation (no speech synthesis)
* definitions
* grammar and etymology,
as well as other information relevant to the search term(s) including
* orthographically similar words
* possible base forms for inflected words
* links to forum discussions containing the search term(s)
Vocabulary trainer
Our free vorab trainer is the perfect companion to build your vocabulary – whether at school or on your holidays. All you need is a free user account and you’re good to start your learning journey.
* Use our curated wordlists to practice vocabulary used in German textbooks at secondary schools
* Learn words with LEO’s spaced repetition system
* Create your own wordlists – be it for school, for professional contexts or for your holidays
* Set your learning targets and learn at your own speed
* Enhance your language skills with a sustainable approach
* Collect as many words and phrases as you like – there is no word limit even in the free version of our app
Forums
The LEO Forum exists to provide a platform for language-related questions that are not answered in the dictionary. If you would like to get help from other users or contribute to questions yourself, you need to register a user account (free of charge).
The app contains adverts which you can choose to remove by subscribing to our ad-free version. https://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula
You can find a detailed description of all of our services on our website https://www.leo.org

Do you want to improve your sl
bluejetty:00040883:ios.description:
SleepScore features patented, non-contact, sonar sleep tracker technology to measure your sleep from your nightstand, personalized actionable advice, sleep sounds, smart alarm, sleep cycle analysis, and more.
Do you want to improve your sleep but don’t know where to start?
Do you want to fall asleep with ease?
Do you want to learn more about your sleep cycle?
SleepScore measures every move and breath to measure each phase of your sleep, from deep and REM sleep to every nighttime awakening. Our measurement technology provides best-in-class accuracy backed by 14 published papers validating the measurement technology against PSG, the gold standard in sleep tracking.
Based on the analysis of your sleep patterns, the app then provides detailed sleep insights and actionable advice, all personalized to improve your unique sleep. Plus, try SleepScore’s lifestyle challenges, sleep sounds, smart alarm, DreamScape, and more.
FEATURED IN: Washington Post, The New York Times, Forbes, CNN, Men’s Health, Huffington Post, Wirecutter, USA Today, Business Insider, Digital Trends, & more!
UNDERSTAND YOUR SLEEP
-Track your sleep with SleepScore’s patented non-contact, accurate sonar technology 
-Explore insights about your unique sleep cycles each night 
-View trend & correlation charts based on your sleep patterns and lifestyle analysis 
-Receive a weekly sleep report to easily view and identify trends
-Access your lifetime sleep history, trends, and sleep cycle analysis
-Access validated screeners if signs of a more serious sleep disorder are detected
-Download a comprehensive 30-day sleep report and screener results to share sleep concerns with your doctor
IMPROVE WITH SCIENCE BACKED FEATURES, ADVICE, AND MORE
-Receive daily actionable tips tailored to your lifestyle and sleep habits 
-Set sleep goals to focus on what you what’s important to you, or let SleepScore learn about your sleep and suggest the right goal for you
-Try weekly sleep challenges to learn new behaviors that can improve your sleep and wellness
-Listen to soothing sleep sounds that gradually slow down to help you relax and fall asleep faster 
-Measure and optimize the light, temperature, and sound levels in your bedroom
-Wake refreshed with the Smart Alarm, designed to gently wake you in the morning at the ideal time in your sleep cycle
APP HEALTH DATA
Our app integrates with the Apple Health app to add your sleep data and read your activities, such as exercise. On supported devices, SleepScore reads data from the Health App with your permission to update your activities during the day to provide more personalized advice. SleepScore also writes sleep data to the Health app with permission.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
SleepScore is free to download and use. For advanced features, SleepScore has auto-renewing monthly & yearly subscription options.
If you choose to purchase SleepScore, payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen subscription length. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes store. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to SleepScore.
Not validated to accurately track sleep with iPad, iPod Touch, iPhone 5s, or iPhone SE.
Privacy policy 
https://www.sleepscore.com/legal/privacy-policy
Terms of Service
https://www.sleepscore.com/legal/sleepscore-terms-of-service

bluejetty:00021030:ios.description:
An App Store Editors’ Choice, Under My Roof® is the go-to app for organizing your home.
All the details and important documents you need to manage and maintain your home and belongings—both daily and for years to come—are neatly organized and always available across your devices. Save time and money while gaining peace of mind.
• NEVER MISS ROUTINE MAINTENANCE OR RUN OUT OF ESSENTIAL HOUSEHOLD SUPPLIES AGAIN
• TRACK MAINTENANCE, REPAIRS, & RENOVATIONS
• NO MORE SEARCHING THROUGH FILES, DRAWERS, OR WEBSITES FOR SCATTERED INFORMATION
• LOCATE ITEMS IMMEDIATELY, EVEN THOSE STORED IN A BOX IN THE ATTIC
• HELPS WITH MOVING, ESTATE PLANNING, INSURANCE COVERAGE, COLLECTIBLES, AND MORE!
Available for iPhone, iPad, & Mac with iCloud syncing using your own private iCloud Account. No risky web backend, no third-party accounts—your data stays yours.
Under My Roof is the next generation of our award-winning Mac app, Home Inventory, trusted since 2005. 
FAST & EASY DATA ENTRY
• Use Apple Intelligence photo analysis to capture an entire room in minutes (iOS 27+ on a device that supports Apple Intelligence)
• Or use voice-activated Quick Entry Mode to capture an entire room including photos
• Support for barcode scanning, text capture, and document scanning
• 3D Room Scan for area and furniture measurements
GET RID OF PAPER CLUTTER
• Store photos, receipts, warranties, manuals, notes, and documents in one place
KEEP IMPORTANT DETAILS HANDY
• Make, model, serial number, purchase price/date, value, square footage, paint colors, property assessments, and much more
TRACK RENOVATIONS & MODIFICATIONS 
• Monitor costs, added value, parts & supplies, receipts, and before/after photos
STAY ON TOP OF MAINTENANCE & REPAIRS
• Schedule maintenance tasks with notifications
• Keep a history with completion dates, costs, parts & supplies, receipts, and photos
MANAGE COLLECTIBLES
• Flexible enough for any type of collection
• Multiple valuation options
PROPERTY INSURANCE COVERAGE & CLAIMS TRACKING
• Know if you are adequately insured with coverage analysis
• Handles complex coverage limits found in most policies
• An inventory of your belongings helps for a fair and timely settlement
• Track the details of the claims process - damages, expenses, contacts, & more
TRACK DISPOSED ITEMS
• Donated, recycled, sold, trashed, gifted, and more
HOUSEHOLD SUPPLIES USAGE
• Low supply alerts
DATA PRIVACY & PROTECTION
• Your data is stored on your device and if sync is enabled in your personal iCloud account
• No one but you and those you share it with have access, not even us
• Apple Intelligence is private - on device and Private Cloud Compute
• Optional password protection and Touch ID
MANAGE YOUR MOVE
• Track box locations, sizes, weights, and contents
BARCODES & QRCODES
• Automatically add an item by scanning a UPC/EAN/ISBN barcode
• Scan your own custom barcodes for asset tracking
• Search your inventory by barcode
CUSTOMIZATION
• Unlimited custom fields, locations, categories, collections, color-coded tags, conditions, heirs, reports, & moving boxes
• Customizable field layouts by category
MULTI CURRENCY SUPPORT
• Automatic conversion plus original currency tracking
OTHER HIGHLIGHTS 
• Supports unlimited homes and concurrent users
• Assign heirs for Estate Planning
• CSV import & export
• Dependable customer support
UPGRADE FROM HOME INVENTORY
• Easily import your Home Inventory database into Under My Roof
• See our FAQ for details: https://binaryformations.com/support/under-my-roof-faq/
PRICING
• FREE to download with a 10 item-limit to make sure it's a fit for you
• Subscriptions remove the limit and include a 1-week free trial
• Supports Family Sharing & covers all your Macs, iPads, & iPhones
• Cancel anytime—your inventory remains viewable
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Questions or feedback? Contact a real human at support@binaryformations.com.
Under My Roof® is a registered trademark of Binary Formations, LLC.

What You Get
Daily Gratitude Journal

bluejetty:00162012:ios.summary:
Discover the 19th and 20th centuries with countryballs! Train your countryballs, teach them how to fight, buy them cool weapons, and join great battles with them.
Countryball: Europe 1890 is a strategy game mixed with a turn-based combat m
bluejetty:00162012:ios.description:
Discover the 19th and 20th centuries with countryballs! Train your countryballs, teach them how to fight, buy them cool weapons, and join great battles with them.
Countryball: Europe 1890 is a strategy game mixed with a turn-based combat mechanic plus cards and stats involved. All of those mechanics make the game more exciting and fun! 
You start the Countryball: Europe 1890 by selecting a campaign/conquest game mode and your character afterward. After that, you will try to complete your objectives by conquering territories and mastering diplomacies. 
In Countryball: Europe 1890 you can declare war, send ally requests, puppet weakened countries, remove your allies/puppets and even annex your puppet states! You have all the freedom to choose your allies and enemies. Try to have strong allies on your side because there will be battles that you will have to fight against multiple enemies. Before each battle, you have the option to call your allies and puppets to make them join the battle on your side. While allies sometimes accept your call, your puppet states on the other hand always accept your battle calls.
To defeat your enemies in battles, you have to be a strong country. To do that, you should play minigames or you should increase your stats (attack, defense, health, and mana) manually by using star points. To earn star points you should simply win battles. Also, you should buy strong cards from the shop. Each card has different combat effects. You play those cards by simply dragging & dropping on the countryball during combat. Note that all weapons are considered as cards!
In Countryball: Europe 1890, your simple task is to complete the objectives by defeating your enemies. By completing campaigns you get new countryballs to your collection. Note that all 50+ countryballs are available to play. The only thing you need is to find them! Some of them are hidden in capital cities while some of them are acquired by completing campaigns or conquests.
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to drop a review or send me an e-mail.
It's time to explore history with countryballs!
Some Music Used In-game
Alexander Nakarada - the Crown
Kevin Macleod - Five Armies
Alexander Nakarada - the Vikings

To do that, you should play minigames or you should increase your stats (attack, defense, health, and mana) manually by using star points. To earn star points you should simply win battles. Also, you should buy strong cards from the shop. Each card has different combat effects. You play those cards by simply dragging & dropping on the countryball during combat. Note that all weapons are considered as cards!

In Countryball: Europe 1890, your simple task is to complete the objectives by defeating your enemies. By completing campaigns you get new countryballs to your collection. Note that all 50+ countryballs are available to play. The only thing you need is to find them! Some of them are hidden in capital cities while some of them are acquired by completing campaigns or conquests.

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to drop a review or send me an e-mail.

It's time to explore history with countryballs!

Unlock the Hidden Value of Your Coins with CoinSpot
Transform your coin collection experience with CoinSpot, the most advanced AI-powered coin identification app available. Whether you're a seasoned numismatist or a curious beginner, our app offers unparalleled features to help you discover, grade, and value your coins with precision and ease.
Key Features:
• Instant Coin Identification: Simply snap a photo of any coin, and our cutting-edge AI technology will instantly recognize it, providing you with detailed information including origin, year, and metal composition.
• Precise Coin Grading: Go beyond basic identification. Determine the specific grade of your coin, including subgrades, to accurately assess its condition and market value—a feature that sets us apart from the competition.
• Mint Error Detection: Detect rare mint errors with our specialized scanning feature. Learn about the specifics of each error and understand how it impacts your coin's rarity and worth.
• Comprehensive Value Assessment: Receive accurate market valuations that consider your coin's grade, year, variety, and any mint errors, ensuring you have the most accurate estimate of its worth.
• Customizable Collections: Organize your coins into personalized collections. Name them as you like, and view summaries that display the number of coins and total value, making it effortless to manage and showcase your treasures.
• Mint Error & High-Value Histories: Quickly access lists of coins you've scanned that feature mint errors or hold significant value, allowing you to keep track of your most remarkable finds.
• Explore Educational Content: Dive into our curated articles to expand your knowledge about coin collecting, history, and market trends, enriching your numismatic journey.
Why Choose CoinSpot?
Unlike other apps, CoinSpot offers a comprehensive suite of features that take your coin collecting to the next level. Our precise grading capabilities and mint error detection provide insights that are typically unavailable in similar applications. With an intuitive interface and rapid scanning technology, you gain instant access to a wealth of information, empowering you to make informed decisions about your collection.
Join a Thriving Community
Become part of a growing community of coin enthusiasts who trust CoinSpot for accurate identification and valuation. Our app is designed to be your reliable companion in the fascinating world of coin collecting.
Download CoinSpot Today! Embark on a journey to uncover the hidden stories and values behind your coins. Download CoinSpot now and transform the way you experience coin collecting.

bluejetty:00040833:ios.description:

Every play, counted
• Top artists, songs, albums and genres, by plays or by minutes
• Any range: today, this week, this month, this year, all time or year by year
• Your listening history day by day, a heatmap of every day you listened, your listening clock and your longest streak

• Say you're going, or maybe, and see who else is: people you follow first
• After the show, say you were there and rate the concert and the venue

• Follow friends and see how compatible your taste is

• Chat one to one or in groups

bluejetty:00068160:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta Airport (ATL). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every ATL flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.

bluejetty:00063412:ios.description:
The free Garmin Audio app puts entertainment control in the palm of your hand. Whether you’re on the move or at the helm, this app gives you quick access to wireless remote control of your compatible JL Audio® or Fusion® stereo via Bluetooth® or Wi-Fi® connectivity (Wi-Fi available on select stereo models only).
Enjoy play / pause / skip audio control with source selection, individual zone volume control and the ability to adjust music / stereo settings (including choosing albums, artists and playlists).
You will also be able to access over-the-air software updates allowing you to easily keep your compatible stereo up-to-date with the latest features.
The app supports Digital Signal Processing (DSP) setup with the Easy Tune feature; where you can select customized speaker, subwoofer, amplifier and environmental profiles to enjoy premium audio that is optimized for your boat, resulting in a superior listening experience. DSP also protects your audio system by adjusting the power output to your system components.
Keep a look out for future app updates which may introduce new features and improvements.

Accrue: The cross-border payment app.
Need an easier way to pay and get paid across Africa and the US? Accrue helps you send money to family and friends in minutes, save in US dollars to earn daily interest, shop online with virtual and gift cards, and grow your money through simple investing - all from your phone. Join thousands of people who trust Accrue to handle their money safely and simply.
Here's How Accrue Works for You:
Send Money to Family & Friends Quickly
Need to send money to loved ones across Africa? With Accrue, you can send money to any African country in just minutes! Send directly to their bank account, MoMo, or MPesa, and they'll get it right away. We give you great rates when sending to Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa and other countries, so you keep more of your money.
Get Your Own Dollar Account
Receive payments in dollars from anywhere in the world with your personal USD account. Perfect for getting paid by international clients or receiving money from family abroad.
Send Money to US Bank Accounts
Got friends or family in the US? Send money straight to their bank account with just a few taps. Simply enter their bank info once and you can send them dollars anytime - it's quick, safe and easy! No confusing bank codes or complicated forms to fill out.
Shop Online with Virtual Cards
Shop on international websites easily with our virtual dollar cards. Create a card in seconds, add money instantly, and make secure online purchases anywhere in the world.
Get Gift Cards & Digital Essentials
Shop at popular stores like Amazon, ASOS, PlayStation Network, and App Store with our digital gift cards. Top up your phone airtime or get instant eSIM data plans for travel - all in one place.

bluejetty:00143540:ios.description:
The cTrader mobile app supports trading in forex, metals, oil, indices, stocks and ETFs.
Trade with top brokers including IC Markets, Pepperstone, BlackBull, FP Markets, FPM Trading, Fusion Markets, AUTU Securities, Axiory, Deriv, Dominion Markets, FxPro, TopFX, TradeView Markets, Tradona Markets, Skilling and many others.
Log in securely, connect your trading accounts and stay in sync across devices. Get access to a complete range of order types, advanced technical analysis tools, price alerts, trade statistics, advanced order and risk management settings, symbol watchlists and a variety of options to customize the platform to your on-the-go trading style.
Trade on a fast, transparent trading platform designed for serious traders:
- Detailed symbol information helps you understand the assets you are trading
- Symbol trading sessions show you when each market is open or closed
- Integrated market news keeps you informed about events that may affect your trading
- Fluid, responsive charts and QuickTrade mode allow for one-tap order execution
- Market sentiment indicators show how other traders are positioned
Use advanced technical analysis tools with flexible settings for all indicators and drawings:
- Multiple chart types, including time-based, tick, Renko, range and Heikin-Ashi
- Several chart views such as candlesticks, bar, line, dots and area charts
- A rich set of drawing tools, including trend lines, Fibonacci tools, channels, shapes, text and pitchforks
- Dozens of popular technical indicators to support your trading strategies
Stay in control with powerful trading tools:
- Configure push and email alerts to stay updated on key events
- Manage all your accounts in one app and switch between them quickly
- Review detailed trade statistics and performance metrics
- Set price alerts to be notified when a price reaches your chosen level
- Create and manage symbol watchlists to track your favourite instruments
- Manage active sessions and log out from other devices when needed
- Trade comfortably with a dark theme optimized for long trading sessions
- Access the platform in 22 languages to trade in your preferred language
cTrader is trusted as a transparent, reliable trading platform rather than a single broker brand. Whether you trade Forex, CFDs, stock CFDs or gold, cTrader provides the tools you need to analyze markets, manage risk and execute your trading plan from anywhere.

bluejetty:00180050:ios.description:
⏺ This app is only available for current Rosetta Stone Classic subscribers, and existing enterprise/education users. ⏺
New to Rosetta Stone? Check out Rosetta Stone Sapphire, the brand new Rosetta Stone experience! There, you can explore all of the latest features from the experts in language learning.
Learning a language can be an experience that transforms your life. Over 25 years of language learning experience has taught Rosetta Stone one thing: everyone has the ability to learn to read, write, and speak a language with confidence. Try the Rosetta Stone app yourself for free. 
Many online language learning apps will promise that you can learn a language in just a few minutes a day. However, there is a significant difference between memorizing vocabulary lists and speaking a language with confidence. Learning a language is about more than just the words. One of the mistakes new language learners make is treating language as an object or an end goal instead of as an experience.
Ditch the books, translator, and dictionary, and surround yourself with a language whenever, wherever with the Rosetta Stone mobile app. 
What are people saying about Rosetta Stone:
• CNN Underscored - "There’s a good reason why the language learning app Rosetta Stone is the gros chien (that is, the big dog) of the apps we tested"
• Mashable - "one of the OG language-learning services, known for its deep dive into accent pronunciation"
• Popular Science - "super-smooth and intuitive, and the lessons neither feel too short so as to be forgettable nor too long so as to be a chore"
• PC Mag - "reliable, accurate, and thorough"
Rosetta Stone has taught millions of people new languages, and you’re next. From day one, you’ll: 
• Stay focused with a personalized language learning plan based on your motivation. 
• Learn a language intuitively using our proven immersion method. 
• Perfect your pronunciation with instantaneous feedback. 
• Download lessons to do everything offline. 
• Access different kinds of exercises with our Extended Learning features. 
• Sync progress across all your devices. 
• And never see an ad, ever. 
Choose from 24 languages: 
Arabic, Chinese (Mandarin), Dutch, English (American or British), Filipino (Tagalog), French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Persian (Farsi), Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish (Latin American or Spain), Swedish, Turkish, or Vietnamese.

• Unlimited use of Rosetta Stone's mobile app is available for existing Enterprise and Education Learners.
• Features may vary for Enterprise and Education Learners.
For questions or assistance, please visit http://support.rosettastone.com

bluejetty:00135576:ios.description:
Welcome to Fishing Blitz! Get ready to dive into the next generation of mobile fishing games, specifically crafted for anglers and fishing enthusiasts from around the globe.
Fishing Blitz! offers an unparalleled experience with fun and realistic gameplay. Immerse yourself in breathtaking fishing environments and encounter a diverse range of exotic fish species.
Embark on your fishing journey at Antler Lake, a captivating location that boasts multiple water bodies. As you progress, unlock and conquer other renowned fishing spots like Bahia Honda, Las Vueltas, Oyster Bay, and many more. Each location presents a unique and stunning selection of fish, allowing you to build your very own Ultimate Collection.
So grab your gear, choose your fishing spot, and get ready to embark on an amazing fishing experience with Fishing Blitz!
Fishing Blitz! also features a broad variety of fish species, including bass, trouts, carp, salmon and even the elusive sharks, allowing players to test their skills and try to catch them all. Use Boosts to increase your chance of catching rare fish. Equip boost such as Luck, Chance, Weight, Speed and Sonar to augment your chance of catching the desired fish. 
Enhance your fishing experience with a wide array of engaging features in the game. Take on a thrilling range of Missions, where you can immerse yourself in exciting objectives and challenges. Compete head-to-head with your friends in intense 1v1 fishing duels, showcasing your skills as you aim for victory.
Embark on Fishing Adventures that are brimming with captivating Quests, offering not only a sense of exploration but also rewarding you with enticing prizes. From big rewards to exclusive items, you'll find plenty of incentives to keep pushing forward.
Unlock the Season Pass to gain access to exclusive content and enjoy additional benefits as you progress through the game. Immerse yourself in the exhilaration of Tournaments, which feature a variety of competitions held daily, hourly, and during special events. Compete against fellow anglers from around the world and strive to climb the leaderboard, showcasing your fishing prowess to the global community.
These exciting challenges add an extra layer of exhilaration, providing you with opportunities to test and improve your fishing skills. Engage in friendly competition, discover new techniques, and continuously grow as you strive for greatness in the world of fishing.
With a diverse range of game modes and ample opportunities for rewards, the game ensures that every fishing session is filled with excitement, progression, and the chance to become a true angling champion. So dive in, tackle the challenges, and let your fishing skills shine!
Join the hunt for fish, play now:
- Easy to pick up and play, catering to all types of players and skills. Whether you're a seasoned angler or new to fishing games, you can jump right in and start playing.
- Immerse yourself in cinematic vistas and realistic, eye-catching fish!
- Compete and climb the ranks against other anglers in 1v1 duels, Fishing Adventures, and Tournaments.
- Seamlessly transition above water and underwater to select/upgrade lures and get back to angling instantly.
- Enhance your cast with boosters that increase your Chance, Speed, Luck, and Fish Weight.
- Utilize Sonar to guide you to the best fish-catching spots.
- Upgrade your Gear & Lures, Level up to unlock new Fishing spots, and build your Ultimate Collection of Fish!

Homzmart is your all-in-one destination for stylish furniture, home decor, appliances, and everyday essentials designed to fit modern lifestyles. Whether you are furnishing a new home or upgrading your current space, Homzmart helps you discover high-quality products that combine comfort, practicality, and elegant design, all in one convenient place.
Explore a wide range of home furniture including sofas, beds, dining tables, chairs, storage units, and wardrobes crafted to suit different spaces and tastes. From modern and minimal styles to classic and timeless designs, Homzmart offers options for every room in your home, helping you create spaces that feel organized, comfortable, and visually appealing without compromising functionality.
Transform your living space with carefully selected home decor items such as lighting solutions, rugs, curtains, mirrors, wall art, and decorative accessories. Each product is chosen to help you create a warm, balanced, and functional home environment that reflects your personal taste and daily living needs, whether you prefer simple designs or bold statement pieces.

These products are selected to support efficiency, comfort, and reliability, making everyday tasks easier and more enjoyable while supporting a modern way of living.

The platform is continuously updated with new collections and product selections to keep up with evolving home trends and customer needs. This ensures that users always have access to fresh options that match current preferences and practical requirements.

• Modern, classic, and practical designs

• Trusted sellers and quality products

Download Homzmart today and bring your home ideas to life.

bluejetty:00120597:ios.description:
Learn English grammar fast with our exciting learning method! Play games with speedy lessons that also improve your vocabulary, listening and speaking skills.
This English grammar trainer and vocabulary builder contains 300+ simple lessons, speedy grammar exercises and interactive practice games for ESL beginners, basic level students and intermediate level learners (A1, A2 & B1). It includes a simple grammar book, listening exercises and challenge games to test your English. Learn British or American English vocabulary and pronunciation. It will teach you syntax skills for conversation, ESL classes or for IELTS and TOEIC tests.
"English Grammar Star" was previously called "Speedy English Grammar" but the game is still just as speedy as before!
Beginner, basic and elementary language level (A1 and A2) includes:
* Present simple tense - the verb "to be" and other verbs
* Past simple tense - regular verbs and irregular verb conjugation
* Articles, pronouns and possessives
* Singular and plural forms
* Positive and negative phrases
* Question forms and short answers
* Demonstrative pronouns
* Determiners and conjunctions
* Present continuous/progressive tense
* Basic adjectives and adverbs
* Comparatives and superlatives
* Future
* Imperative
* Present perfect tense - regular verbs and irregular verb conjugation
* Basic time words and phrases and the use of different tenses
Intermediate language level (B1) includes:
* Prepositions
* Past continuous tense
* Action verbs vs state verbs
* Conditional Tenses
* The passive voice
* Relative Clauses
* Prefixes and suffixes
It has:
* A speedy irregular verb conjugation trainer
* A suffixes course
* A simple grammar book with examples
* Challenge games to test your language skills at each level (A1, A2 & B1)
* Listening practice
* American & British English vocabulary & pronunciation
This is for ESL beginners, basic level students and intermediate English learners (A1, A2 & B1). Practise by yourself or for TOEIC, IELTS or ESL conversation courses.
Listen and speak the vocabulary to improve your speaking skills for conversation!
English Grammar Star makes learning fun!

bluejetty:00131341:ios.description:
Take the hassle out of parking with the ParkWhiz app. Find parking in any major city, compare prices, plus save up to 50% when you book in advance.

You'll get paperless passes that travel with you, for convenient parking anytime--with savings of up to 50% off drive-up.
BOOK easier than ever with our all-in-one homescreen.
PARK with your mobile pass, just pull in.
DO YOUR THING with all the time and money you've saved.
- All in one homescreen for the way you like to book.
- New larger date & time selection for better ease and accuracy.
- Control it all, make your own choices. Choose fast, book easy.
- Instant-load map, simple selections, speedy booking.
- Up to 50% off drive-up rate for pain-free city parking.
All the parking you need.
Business? Check. Commuting? Yep. Going to a museum or a concert? Got it. Need airport parking? Even there. Book with ParkWhiz for all of your parking needs.
We're the leading NYC app, sparing New Yorkers from alternate side of the street parking. From the most congested place in the nation, to Chicago, San Francisco, Boston, Los Angeles, Toronto, and all points in between, ParkWhiz gets drivers parking for less. 
Better yet, you book in advance, so your space is waiting. There's no more circling blocks, worrying about full lots or frayed nerves from not knowing where to park.

- The first screen lets you search by destination by address, map 
or past pass.
- Pick the pin on the map with the nearby location's price you like.
- Set date and times.
- Confirm booking.
- Get your virtual pass in your phone.
- Pull in, park, then do your thing.

bluejetty:00068904:ios.name: 네이버 스마트보드 - Naver Smartboard
bluejetty:00068904:ios.summary:
The more you use, the easier it gets. Search and translation are available on the keyboard.

Take a look at NAVER SmartBoard, a keyboard app that just fits you.
1. It gests smarter as you use
bluejetty:00068904:ios.description:
The more you use, the easier it gets. Search and translation are available on the keyboard.
You also can use stickers or your own drawings.
Take a look at NAVER SmartBoard, a keyboard app that just fits you.
1. It gests smarter as you use it.
You can use suggestions from SmartBoard such as words, corrections, or emojis.
Custom texts help you enter long sentences each with a single tap while Quick Keys let your favorite shortened phrases stay in a single key.
You can not only change Korean syllables to Chinese characters but also type with your voice.
2. Search while you keep texting
You don't have to switch to a search app during a conversation.
Finding information of restaurants, movies, weather, and shopping has never been easier.
Stay where you are and get things done!
3. Real-time translation as you type in.
Don't be afraid of texting or emailing with foreigners any more.
Just type in Korean and SmartBoard does the rest translating into English, Chinese (Simplified), or Japanese using N2MT technology.
Using voice recognition while translating is even useful.
4. A single drawing wins the speech.
Sometimes it's a lot better to show a picture than to describe in words.
Draw anything you want to send either on a empty canvas or a picture in your gallery!
5. Customize your keyboard
Accustomed to a certain Korean layout? SmartBoard supports major Korean layouts such as "2-set Korean", "Danmoum", "Cheonjiin", "Naratgul", and "Vega". If you were frustrated with "Danmoum" before, meet our "Danmoum+" that has an additional SHIFT key.
You also can set any images for the keyboard background.

bluejetty:00035559:android.name: Assistant for SV
bluejetty:00035559:android.summary:
Unofficial Assistant for Stardew Valley helps you optimize your farming experience. With this guide, you can:
• Browse the game encyclopedia: View information about crops, fish, items, and characters. Our app's built-in Stardew Valley wiki
bluejetty:00035559:android.description:
Unofficial Assistant for Stardew Valley helps you optimize your farming experience. With this guide, you can:
• Browse the game encyclopedia: View information about crops, fish, items, and characters. Our app's built-in Stardew Valley wiki has all the information you need in one convenient place.
• Track NPC schedules: Plan your interactions with NPCs and view their availability on specific days.
• Manage tasks: Set repeat patterns for tasks and track their completion to help you stay on top of your farm work.
• View NPC gift preferences: Make gift-giving easier and build stronger relationships with NPCs by viewing their favorite and disliked items.

And don't forget: if you want an extra challenge, you can also play "Never Have I Ever... Dirty" or "Never Have I Ever... Girls."
No matter what game you choose, the best part is that this application is free, so there's no catch—just tons of fun!

bluejetty:00018703:ios.description:
Frigo Magic is the must-have application for anyone looking for quick and easy meal ideas using ingredients already in their fridge and cupboards. With nearly 2000 recipes and 7 million possible combinations, you are sure to find what you are looking for! 
Our application is particularly adapted to parents, students, single people or people who want to limit their food waste. With Frigo Magic, you can compose customized recipes in one click, with the food you have on hand, without having to go shopping. 
Our extra trick? Variation! You can change the foods in your recipe in a flash, for an even more personalized kitchen. And best of all, our application is completely free! 
To get started on Frigo Magic, you just need to enter the food you have in your fridge and cupboards, and the application will suggest suitable recipes. You can also specify how many people you're cooking for, your diet and your kitchen equipment, for even more personalized recipes. 
Once you've completed your fridge, you can explore all the recipes available on the app and save your favorites for easy retrieval. Each recipe comes with check-off steps and voice dictation to help you cook with ease. 
Finally, don't forget to share your best photos of dishes cooked with Frigo Magic on Instagram and Facebook! And if you encounter any technical issues, our team is available to help you by email at hello@frigomagic.com. 
Download Frigo Magic on the Apple Store now and never ask yourself the question "What's for dinner tonight?" again!

bluejetty:00061032:ios.summary:
Stay on top of your relationships with a powerful, easy-to-use CRM.
Contacts Journal gives you the tools to track conversations, manage follow-ups, and organize your contacts—so you can build stronger relationships and never miss an opportu
bluejetty:00061032:ios.description:
Stay on top of your relationships with a powerful, easy-to-use CRM.
Contacts Journal gives you the tools to track conversations, manage follow-ups, and organize your contacts—so you can build stronger relationships and never miss an opportunity.
With Contacts Journal, you can:
• Always know your last interaction with each contact, so you’re prepared for any conversation
• Stay consistent with timely follow-ups, reminders, and tasks
• Organize contacts using tags, groups, and filters
• Keep all relevant notes, files, and documents in one place
• Plan smarter meetings by seeing who’s nearby and where opportunities are
• Maintain a private, secure address book fully under your control
• Reach out faster with personalized emails using templates or AI
TRUSTED BY PROFESSIONALS WHO MANAGE RELATIONSHIPS:
• sales professionals and account managers
• small business owners
• freelancers, consultants, and independent operators
• real estate agents, lawyers, and other client-facing roles
• individuals who want to stay intentional about their personal network
KEY FEATURES:
LOGS, TODOS AND FILES
Keep notes for each meeting with Logs; create follow-ups and reminders with ToDos; attach images and documents with Files
IMPORT CONTACTS
You can easily import your contacts from the Contacts app, or from a CSV file
ORGANIZE CONTACTS
Categorize and visualize your contacts list with Contact Tags, Favorite Contacts, Groups and Filters
COMPANY ACCOUNTS
Link multiple contacts to a Company Account, to track interactions at the organization level
DUPLICATE DETECTION AND MERGE
Detect and merge duplicate contacts
CUSTOM FIELDS
Extend the app by defining and creating your own custom fields
MAP YOUR CONTACTS
Turn your contacts into a map of opportunities. See who’s nearby, plan smarter meetings, and spot patterns with color-coded locations
BUSINESS CARD SCANNER [requires a Teams plan]
Quickly convert business cards into contacts
EMAIL TEMPLATES
Create email templates with personalization tags, to send prepared emails quickly with a personal touch
AVAILABLE ON iOS AND MAC
Contacts Journal is available on iOS and Mac App Store, with seamless syncing via iCloud so your data is always up to date across devices.
POWERFUL FEATURES
• Share Extension to save notes, links, and images from other apps
• Siri Shortcuts for faster workflows and automation
• Home and Lock Screen widgets for quick access
• Group Emails to reach multiple contacts at once
• Visual charts to track your relationship activity
GREAT FOR PRIVACY
No account signup needed. Your data stays fully under your control, and we never have access to it
UNLIMITED PERSONAL PLAN:
• The app is initially limited to 20 Logs, ToDos, Files, Custom Fields, etc. To add unlimited entries, please purchase the “Unlimited Personal Plan”
• The Unlimited Personal Plan is a one-time purchase 
• You can purchase the "Unlimited Combined Plan" to unlock both iOS and Mac apps together 
CONTACTS JOURNAL FOR TEAMS:
• Share your Contacts Journal data with others using iCloud accounts
• Real-time, automatic syncing between multiple users
• Create multiple teams to share different information with different users
• Includes a Business Card Scanner
Contacts Journal For Teams requires a monthly or annual subscription that is purchased through the app. The subscription will automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Service: https://contactsjournal.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360015780571
Privacy Policy: https://contactsjournal.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360015414291
Please send us your suggestions and feedback at support@zaal-llc.com

bluejetty:00022617:ios.description:
Explore the world through historical photos pinned on a map.
Discover old pictures, compare past and present, and uncover the history of places around you.
Time Portal is your personal time machine with over 2,100,000 historical photos from across the globe. Discover how the world looked in the past — from 1825 to today — through authentic vintage images of cities, streets, and landmarks.
SEE HOW PLACES HAVE CHANGED – FROM THEN TO NOW
• Search by location – Enter any city, street, or address and uncover rare old photos of that exact spot.
• Filter by year – Explore specific time periods like the Victorian era, WWII, or the 1960s.
• Compare past and present – Use your camera to capture a modern photo and view it side-by-side with historical images.
• Explore rare archival content – Access authentic street view history from global archives, libraries, and collections.
• Discover hidden stories – From New York and Paris to small towns and villages, find unique historical perspectives from anywhere in the world.
PERFECT FOR:
• History lovers and researchers
• Travelers and explorers
• Photographers and creatives
• Educators and students
• Anyone curious about the past
Time Portal is the easiest way to search old photos by location, see what your street looked like decades ago, and compare then and now — all in one beautiful app.
Download Time Portal and rediscover the world through historical photography.

bluejetty:00032662:ios.description:
Jackpot.com - The Official lottery app to order lottery tickets online
Order official lottery tickets for the biggest games like Powerball and Mega Millions from your phone in minutes. With Jackpot.com, you can play lottery online, order scratch off tickets, and check lottery results anytime - all in one secure lotto app.
No lines. No paper tickets. Just easy, secure ticket ordering.
How to Order Your Tickets in Minutes
1. Choose Your Game: Pick from Powerball, Mega Millions, Millionaire for Life, or local state lottery tickets.
2. Select Your Numbers: Use your favorites or choose a "Quick Pick."
3. Place Your Order: We purchase the ticket from an official retailer on your behalf.
4. View Your Scan: See a scan of your digital lottery tickets right in the app.
5. Collect Winnings: Get notified if you win! Small prizes go straight to your account.*
Why Choose Jackpot.com?
• Keep 100% of Your Winnings: We never charge commission on your prize.
• Official & Secure: We are a licensed courier. Your digital lottery tickets are safe, and your physical ticket is stored in a secure vault.
• Instant Win Games: Enjoy lottery scratchers and digital scratch cards in supported states for a shot at games for cash.
• Lottery Results: Check your winning numbers and check lottery tickets from anywhere.
• My Lottery Rewards: Earn rewards as you play and enjoy exclusive app promotions.
We operate with licensed state retailers and comply with all state gaming regulations.
Powerful Features for Every Player
• Powerball App & Mega Millions App in one place: Specialized tracking for the nation’s biggest jackpots.
• Scratch Off App: Experience digital scratch tickets with the same excitement as paper scratchers.
• Real-Time Alerts: Get push notifications when you win, plus instant updates and latest results.
• Never Miss a Draw: Use our auto-entry feature to stay in the game for every super lotto jackpot or mega draw.
• Save Your Numbers: Store your favorite numbers in the app for a quick play.
• Play Responsibly: Set limits and use built-in tools for responsible play
Supported States & Games
We currently support online lotto services in:
• New York Lottery: NY Lottery, Win 4, Numbers, and more.
• New Jersey Lottery: NJ Pick 3, Pick 4, Pick 6, and more.
• Ohio State Lottery: Pick 3, Rolling Cash 5, Classic Lotto, scratch-offs, and more.
• Massachusetts Lottery: MA Numbers Game, Mass Cash, scratch-off, and more.
• Arizona Lottery: The Pick, scratch-offs, and more.
• Arkansas Lottery: AR LOTTO, Natural State Jackpot, Cash 3, and more.
• Colorado Lottery: Colorado Lotto+, Cash 5, scratch offs, and more.
• Digital scratch tickets are available in MA, OH, AZ, and CO.
Secure & Official
Jackpot.com is licensed and registered in supported states. We purchase official state lottery tickets on your behalf from authorized retailers. Your data is encrypted and stored securely.
Must be 18+ (21+ in AZ).
*Prizes up to $600 ($500 in AR) are credited to your account. For larger wins, we arrange secure delivery of your physical ticket so you can claim directly from the State Lottery.
Play Responsibly
Set limits or take a break anytime. Certified by the National Council on Problem Gambling (NCPG).
If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER or 1-800-MY-RESET.
NY: 1-877-8-HOPE-NY or text HOPENY (467369).
Support: www.jackpot.com/contact-us
Terms: www.jackpot.com/terms-and-conditions
Jackpot.com is not affiliated with any State Lottery.

* Compatible with your training apps like Strava, Runna, Garmin, Runkeeper, Apple Watch, and more

Optimize your shoe lifespan. Rotate your gear smartly. Avoid injury from worn-out shoes. Whether you’re a casual walker or a competitive runner, SHOOZ is your shoe’s best companion.

bluejetty:00064623:ios.description:
A new easy way to pay your Local Earned Income Tax in Pennsylvania!
If you live in a PA district where Berkheimer is the collector, you can use this app to easily submit and file your local EIT tax returns.
* Fast, Easy Filing!
* Get your refund sooner!
* Save time!
* Save postage!
* Save paper and trees!
Currently two scenarios are supported:
1. Submit a completed paper return.
If you have completed a Local Earned Income Tax Return, you can take photos of the return, any supporting documents and schedules, enter the amount owed or the refund amount, pay by credit card, and submit your return to Berkheimer.
2. Generate an EZ return if you only have W2s.
If your EIT Return can be completed with only W2s, then you can take photos of your W2s and enter your employer and wage information. The app will calculate your tax liability or refund. You can then pay by credit card and submit right in the app.
More filing scenarios will be added as we add more functionality to the app.
It's all part of our mission to make filing your PA taxes as easy as possible!

bluejetty:00177549:ios.description:
Experience Borussia Dortmund! The official BVB app is your ultimate matchday guide to the Bundesliga, DFB-Cup and UEFA Champions League. Don't miss any more highlights or news and stay up to date with everything that's happening at BVB, wherever you are. Get the app now and become part of the black and yellow family!
The functions at a glance:
News: The app's start screen shows you the most relevant news, videos, and social media posts about BVB. Swipe up and down to be up to date immediately and discover all news.
Teams: An overview of the squads of our first team and U23. Discover more information and all statistics about our players.
Match Schedule: Find plenty of numbers, data, and facts about the latest BVB seasons in the "Schedule" module. Simply filter by season and competition, select a matchday, and you'll see the lineup, tables, fixtures, and statistics. In addition to the first team, you'll also find the women and U23 matches in the overview.
Netradio & Matchday: The countdown shows you how long you have to wait until the next match of the first team. On matchday, we go full throttle and report live from Dortmund or away games with our ticker starting at 09:09 AM: the best companion for all BVB fans. Of course, this includes the netradio with Nobby and Boris.
Mini Games: Predict the starting lineup up to 90 minutes before kickoff and compete with your friends. Share your opinion by participating in the polls of the day.
Order & Collect: Enjoy the stadium experience without waiting! With our order & collect service, you can conveniently pre-order snacks and drinks via the app and pick them up at the fast lane at selected kiosks.
Your BVB: If you want to experience Borussia, this is the place for you. Here you'll find events and experiences, shops, media offerings, and much more. Everything to make black-and-yellow hearts beat faster.
Push Notifications: Never miss a highlight again with our super-fast push notifications. Watching the game via livestream? Choose delayed delivery to avoid spoilers. For visually impaired users, there's also an option to have push notifications read aloud.
Your opinions, wishes and needs are very important to us. This app is for you and you can use it to tell us what you want. What's great, what could be better? Do you have any new ideas? Then please give us feedback via the ratings.

The functions at a glance:

News: The app's start screen shows you the most relevant news, videos, and social media posts about BVB. Swipe up and down to be up to date immediately and discover all news.

Teams: An overview of the squads of our first team and U23. Discover more information and all statistics about our players.

Match Schedule: Find plenty of numbers, data, and facts about the latest BVB seasons in the "Schedule" module. Simply filter by season and competition, select a matchday, and you'll see the lineup, tables, fixtures, and statistics. In addition to the first team, you'll also find the women and U23 matches in the overview.

Netradio & Matchday: The countdown shows you how long you have to wait until the next match of the first team. On matchday, we go full throttle and report live from Dortmund or away games with our ticker starting at 09:09 AM: the best companion for all BVB fans. Of course, this includes the netradio with Nobby and Boris.

Mini Games: Predict the starting lineup up to 90 minutes before kickoff and compete with your friends. Share your opinion by participating in the polls of the day.

Order & Collect: Enjoy the stadium experience without waiting! With our order & collect service, you can conveniently pre-order snacks and drinks via the app and pick them up at the fast lane at selected kiosks.

Your BVB: If you want to experience Borussia, this is the place for you. Here you'll find events and experiences, shops, media offerings, and much more. Everything to make black-and-yellow hearts beat faster.

Push Notifications: Never miss a highlight again with our super-fast push notifications. Watching the game via livestream? Choose delayed delivery to avoid spoilers. For visually impaired users, there's also an option to have push notifications read aloud.

Your opinions, wishes and needs are very important to us. This app is for you and you can use it to tell us what you want. What's great, what could be better? Do you have any new ideas? Then please give us feedback via the ratings.

bluejetty:00150818:ios.summary:

We are not concerned with pace or elevation, only distance. Run or walk wherever you are, whatever time y
bluejetty:00150818:ios.description:
Choose from one of 9 maps and then record all the STRUCTURED runs and walks to virtually run the country or continent of your choice.
We are not concerned with pace or elevation, only distance. Run or walk wherever you are, whatever time you like at whatever speed you like and upload it to our App to track you on a virtual journey. The distance you upload will move you along your map, no matter where you are.
We automate with Strava, whereby your running, walking and hiking distance will automatically upload to our App. Alternatively, you can add manual entries by providing evidence using any other device (other than step counting profiles).
We are not a Step counter…. All runs and walks must be structured, meaning no step profiles or incidental activity can be added, only runs or walks where you make the conscious decision to get out the door or off the couch.
Your journey is a long-term commitment - broken down into smaller segments along the way. Emails are sent every time you reach towns and cities during your journey. Educational and informative, these milestones keep you motivated and engaged during your membership.
* Monthly competitions are held to further enhance your experience. As part of your membership these monthly competitions will provide an extra tool to keep you motivated on your journey.
* Interact with Friends. Communicate with them via the App and track their journey via their map and leader boards. Get your running club involved and set up a team with your own leader boards and group chats.
* Leader boards will also help with motivation. Filter by your map, your gender, your age, weekly, monthly, yearly and overall to see how you are going against the rest of the database or filter to see how you are going against your friends or your running club.
* Check out a vast array of stats as you accumulate runs and walks. Your profile is easily accessible and keeps you accountable.
And we are more than just an App – we are a community. Keep an eye out for social catch ups, finishers celebrations, organized member events and
more – all part of your membership.
Free for 28 Days. Then monthly subscription available.
Subscription pricing and terms:
The Run the World subscription starts with a free 28-day trial. At the end of the free trial period you will be automatically subscribed and charged monthly unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. We offer monthly auto-renewing subscription to provide you with unlimited access to the App while you maintain an active subscription. Your monthly subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal in the Apple App store Account Settings after purchase, or cancel your subscription at least 24-hours prior to the end of the subscription period. Payment is charged to your payment method through your Apple App store account at the confirmation of purchase.
Read our terms and conditions for more information:
https://www.runsoftheworld.com/terms-conditions-and-privacy
