bluejetty:00093059:ios.description:
In 2007 Mary Devitt opened Crossroads Coffeehouse as a gathering place for the community of Cross Plains and visitors enjoying the Driftless Region. Since then, she has cultivated relationships and grown a community within these four walls (and beyond) through sponsored events and countless hours of volunteering but most times, just through a simple cup of coffee and conversation. At the end of 2020, Mary decided to trade in her ownership mug for a retirement one and pass that baton on to us. But don’t worry, you’ll see her around the shop for a while.
We are excited for the opportunity to continue Mary’s legacy while she enjoys a well-deserved retirement. Our intentions are to keep her unwavering dedication to high-quality coffee, tea, food and, most importantly, exemplary customer service, as our number one priority. With a shift in ownership comes change and while we do embrace it, we also think everyone’s had just about enough of it in 2020 so we’ll try to make this transition as seamless as possible.

bluejetty:00066365:ios.description:
Explore the wild jungle as a powerful tiger! This visually stunning RPG will let you develop your character and upgrade your skills to become the strongest cat out there. Try your skills in one of two modes: CO-OP or PVP - everything in Online Real-Time Multiplayer. Play with people from all over the World!
Online Real-Time Multiplayer RPG
Stunning 3D graphics
Beautiful environment
Realistic animals
Character development and upgrades
Cooperative multiplayer hunting and PVP Battle Arena modes
Clans system with Global Rankings
Smooth performance
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER SIMULATOR
Meet other tigers in real time and conquer the jungles and forests! With them or against them - it’s up to you, but you’re never alone in the wilderness. Join players from all around the World!
CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
Create your own tiger! Choose your favorite - the Asian Tiger? White Tiger? Or maybe the rare Gold Tiger? Whichever reflects your character the best - it’s all up to you!
RPG SYSTEM
Decide which attributes to develop and which skills to upgrade to become the strongest out there! Make your progres even faster by completing daily quests. Choose wisely, because you’re the king of your own destiny!
AMAZING GRAPHICS
Starting from your den all the way to the depths of the forest, the high-end graphics will leave you amazed. Chase the realistic animals and enjoy the beautiful environment!
VARIOUS GAME MODES
Choose your gameplay style! The hunting mode lets you cooperate with other players and search for bigger prey together. If you need more, try yourself in the PVP mode and fight against a team of enemy tigers. Be prepared for tough battles!
BECOME KING OF THE JUNGLE
Become the strongest one and achieve the highest rank as you can! Earn Combat Points by developing your character. Compete with other players and make your way to the podium of Global Rankings!
DEMONSTRATE YOUR LEADERSHIP 
Create your own Clan and lead it to victory! Join the Weekly Bounty challenge together to make your members stronger. Compete with other Clans and show them your domination!

bluejetty:00120585:ios.summary:
Solar Alert warns you about solar storms before they hit, and explains what they mean.
When the Sun turns active, the consequences reach us down here: degraded communications, unreliable satellite navigation, electronics behaving strangely
bluejetty:00120585:ios.description:
Solar Alert warns you about solar storms before they hit, and explains what they mean.
When the Sun turns active, the consequences reach us down here: degraded communications, unreliable satellite navigation, electronics behaving strangely and power grids under strain. Solar Alert watches the Sun around the clock, warns you when something deserves your attention, and tells you what to do with that head start.
HOW IT WORKS
We continuously analyze data from NOAA, NASA and other official observatories. Every minute, our algorithm checks whether you should receive an alert based on your preferences. If it detects a relevant risk, we alert you up to 3 days in advance, and we don't just warn you: we explain what is happening, how it may affect you and what you can do to protect yourself.
WITH TIME TO REACT, YOU CAN:
√ Stay ahead of communication failures and of the instability affecting the electronics of vehicles, aircraft and air traffic control.
√ Disconnect and isolate your solar panel installation and your appliances in time, protecting them from grid surges and reducing the risk of fire at home.
√ Avoid being trapped in elevators, trains or other electromechanical systems when the power supply turns unreliable.
√ Calmly get water, food, light and a backup way to communicate ready, following the checklist of precautions included in the app.
WHAT YOU WILL FIND INSIDE
• Automatic early warning, with a severity level, concrete recommendations and alerts in five languages.
• Contextual help throughout the app: tap the help button on any screen and Solar Alert explains what you are looking at. More than 900 explanations at two levels, with a tutorial mode that walks you through step by step.
• A history of your last fifty alerts, each with its image and full detail.
• A forecast tuned to your latitude, using automatic location or simply typing your city. Your location stays on your device; we do not share it with third parties.
• Solar Plasma Monitor: how a storm travels from the Sun to the Earth.
• Seven scientific panels that refresh on their own every minute.
• Images of the Sun across 42 observation channels, the OVATION aurora map in full screen, and a photo gallery.
• A checklist of preparations and precautions to take before an extreme storm arrives.
TRY IT BEFORE YOU DECIDE
Solar Alert has a free version with the essentials. And you can open the Premium content for 30 minutes, once, with no payment and nothing to cancel afterwards.
14 YEARS BEHIND EVERY ALERT
Solar Alert has been on the App Store since 2012, with a 4.7 average rating. Behind it there is more than an app: a team, our own server and data from official observatories and agencies, running every single day. Cloning a few good-looking screens is easy today; keeping an alert system you can trust running for fourteen years is not.
When the next big storm arrives, you will want to be warned. And you will want to understand what it means.
Solar Alert is an alert and protection service for extreme solar events, available through an auto-renewable subscription.
Payment is charged to your Apple account upon confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. The renewal charge is applied within the 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions on your device.
If the subscription includes a free trial period, any unused portion is forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
The price and duration of each plan are shown on the subscription screen before you confirm the purchase.
Terms of use and privacy policy: https://www.solaralertapp.com/EULA&Privacy-policy.html

The mobile application from UniCredit Bank is intuitive, safe and it helps you to save time for the things that really matter.

Black Humor is finally available in the App Store!
This satirical, ironical and politically in-correct game will blow your mind and make your parties go on fire!
How does the game work?
Preparation phase
You will be presented with 10 answer cards. These are the cards that are in your hand that you can use to fill in the blanks in the question cards. No one else can see your answer cards until you play them. 
Game phase
You will also see one question card. This card contains a sentence you will need to fill with one (or more where requested) answer card in your hand. Try to pick the card that makes the sentence in the question card most funny, satirical, ironical, or whatever you stupid kids are into these days. Btw, the answer card you just used will be immediately replaced with a answer card drawn from the deck, so you will always have answer 10 cards.
Judgement phase
Now the best part of the game happens: the judge will need to pick the winning answer card from the list of shuffled and anonymised replies that every player gave. Once the judge chooses a answer card the player who played it gets one point and becomes the judge for the next round.
It’s so easy that maybe even you can play this game. Or well.. maybe not.

bluejetty:00175203:ios.summary:
Write naturally with your Apple Pencil on Live Paper with Penbook.

bluejetty:00175203:ios.description:
Write naturally with your Apple Pencil on Live Paper with Penbook.
Build your perfect notebook from more than four hundred types of stationery. Then, use the best digital inking technology to pour your ideas, notes, plans, and dreams into it.
Penbook's Live Paper is way smarter than ordinary stationery. Schedule your life on a monthly planner that shows a real calendar, organize your day with a day planner that shows you what time it is, and record your nutrition on a food diary that knows what day it is.
Or, bring your own stationery! Import your PDFs into Penbook for quick annotation and editing. 
Give your notebooks colorful covers with fun art, and share them so your notes are always where you need them.
FEATURES
• Live Paper, the dynamic stationery that uses the smarts of your iPad and iPhone
• Over 400 of academic, scientific, and planning stationeries
• Import PDFs and use them as notebooks
• Write naturally with your Apple Pencil, stylus, or finger
• Unlimited unique cover combinations for your notes
• Search your handwritten notes for words or phrases
• Snap your strokes to perfect shapes with shape recognition
INCLUDED STATIONERIES
Penbook has a huge selection of customizable stationery. Each page of your notebook can be different, turning your iPad or iPhone into a magic notebook:
• Blank stationery, with an optional date and configurable margin
• Ruled paper with variable density
• Graph paper with four options for square sizes
• Dot stationery, either squared or isometric (offset)
• Cross stationery with configurable margins and density
• To Do pages with four layout options
• Monthly habit paper for tracking streaks, habits, and goals
• Day planner paper with a live updating timeline and calendar, and three layouts
• Weekly planner paper that highlights the current time and date
• Monthly planner paper that keeps track of the current day and shows you what's coming next
• Yearly stationery for getting a complete overview of your next 365 days
• Cornell paper for taking perfect study notes
• French ruled (Séyès) paper
• Penmanship practice paper
• Table stationery for hand-written spreadsheets
• Polar graph paper for plotting radial data
• Semi-log and loglog paper for data with exponential growth or decay
• Isometric stationery with equilateral (60-60-60) or isosceles (75-75-30) triangles
• Perspective paper, configurable with one, two, or three vanishing points
• Developer stationery with device stencils and configurable note-taking areas
• Storyboard paper with 3 frame aspect ratios
• Engineering paper with variable density
• Chemistry paper for easily sketching molecules
• Staff and tablature (music) paper with optional linked staves
GET THE MOST OUT OF PENBOOK
Use all of Penbook's stationery and writing features in a single notebook for free for as long as you like.
Upgrade to Penbook Premium to create and export unlimited notebooks, receive access to new stationery and covers as they're designed, and get regular app updates.
Penbook Premium is available by purchasing a yearly subscription or a one-time (lifetime) in-app purchase.
When you choose to upgrade with the yearly subscription, you can start using Penbook Premium for free with a 7-day free trial. During the trial, cancel any time until 24 hours before the trial expires, and you will not be charged. If you do not cancel, you will be automatically billed for the yearly subscription when your free trial ends. 
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Our customer-first privacy policy: https://penbook.app/privacy-policy
Penbook's terms of use: https://penbook.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00170558:ios.description:
Ragdoll: Break the Ragdoll is a thrilling adventure of physics-based excitement with ragdoll fall! Immerse yourself in the ultimate stress-relieving experience as you break the ragdoll bone and navigate through challenging simulations. Play one of the craziest ragdoll break bones simulation games ever! Get ready to break ragdoll bone! Crush, throw, punch and kick your way to ultimate stress relief in a ragdoll game. This dummy ragdoll breaker is designed to relax your mind and keep you hooked with its satisfying gameplay. 
In Dummy Ragdoll Break Bone, after a hard day's work your goal is to break ragdoll bone in the most entertaining way. Navigate descents, bouncing off construction cranes, cars, floors, pendulum ball and various surfaces to maximize the bone breaking experience. The more ragdoll bones you break, the higher your score. Collect game points to unlock a variety of quirky skins for your wooden dummy ragdoll, adding an extra layer of fun to the ragdoll breaking physics simulation game.
This is a simple yet fun break ragdoll game that combines the thrill of breaking a ragdoll bone with the maximum relaxation and enjoyment of a physics simulation game.
Challenge yourself to reach new records, aiming to get the highest score. As you do, unlock more challenging levels to break your trump ragdoll. So, get ready to get down, ragdoll breaking bones and relax in the easiest break challenge ever!
Dummy Ragdoll Break Bone is a physics fun and exciting ragdoll break 3D game. bluejetty:00136052:ios.description:
Scan QR and barcodes in seconds!
Easily create your own custom QR codes.
Secure your accounts with the built-in 2FA Authenticator!
Instantly check product info and prices for smarter shopping!
ScanMaster is a powerful and user-friendly iOS app designed to transform your smartphone into a versatile barcode and QR code scanner — now with a built-in two-factor authentication (2FA) tool to keep your online accounts safe. With ScanMaster, you can effortlessly scan various types of barcodes and QR codes using your device's camera, generate your own QR codes, and manage your 2FA codes all in one place, making it an essential tool for both personal and professional use.
Key Features:
Scan Barcodes and QR Codes: With ScanMaster, simply point your device's camera at any barcode or QR code, and the app will quickly and accurately scan and decode the information. Whether you're scanning product barcodes, ticket QR codes, or promotional QR codes, ScanMaster has got you covered.
2FA Authenticator: Protect your online accounts with the built-in two-factor authentication tool. ScanMaster generates secure, time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) for your favorite services — including Google, Facebook, Instagram, X, GitHub, Amazon, and more. Simply scan the QR code provided by the service to add an account, and ScanMaster will display your rotating 6-digit verification codes whenever you need them. All 2FA secrets are stored locally and securely on your device.
History of Scans: The app maintains a comprehensive history of all your previous scans, allowing you to revisit and access the scanned information whenever needed. You can conveniently browse through your scan history, view the details, and even share the results with others.
Organized Scan History: ScanMaster organizes your scan history chronologically, making it easy to find specific scans based on the date and time they were performed. You can also search for particular scan results using keywords to find information quickly.
Save and Export: If you want to keep a record of specific scans for future reference, ScanMaster enables you to save the scan results locally on your device. Furthermore, you can export the scan history as a CSV file, making it simple to share, backup, or analyze the data.
Scan Accuracy and Speed: ScanMaster utilizes advanced barcode and QR code recognition technology to ensure high accuracy and quick scanning. The app can effortlessly read codes, even in low-light conditions, for a seamless scanning experience.
Real-Time Feedback: The app provides real-time feedback during scanning, giving you visual and audio cues when a successful scan is made. This feature ensures that you can effortlessly capture the code without any guesswork.
Customizable Settings: Tailor the app to suit your preferences by adjusting various settings. Customize scan sounds, choose the default actions for different types of codes, and adjust display preferences to make ScanMaster work just the way you like.
Privacy and Security: ScanMaster prioritizes user privacy and data security. The app does not store any personal or sensitive information from the scans, and all 2FA account secrets stay on your device — never uploaded to any server — ensuring your data remains confidential and protected.
Whether you're a business professional, a retail enthusiast, or someone who simply wants a faster, more secure way to manage codes and logins, ScanMaster offers a simple, efficient, and reliable all-in-one solution. Unlock the potential of your iOS device and download ScanMaster today to enjoy hassle-free barcode scanning, QR code creation, and secure 2FA authentication — all at your fingertips!
Note:
You can find the Terms of Use here: https://www.tensortechapps.com/tandc

bluejetty:00174723:ios.description:
Meet Moodee, your own little mood guide!
Everyone has bad days. Find out how to manage your mood with Moodee.
■ Look back on your emotions
Sometimes it’s hard to put a name to what you’re feeling. Research shows that simply labeling your emotion can be an immense help in dealing with it. In Moodee, you have access to a large variety of emotion tags that will help you identify exactly what you’re feeling in this moment. Make it a routine to reflect on your emotions and put time into understanding yourself better. 
■ AI-recommended quests for your mood
When you’re feeling overwhelmed by an emotion, it’s hard to think about what you should do to make it better. Whether you're feeling upbeat or low, Moodee will give you curated quest recommendations for how you can make your day better. Discover small to-dos and routines that you can try out right away.
■ In-depth analysis of your emotional records
Check out detailed stats about you, from frequently recorded emotions to your to-do preferences. Get monthly and annual reports to gain deeper insights about yourself - and understand what you feel, what you like, and what you need.
■ Rewire your brain to think different with Training
Do you have any thinking habits that make you feel bad? Neuroplasticity theory says that our brains can be rewired with repeated practice. With Moodee’s Training, you can go through various fictional scenarios and practice thinking in a different way - whether it be to be more optimistic, or feel less guilty on a daily basis.
■ Talk with animal friends in interactive Stories
Various animal friends who are trapped in their stories have come to you for help! Listen to what they have to say, help them figure out what they need, and guide them to their happy ending. In the process, perhaps you’ll discover a piece of yourself in them.
■ Your most private emotion journal
Build your own private and honest emotion journal, just by using Moodee daily. You can lock your Moodee app with a secure passcode, so that no one but you will have access to your honest feelings. Feel free to say anything you want, anytime you want.

bluejetty:00149339:ios.description:
The STIM onTrack™ mobile app provides tools and information for patients to help them use their bone growth therapy device daily as prescribed by their physician. 
STIM onTrack app features for patients: 
• Create daily treatment reminders
• View your treatment as shown on your connected device
• Track treatment history with a daily treatment calendar
• Sync with activity trackers to view Step and Resting Heart Rate averages
• Connect with an Orthofix Sales Rep or Patient Services with one-touch calling
• Send in-app messages to Patient Care
• Access answers to commonly asked questions 
• Learn how Orthofix Bone Growth Stimulation Therapy devices support fracture healing and spinal fusion success rates 
• Complete a standardized Patient Reported Outcomes Measure (PROM) questionnaire and Patient Experience Survey 
For more information, visit BoneGrowthTherapy.com
STIM onTrack mobile app is available in English, French, and Spanish and distributed in the U.S. and Canada. 
STIM onTrack mobile app does not share any data with third-party data brokers, and does not use any linked third-party data for marketing or advertising purposes.

bluejetty:00070567:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
Games: Users can enjoy a variety of games served in app. Games include: Sudoku, Solitaire, Jumble, Crossword, and Puzzles

Boukili encourages children to read
bluejetty:00014132:ios.description:
Boukili, presented by Groupe média TFO, provides an immersive, interactive and educational reading experience for children ages 4 and up, whether they are native to the language or still learning French.
Boukili encourages children to read and supports them by offering a collection of hundreds of illustrated books grouped by reading level, theme and skill. Boukili offers different reading modes to young readers according to their needs: narration mode (listening to the book), solo mode (independent reading) or voice recording mode.
Boukili is a customizable tool for teachers, parents and children. Teachers have access to a dashboard allowing them to:
create a profile for each student (unlimited number of students!)
assign readings to students according to their level and interests
listen to student recordings
view the progress of each student
send messages of encouragement
A version adapted for parents also gives them access to a dashboard where they can track and guide their child’s progress.
Boukili makes learning to read fun by offering quizzes and a cute avatar to customize. The theme of travel is ever-present, with the possibility of unlocking countries to discover. Children gain confidence while discovering the wonderful world of reading!
Have a nice trip!

bluejetty:00115159:ios.description:
Curious about how your baby might look in the future? This app makes the experience fun, fast, and full of surprises! In just a few taps, you can mix two photos and instantly see an adorable baby prediction. Perfect for couples, friends, or anyone who wants to add a touch of laughter and imagination to everyday moments.
From discovering who the baby might look like, to experimenting with celebrity mashups or trying creative face swaps, this app is designed for entertainment as much as curiosity. Share the results with friends and family, keep them in your gallery, or simply enjoy the fun of watching AI create something magical in seconds.
Future Baby Generator – Select two photos and let AI reveal your possible baby’s face.
Like Parent Test – Compare features and see which parent your little one could resemble most.
Celebrity Mashups – Wonder what your baby with a movie star would look like? Try it for a hilarious surprise!
Face Swap Fun – Pick group photos and swap faces instantly for guaranteed laughs.
Baby Names Finder – Browse through creative baby name ideas, learn their origins, and discover what’s trending around the world.
Aging Preview – Watch your predicted baby grow from a sweet toddler to a teenager and beyond.
*Enjoy better tools:
- Unlimited baby predictions with no limits.
- Exclusive tools like face swaps, aging previews, and advanced mashups.
- Ad-free experience for smoother use.
- Continuous feature updates with exciting new options.
Unlimited Plan:
Week Package.

bluejetty:00070846:ios.description:
■ Apple Recommendation App
■ Product Introduction
A short hour or so in the morning (Sunrise) and evening (Sunset) of a day is the 'golden time' in photography. At this time, the sun is relatively low in the sky. The sun light gives the scene rich shadows to make the photos more texture.
'Golden time' will be slightly different due to the geographical location and time. In order to pursue the most perfect effect, photography lovers need to know the precise time. The "Sun & Moon" app can accurately calculate the 'sunrise and sunset', 'golden time', 'Blues time' and 'moon phase' of each day, so that users can prepare for taking the best photos.
■ Product Functions
- Precise Time: Sunrise and sunset, golden hour, blue hour, moon phase
- Photo Sharing: Create a long pictures to share with your friends on social platform quickly.
- Recent Preview: View the precise time of the day for nearly 7 days.
- Global Position: View the precise time of any city all over the world (Premium).
- Calendar Overview: View the precise time of any future date (Premium).
- Timely Reminder: Never miss a good sunrise or sunset (Premium).
■ About Me
- Personal works
Apple Recommend App: Sun & Moon, Flaaash, Easy Period, Time Arrow, Lover List
- Contact Information
My Email: hanchongzan＠icloud.com
If you have any suggestions and ideas, you can send messages me at any time. I will continue to develop more good applications.
■ Terms of Use
Sun & Moon Premium Subscription is a subscription-based paid-up service, which means that you will pay in advance for future use of the service. You can currently choose to pay the service on an annual basis. At the end of each subscription cycle, your subscription is automatically renewed by default unless you explicitly cancel the automatic renewal or cancelled by Sun & Moon.
- Fees:
Now Premium is set a standard fee as $1.49 per year. This price may be changed during promotion period. If the price is adjusted, the new price will take effect for the next subscription cycle.
- Refund:
After the trial period, you shall never be refunded the fee. Please voluntarily cancel your payment of service.
- Unsubscribe:
If you want to unsubscribe, please cancel it at least 24 hours in advance. You can cancel it as follow steps: Enter Into The System Settings - Click Apple ID - Click Subscription - Select Sun & Moon Premium - unsubscribe.

bluejetty:00115447:ios.description:

Welcome to TopTop — the ultimate social gaming app where fun meets friendship!

Who’s the Undercover, Toppy Park, ONO, IQ Games, and more!

Join voice rooms and chat with people from around the world. Whether you're into music, games, sports, or just good vibes, there's a space for you. No need to show your face — just be yourself, talk freely, and build real connections in a relaxed, fun space

bluejetty:00069993:ios.description:
A simple calculator for your iPad with unit & currency converter and multitasking mode. Get it now for free!
Calculator Pro main features:
 - Basic calculator in Portrait Mode
 - Scientific calculator in Landscape Mode
 - Universal converter for Currency, Length, Time, Weight, Pressure, Temperature, Fuel Consumption, Speed and many more categories
 - Multitasking mode: use Calculator Pro and any other app simultaneously 
Calculator Pro+ for iPad is designed for everyone looking for simplicity and functionality. Enjoy basic calculations in Portrait Mode with big handy buttons, or make complex calculations in scientific calculator, available in Landscape Mode. Calculator Pro is the only one calculator needed for math classes from primary school through college. The app is great in basic everyday calculations and solving complex problems in physics, astronomy or chemistry as well. 
Need to convert one unit to another? With the intuitive and beautifully designed converter, you can easily switch between currencies, temperatures, length, speed and other numerous units, and continue calculation without interruptions.
Features: 
• Two modes are available: do basic calculations in Portrait Mode or go advanced in Landscape Mode
• Degrees and Radians calculations
• History Bar: see your full calculation history directly on the screen
• Track Calculations History: view, save, delete selected equation or clear all
• Universal converter with 19 categories, including Currency, Length, Time, Weight, Pressure, Temperature, Area, Data Size, Energy, Force, Frequency, Power, Acceleration, Density, Angle, Typography, Volume, Fuel Consumption and Speed
• Handy text search to find categories and units instantly
• Multitasking mode: bring in Calculator Pro while viewing web pages, photos, taking notes and more to get results instantly! 
• Calculator Pro is now accessible via VoiceOver as well
• Smart Keyboard support: take full advantage of seamless and intuitive calculations on your iPad Pro 
• Pick the look from a bunch of skins to suit your own preference (Modern, Rose, Wood, Old, Doodle, Minimalistic, Zombie, Yellow, New Year)
• Memory buttons to help you out with complex calculations
• Accidentally input the wrong number? Just swipe with your finger to edit it!
• Copy and paste results and expressions directly into the current calculation
• Comment on the equation and send the calculation results with comments via email
Now you can do calculations on the go seamlessly!
For complete access to all Calculator Pro+ for iPad features, you will need to allow access to the following: 
*Location data - this will enable automatic currency selection in the Converter.

bluejetty:00065222:ios.description:
Plan trips together, beautifully.
Pogo is the all-in-one trip planner for saving travel inspiration, building personalized itineraries, organizing reservations, and keeping every part of your trip in one place.
Whether you’re traveling solo, planning with a partner, organizing a group getaway, or coordinating a family vacation, Pogo makes it easy to turn scattered ideas into one organized plan.
PLAN TOGETHER
Create a dedicated Pinboard for every trip and invite friends, family, or travel companions to collaborate. Everyone can save places, add ideas, and help shape the itinerary - without losing links in texts, notes, screenshots, or group chats.
SAVE PLACES AND TRAVEL INSPIRATION
Pin restaurants, hotels, attractions, hidden gems, and must-see spots to your trip. Use Pogo’s AI-powered search to discover ideas based on your destination and interests, then save your favorites in a tap.
BUILD A PERSONALIZED ITINERARY
Turn your saved ideas into a clear day-by-day travel plan. With Pogo Magic, Pogo Plus members can generate a personalized AI itinerary tailored to their interests and travel style.
KEEP RESERVATIONS ORGANIZED
Add or import existing flight, hotel, restaurant, and activity reservations. Keep all your booking details alongside your itinerary, so everything you need is easy to find.
SEARCH HOTELS AND FLIGHTS
Explore hotel and flight options through Pogo’s travel partners, including Booking.com and Skyscanner, then continue with the partner to complete your booking. Save your plans and booking details to your Pinboard for easy access.
SEE YOUR TRIP ON A MAP
View all your saved Pins on a personalized map. See what’s nearby, group activities by area, plan routes, and visualize your trip at a glance.
PACK, PREP, AND GO
Create packing lists and travel checklists, and keep important documents such as boarding passes, tickets, and confirmations together in Pogo.
SAVE DREAM TRIPS WITH POGO POCKET
Not ready to choose your next destination? Save interesting places, travel ideas, and inspiration to Pogo Pocket. When you’re ready, turn those saved ideas into a new trip.
UPGRADE WITH POGO PLUS
Unlock Pogo Magic for personalized AI itineraries, plus custom categories, custom icons, and additional ways to personalize your travel planning.
Subscription options and pricing are shown in the app.
From weekend getaways and city breaks to road trips and once-in-a-lifetime adventures, Pogo helps you plan every journey from inspiration to itinerary.
Pogo is free to download, with optional in-app subscriptions.
Download Pogo and start planning your next trip.
---

bluejetty:00129637:ios.name: CardZap: Digital Business Card
bluejetty:00129637:ios.summary:
A Free digital business card app to help you create professional ecards and share your details in a modern, cheap, efficient, and most importantly secure way.
Create digital business cards and share them with anyone even if they don’t have
bluejetty:00129637:ios.description:
A Free digital business card app to help you create professional ecards and share your details in a modern, cheap, efficient, and most importantly secure way.
Create digital business cards and share them with anyone even if they don’t have CardZap. Create as many eCards as you want for free. CardZap's digital business cards serve as a vital asset for enhancing the worth of your business relationships. 
In contrast to conventional business cards, CardZap's digital alternatives enable you to uphold brand uniformity, offer enhanced functionality, prove to be a more budget-friendly option, and have a more sustainable impact on the environment.
You can choose a premium business card template or create your own. Also CardZap allows you to create multiple digital business cards: one for work, one for home, one for a person you just happened to meet and don’t want to give all your details to. It can be customized with colors and fonts to match your corporate brand. For personal business cards, you can add photos and choose from lots of colors and fonts.
Premium Design, Lasting Impact
Skip the design struggle. Stand out with CardZap! Explore our different prebuilt templates made for various industries. Choose a template that aligns well with your needs, customize it, and make a lasting impression in no time. 
Quick & Easy Sharing
You can share your digital business card via personalized texts and emails, sharing your card’s URL or getting your virtual business card’s QR code scanned.
You can also share the card with a branded QR code, iMessage, through Apple Watch, on social media, through Airdrop, NFC, and more.
Business Contact Manager (Calendar and Map View)
Easily keep track of everyone you meet. This means when you scan any digital business card or physical business card within CardZap, it stores the date & place where you met them. So even if you forget the person’s name, you can find them if you know the date or location where you meet them.
Physical Card Scanning
CardZap is the most accurate business card scanner app. Scan physical business cards and extract contact details with unmatched precision. Access your scanned contacts anytime, anywhere!
Analytics 
Turn deep insights about card usage into a lead source with CardZap’s in-app analytics. Gain valuable insights into your network interactions. Track engagements, measure effectiveness, and refine your marketing strategies. (How many views for cards and how many shares of business cards)
What are LiveCards?
If you're sharing a digital business card with somebody who already has CardZap then when you update that eCard, they automatically receive the updates. If you change your job or your email (or even the photo on the card), they will get these updates. They'll never lose contact with you again!
When somebody shares an eCard with you via CardZap, you have the option to automatically send your details back to them. You can choose which card you want to send and then they have your details in their eCard list too!
About Us
We're a passionate team of innovators and technophiles who believe that the traditional business card has had its day. With backgrounds in technology, design, and entrepreneurship, we set out to create a smarter, more sustainable, and environmentally friendly solution for sharing contact information. CardZap envisions a world where networking is seamless, sustainable, and smart. 
CardZap is more than just a digital business card platform. It's your gateway to efficient networking and powerful connections. With CardZap, you can create and customize multiple digital business cards, effortlessly share your contact information, and keep your network up-to-date in real-time.
Terms of Use

bluejetty:00029938:ios.name: Pollen Wise
bluejetty:00029938:ios.summary:
Pollen Wise has reached version 5! We've been hard at work transforming data from the network of Pollen Sense sensors into a model that includes greatly improved forecasting. 
Own Your Seasonal Allergies with Pollen Wise! Using a robust n
bluejetty:00029938:ios.description:
Pollen Wise has reached version 5! We've been hard at work transforming data from the network of Pollen Sense sensors into a model that includes greatly improved forecasting. 
Own Your Seasonal Allergies with Pollen Wise! Using a robust network of sensors around the United States and select other countries, Pollen Wise provides up-to-date pollen counts to help users mitigate allergens and avoid seasonal allergy symptoms. Customize Pollen Wise to put emphasis on the allergens that impact you the most, while still seeing levels across categories!
Pollen Wise is the only seasonal allergy app providing hourly allergen reports! Competing apps either use counts from yesterday or various other algorithms based on daily counts.
The advanced Automated Particle Sensor (APS) by Pollen Sense uses AI image processing to analyze images taken via a microscope to identify and classify allergens down to individual species. Particularly sensitive to Ragweed? Pollen Wise has you covered! Specific trees during tree season have your nose running? APS sensors find those too!
Airborne particulate levels can vary dramatically through the day! With Pollen Wise, you can see an up-to-date snapshot of allergens nearby and better plan your outside time.
The allergen journal feature allows you to log your symptoms to later see snapshots of your symptoms and allergen levels at that time. Please consult with a specialist if you suffer from seasonal allergies. As airborne particulate levels are impacted by weather conditions, levels can change dramatically.
While many features of Pollen Wise are free, some features require a subscription (Pollen Wise Plus). Unlock access to more historical data, an upgraded journal experience, home/lock screen widgets, and more with Pollen Wise Plus!

bluejetty:00131259:ios.description:
Are you a fan of coloring games and drawing carnivals? Looking for a fun and creative way to relax? Check out the coloring game, Drawing Carnival, a color puzzle and joy doodle all rolled into one! With our coloring match and draw-it features, you can mix and match different art styles to create a unique masterpiece.
In this coloring game, you draw it! Unlock your inner artist and create a picture made up of different styles. Divide your favorite portrait or any painting into four parts. Spray paint, neon markers, gems, glitter powder... Every kind of painting you can imagine! 
With our diverse makeup kit, you can draw it all with different colors and styles to create the perfect look. And for those who are looking to de-stress in a color me happy headspace, our color page ASMR feature is sure to provide a satisfying sensory experience.
There are various beautiful images awaiting your joy doodle. Paint freely and relax but also challenge yourself to artistic color puzzles that combine various effects of makeup kit color palettes to create one outstanding work of art. Let's color match and take the colored pens with the right tools, draw different styles, and try to combine them. Put your different pictures together. Give it a try and show me how talented you are! It’s a Drawing Carnival and the show has just begun.
So what are you waiting for? Join the drawing carnival and let your joy doodle creativity run wild! Color me happy with your beautiful artwork and show off your talent to the world in this color page ASMR coloring game.
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our privacy policy: https://crazylabs.com/app

bluejetty:00019410:ios.description:
Skat Palace – Play a fun game of Skat live against real players.
Skat is the smart classic with German roots – for solo pros! Comparable to games such as Pinochle, Spades, and Doppelkopf, Skat requires tactical and deductive skills. You can now experience the popular card game online, for free, in the largest online card game community.
Whether you are a hardcore fan or a casual player, with us, you will always find an opponent at eye level. The joy of playing cards is our priority, and we invite you over to our card tables!
LIVE CARD GAME EXPERIENCE
- Play live against real opponents at any time.
- Experience an active community of players.
- Chat with other card game fans.
EASY TO PLAY
- No need to register; just start playing.
- Enjoy direct play thanks to automatic player search. 
- Make use of the handy bidding calculator in the game.
SKAT, AS YOU KNOW IT
- Use original Skat playing cards or house cards with optimized legibility.
- Choose your card deck: French, Tournament, German, … 
- Discover various special rules: Ramsch, Patrols, Tournament Scoring, and many more.
- Play with classic Skat rules or according to your personal preferences.
FAIR-PLAY COMES FIRST
- We provide constant support by our customer service team.
- Our card shuffling is independently tested and reliable.
- The privacy settings in the Skat Palace are flexibly adjustable.
HOBBY CARD GAME
- Gain experience and level up.
- Forget the stress and exercise your memory and tactics with Skat.
- Make your way through the league up to the top 10.
- In tournaments and at long-lasting tables, you can boost your endurance.
HOW TO PLAY SKAT
In the trick-taking game of Skat, a round consists of two phases: bidding and playing tricks. The bidding determines the declarer who is allowed to pick up the two remaining cards – the skat – and decides the conditions of trick-taking. This is followed by the actual trick-taking, in which you aim to win as many valuable cards as possible. When all cards have been played, evaluation ensues: If the declarer wins, they receive points resulting from the game value. For a lost game, however, double the game value is deducted.
Learn more about us and our games:
https://www.palace-of-cards.com/
NOTE:
You can download this app for free. It is permanently completely free to play. However, you can purchase optional game enhancements such as game chips, premium membership, and special playing cards within the game.
The game requires an active internet connection.
By downloading the app, you agree to our terms and conditions and our privacy policy.
TERMS & CONDITIONS:
https://www.skat-palast.de/terms-conditions/
PRIVACY POLICY:
 https://www.skat-palast.de/privacy-policy-apps/
CUSTOMER SERVICE:
If you need help, feel free to contact our friendly customer service:
support@skat-palast.de
Skat is mainly intended for an adult audience. According to German law, Skat is not a gambling game. In our app, there is no real money and no real prizes to win. Practice or success in casino games without real winnings ("Social Casino Games") does not imply future success in games for real money.
Skat Palace is a product by Spiele-Palast GmbH (Palace of Cards). Playing with family, friends, or dedicated groups is one of the favorite pastimes for many people! Our mission is to give this joy of playing a digital home at the Palace of Cards and build a lively community of players through high-quality implementations of online card games.
We wish you a good hand
Your Skat Palace Team

bluejetty:00019013:ios.description:
A murder has been reported on Ocean Shore, Detective. Welcome to Pacific Bay — where paradise has a dark side.
Criminal Case: Pacific Bay is the second season of the award-winning hidden object detective series that has turned more than 100 million players into detectives. Search crime scenes for clues, examine the evidence, interrogate the suspects — and when the proof is solid, arrest the killer yourself. Standalone story: no prior season needed.
INVESTIGATE CRIME SCENES
Every case starts at the scene of the crime. Search gorgeous hand-drawn locations for hidden objects and vital clues, race the clock for the best score, and earn the stars that move your investigation forward.
RUN THE LAB
Bring your findings to the Pacific Bay crime lab. Analyze samples, decode messages, reconstruct torn documents and match fingerprints. In this city, every detail talks — if you know how to listen.
INTERROGATE THE SUSPECTS
Bring witnesses and suspects in for questioning. Compare their statements with the facts, catch them lying, and profile your killer trait by trait until only one name is left.
ARREST THE KILLER
Most mystery games end when you find the last object. Criminal Case is where it gets serious: match the evidence to your suspects and put the right one behind bars. Get it wrong, and a killer walks free.
A WHOLE CITY TO CLEAN UP
From the boardwalk of Ocean Shore to the swamps of Bayou Bleu, from the movie studios of Ivywood Hills to the casinos of Paradise City — every neighborhood of Pacific Bay is a different slice of America, and every one of them hides a killer. Case after case, the deeper you dig, the clearer it becomes: something is rotten in paradise.
MEET YOUR PARTNERS
Officer Amy Young — rookie, brilliant, and far too honest for this city. Detective Frank Knight — veteran, cynical, and hiding more than he lets on. With Chief Marquez's team behind you and a coroner who swears the corpses talk to her, you never investigate alone.
FROM THE MAKERS OF THE ORIGINAL
Facebook Game of the Year 2013. More than 100 million detectives worldwide. Pacific Bay is season two of the saga that defined crime investigation games on mobile — still updated, still free, still one of a kind.
Cleaned up Pacific Bay back in the day? Welcome back, partner. Amy saved you a seat, and Frank saved you the paperwork.
BETTER WITH FRIENDS
Connect with your friends to team up on investigations, compare your detective skills on the leaderboards, and send each other energy and gifts.
SEASON 2 OF 8
Pacific Bay is one chapter of the Criminal Case saga. Start here, or go back to Grimsborough where it all began — then follow your badge around the world, through time, and all the way to Paris.
Criminal Case: Pacific Bay is free to play, with optional in-app purchases (you can disable these in your device settings).
Terms of Service: https://prettysimplegames.com/legal/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.prettysimplegames.com/legal/privacy-policy
The tide can wash away footprints, Detective. It can't wash away evidence.

*limited functionality is currently available within the mobile app.
¹Other fees and charges apply. ²The above estimations are calculated based on published rates for the Big Four banks.

bluejetty:00157763:ios.summary:

Wi
bluejetty:00157763:ios.description:
Community Transit's Zip Shuttle is a flexible way to travel around Snohomish County, WA. We’re an on-demand shared ride service that’s easy, affordable, and convenient. Adults ride for $2.50 or less, and youth 18 and younger ride free.
With a few taps, book a ride in the app, and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way.
HOW IT WORKS:
- When you're ready to go, book a ride in the app by providing your pick-up and drop-off locations, anywhere in our service area.
- Let us know whether you’re riding alone or with additional passengers.
- You will receive an estimated vehicle-arrival time upon booking your trip and be picked up where you requested. The driver’s estimated arrival time will automatically update as your vehicle makes its way to meet you.
- Be ready for your driver outside at the pick-up location.
- When your driver arrives, pay your fare and board the vehicle. Pay on board with an ORCA card or exact cash, or save your credit or debit payment method in the mobile app.
-There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way. Track your ride and share your status within the app in real-time.
AFFORDABLE:
Rides cost the same as a Community Transit bus fare — adults ride for $2.50 or less, and youth ride free.
RELIABLE:
Track your ride as the driver is on their way to you, and while you’re in the vehicle too. The app will provide real-time information for your pick-up and arrival time.
ACCESSIBLE:
Zip Shuttle is wheelchair accessible. If you require a wheelchair, simply toggle on “Wheelchair accessibility” in the “Account” tab of your app. When you request a ride, you’ll be matched with a wheelchair-accessible vehicle.
SHARING YOUR TRIP:
Our service matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience of an on-demand ride with the efficiency and affordability of public transit.
Questions or comments? Reach out at (833) 342- 5947.
Your feedback is important to us. Ride Zip Shuttle and let us know how we did!

Dreamy is your personal dream journal for quickly logging, organizing, and exploring your dreams over time. Add entries in seconds, then enrich them with details like mood, dream type, and personal int
bluejetty:00042627:ios.description:
Capture your dreams before they fade.
Dreamy is your personal dream journal for quickly logging, organizing, and exploring your dreams over time. Add entries in seconds, then enrich them with details like mood, dream type, and personal interpretation so every dream becomes easier to revisit and understand.
With Dreamy, you can:
 - Record dreams with title, full notes, mood, and type
 - Keep your entries organized with calendar and search tools
 - Attach photos, voice notes, and drawings to make memories more vivid
 - Review detailed dream screens and edit entries anytime
 - Spot patterns through visual statistics like dream frequency, mood trends, moon phase correlations, and sleep duration insights
 - Protect your journal with optional Face ID / Touch ID lock
 - Set reminders to build a consistent journaling habit
 - Export and import your dream history with JSON backup support
 - Personalize settings, default values, and dream field visibility
Dreamy is designed for both quick nightly logs and deep reflection, helping you build a meaningful archive of your inner world.
----
Dreamy uses auto-renewing subscriptions.
Dreamy Pro provides additional features like attaching a drawing, daily reminder, export & import dreams and screen customization.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
Terms of use: https://www.dreamy.app/terms-conditions.html
Privacy policy: https://www.dreamy.app/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00103635:android.description:
Presentation coming up but no time to practice? Prezi Viewer for Android is a free app that lets you view, practice, and present on the go. 
When you’re traveling to a big pitch or meeting, you can use the transit time to run through your presentation on your phone or tablet. Once you arrive, connect via bluetooth to your PC or Mac and present on the big screen. 
Let’s say you’re seated next to a killer prospect on the flight home. You can present your saved presentations offline, so you’ll never miss a connection. Prezi Viewer for Android means you’re always ready to deliver.
View, practice, or present, wherever life takes you
* Access and view all your presentations online or offline
* Enjoy the same smooth rendering you get with your computer
* Share your presentations via a link over email, messaging, or social media
* Leave feedback and comments on collaborative presentations
* Use intuitive touch gestures—pinch to zoom, and drag to pan around your canvas
* Connect your Android device to present on the big screen
Discover how Prezi makes you a better presenter
* Make messages more engaging and persuasive with visual storytelling

bluejetty:00131859:ios.description:
Embrace compassion and nurture positive emotions with the Loving Kindness app.
Loving Kindness meditations, also known as metta meditations, are an ancient Buddhist practice that inspires feelings of empathy, interconnectedness, and kindness toward all beings… including yourself.
With the Loving Kindness app, you’ll receive gentle reminders throughout your day encouraging you to take a moment, leave your surroundings aside, and focus on your heart-center.
Tailoring your Loving Kindness mantras to your lifestyle is simple:
- Choose topics that resonate with you.
- Customize your mantras to include people or groups in your life that need a little extra Loving Kindness.
- Select a schedule that works for you.
- And let the Loving Kindness app do the rest!
We’ll deliver the customized, pre-written Loving Kindness mantras you want, when you want them, so you can effortlessly integrate this powerful practice into your daily routine.
It’s up to you how you choose to use your mantras: on their own, for a short burst of inspiration and contemplation, or to enhance your current meditation practice.
But whether you’re a beginner or an experienced meditator, one thing stays the same. The Loving Kindness app will help you cultivate a more positive and caring mindset.
The power of Loving Kindness meditations is undeniable; they’ve been scientifically proven to increase feelings of empathy, compassion, and overall well-being. Plus, they can help reduce feelings of anxiety and depression, lower stress, and improve relationships.
Everyone could use a little bit more Loving Kindness in their lives, and our app brings it right to your phone.
So start spreading compassion and goodwill today with the Loving Kindness app.

bluejetty:00066238:ios.name: Retro Football Management
bluejetty:00066238:ios.summary: Welcome to Retro Football Management, the game that breathes new life into classic football seasons. This simple, fun and free football manager game allows you to take control of the greatest club sides from history and complete a game in l
bluejetty:00066238:ios.description:
Welcome to Retro Football Management, the game that breathes new life into classic football seasons. This simple, fun and free football manager game allows you to take control of the greatest club sides from history and complete a game in less time than it takes to finish your daily commute.
We are adding new seasons every month to the game, which currently includes 40 seasons from 8 countries across 5 decades, with the European Cup and Champions League. 
Pick the era when you fell in love with football and manage the legends of your youth. Turn an average Coventry team into European Champions, sell the players you never liked and buy the ones you did. Unlike other Management games, your clubs past mediocrity will not stop you signing the world’s best players - assuming you have the money of course! 
As you play the game you will earn points for hitting various challenges, like winning 3 matches in a row or being top of the league after 10 games. Points can be exchanged for squad enhancements in the shop that will help take your team from also-rans to champions; spend them wisely to help make your club the greatest in the world. Points can also be used to unlock extra classic seasons like the 1988/1989 Italian with European Cup.
The app will always be free to download and contains in-app purchases if you want to enhance your team more quickly but does not require you to spend money in order to win. It’s designed to be a fair test of your gaming skill and football knowledge; you against the computer, just like it used to be.
You will start with a small squad that always is in need of some work to sell players to generate cash and then buy better ones for less; your transfer aptitude will go a long way to determining your success. The club’s board will set you season-long objectives, hit them and get rewarded with cash and stadium expansions, but if you miss them you will be fired – classic game over!
You can play 5 different games at the same time, so you can build world-class sides from 5 different decades—Pele to United in the 1960s, Leeds sign Cruyff in 1973, Spurs sign Maradona to play with Gascoigne in 1988—whoever your team is, Retro Football Management gives you the chance to pack your squad with legends and dominate world football.
Why wait? Download the game for free now and take a nostalgic trip through the history of gaming and football!

Pick the era when you fell in love with football and manage the legends of your youth. Turn an average Coventry team into European Champions, sell the players you never liked and buy the ones you did. Unlike other Management games, your clubs past mediocrity will not stop you signing the world’s best players - assuming you have the money of course! 

As you play the game you will earn points for hitting various challenges, like winning 3 matches in a row or being top of the league after 10 games. Points can be exchanged for squad enhancements in the shop that will help take your team from also-rans to champions; spend them wisely to help make your club the greatest in the world. Points can also be used to unlock extra classic seasons like the 1988/1989 Italian with European Cup.

The app will always be free to download and contains in-app purchases if you want to enhance your team more quickly but does not require you to spend money in order to win. It’s designed to be a fair test of your gaming skill and football knowledge; you against the computer, just like it used to be.

You will start with a small squad that always is in need of some work to sell players to generate cash and then buy better ones for less; your transfer aptitude will go a long way to determining your success. The club’s board will set you season-long objectives, hit them and get rewarded with cash and stadium expansions, but if you miss them you will be fired – classic game over!

You can play 5 different games at the same time, so you can build world-class sides from 5 different decades—Pele to United in the 1960s, Leeds sign Cruyff in 1973, Spurs sign Maradona to play with Gascoigne in 1988—whoever your team is, Retro Football Management gives you the chance to pack your squad with legends and dominate world football.

Why wait? Download the game for free now and take a nostalgic trip through the history of gaming and football!

bluejetty:00124264:ios.summary: Build incredible steampunk machines, spin cogwheels, launch balloons, mine for ore and empower your awesome contraption. The machines will produce money to spend on building even more powerful machines. And once you reach the limit, you can
bluejetty:00124264:ios.description:
Build incredible steampunk machines, spin cogwheels, launch balloons, mine for ore and empower your awesome contraption. The machines will produce money to spend on building even more powerful machines. And once you reach the limit, you can build a portal to repeat your adventure from the start or to travel to other steampunk, dieselpunk or gaslight fantasy worlds and explore them.
This incremental game is all about exploration, invention and mad science. Your story begins in a workshop and all what you have is a machine, which produces coins for rotating a cogwheel. Later on you'll will discover that after buying another gear and connecting it to the central pins will make the first one spin faster.
You have never seen a game like this: this is an idle game where you actually build the machines, which will bring you income. You are doing this by combining the connecting parts and discovering new machine setups. More and more ways to boost your idle earnings and active play income will appear. Steam engines will work even when the game is offline, mines produce ore, which boosts the main machine's production and vapor collector powers the balloon pumps and produces instant powerups.
Unlock 4 steampunk worlds: Workshop, Clockwork City, Floating Islands, and Good Old Spinner, each one with its unique buildings and strategy. Equip your factory with more than 50 various machines.

Mini Racing Adventures is a stunt racing game that challenges you to unlock our collection of 65 unique vehicles each with their own feel, to travel across the farthest reaches of 21 adventurous stages. Race into action as you select your favorite Racing car, Buggy, ATV, Trial Motor Bike, and even Truck to climb the highest hill, dirt tracks, snowy mountains and other beautifully designed stages. You can find car game, motorcycle game, truck game, etc, just in one game!

- Real time Online Multiplayer racing game
- Offline Multiplayer against CPU or your Ghost!
- Google Saved Games Cloud Save
- Leaderboards & Achievements
- Smooth and realistic physics (look at those car and motorcycle suspension in action!).
- 3D racing game with stunning visuals and graphics
- Lots of vehicles ( Racing car, Offroad Buggy, Racing Motorcycle, Monster Truck, etc )
- Upgradeable vehicle components
- Control options
Tracks in this racing game are designed to challenge any speed freak, off road climbers, rock crawling simulation, hill climb, casual driving and even asphalt drag racing. Master your stunt and beat every mega ramp in the circuit to be a superhero.
Happy Trail driving and Trial riding! Remember to buckle up as it's going to be a bumpy ride!
Cloud Save Notes
Please make sure that you are logged in with Google Play account. Otherwise, your data will not be saved and will be lost in the future.
For a fast response, please send us bug report and any problem to support@minimostudios.com , reports in User Review might be missed to read by us. Thanks for the support!

Open a World of Accessible Books
EasyReader removes barriers to reading, enabling anyone with a print disability to read independently. Global links to over 50 libraries connects you to millions of titles and empowers you to read in ways th
bluejetty:00014150:ios.description:
Open a World of Accessible Books
EasyReader removes barriers to reading, enabling anyone with a print disability to read independently. Global links to over 50 libraries connects you to millions of titles and empowers you to read in ways that work best for you. 
EasyReader offers a customisable reading experience and supports a wide range of accessibility needs including dyslexia and vision impairment.
Download and read classic literature and bestselling fiction, textbooks and non-fiction, picture books and children’s stories and more. Access magazines, newspapers and periodicals or import files and read clipboard text. 
It’s easy to customise your reading experience so it suits your own reading needs and preferences.
Easy Navigation
Browse, download and navigate books easily, whether you read visually, audibly or with braille. You’ll move intuitively through content with EasyReader: skip pages, jump to chapters, add bookmarks and search keywords to find information instantly. 
Empowering Dyslexic readers:
- Choose dyslexia-friendly fonts
- Adjust text and background colours 
- Highlight words and sentences, read along to audio 
- Modify letter and line spacing, adjust lines visible to reduce distractions 
- Explore Tools are available to boost study and revision
Blind and Partially Sighted readers:
EasyReader offers an exceptional experience for readers with vision impairments: 
- Adjust text size with touchscreen gestures 
- Choose custom colour contrasts
- Read using braille displays 
- Switch to linear reading mode for screen readers and braille
- Access to premium image descriptions available
Audio Books & Text-to-Speech (TTS)
Listen to narrated audio books and use Text to Speech (TTS) to read books, newspapers and more. Speech synchronises perfectly with on-screen highlights for a perfect read-along experience.
- Choose from a selection of reading voices
- Adjust reading speed, volume and pronunciation
- Adjust sentence and word highlights
Read a Range of Formats 
Choose from the widest range of book and document formats. including DAISY 2 and 3, ePub, MathML, Microsoft Word (DOCX), PDF, HTML and text files.
Help & Support
The 'Ask a Question’ feature in EasyReader Help offers instant guidance. It uses built-in AI to search user guides, the Knowledge Base and training materials.
Step-by-step help is also available on the Dolphin website. 
Share feedback or report a bug directly in the app to help Dolphin continue improving EasyReader.

bluejetty:00186198:ios.summary: Smart Social helps 2 million people each year to keep their kids safe and help them learn how to be positive on social media. In this app, you will get access to 450+ social media safety guides to help protect your family online, including
bluejetty:00186198:ios.description:
Smart Social helps 2 million people each year to keep their kids safe and help them learn how to be positive on social media. In this app, you will get access to 450+ social media safety guides to help protect your family online, including a family media agreement to get your family on the right track.
We believe every family and school should have access to tools that will keep kids safe online, regardless of income or budget. That's why we offer hundreds of professionally built resources, for students and their families.
Overcome Your Screen Time Frustrations
Do you know how much time your child spends on their screens daily? The average might shock you—it’s over seven hours! But what’s really at stake here isn’t just time, it's their future motivation, well-being, and success.
We teach families how to use social media in a positive way that keeps them out of trouble.
Using our easy-to-follow 3-step formula, our safety videos and tutorials help families and schools safeguard kids from the dangers of the digital world and help them use their time online to create a stronger future.
Social Media Can Be Used in a Positive Way
We take a positive approach to social media safety with fun and easy to follow videos and training guides. Your kids are going to be exposed to social media, even if they do not have their own accounts. Let's teach them how to make good choices and avoid dangerous situations.
Parents can help their teens use social media to create a positive digital footprint, learn skills that will help them succeed in their future career and make a real difference in the world.
Knowing everything your child is doing online is almost impossible, so we teach students how to self-regulate their screen time and make choices they can be proud of.

- Write and review session notes
- Share and upload documents
- Send secure messages
- Process invoices and payments

- 100% HIPAA compliance
- Biometric access
- In-app passcode protection
- Bank-level data encryption
This is a companion app for SimplePractice's cloud-based practice management software. A SimplePractice account is required to use the app.

bluejetty:00031851:ios.description:
Discover AR Drawing, the ultimate drawing companion that makes learning how to draw a breeze with innovative AR Drawing technology.
Explore various art drawing techniques, from photo drawing to picture drawing, suitable for both beginners and experienced artists. Dive into diverse drawing genres, including nature, animals, food, anime, and more, inspiring boundless creativity.
Key Features:
Use your phone camera to draw
Paint & Sketch - a powerful tool for artists, designers, and creative individuals.
Transform your favorite photos into artistic masterpieces with innovative photo drawing
Explore a library of 1000+ free templates for drawings
Discover a range of tracing genres like Animals, Nature, and Anime, inspiring your art drawing or picture drawing and the freedom to trace anything.
Capture, analyze, and enhance your drawing techniques by recording time-lapse videos of your creations, providing valuable insights into how to draw and improve your drawings.
Experience an intuitive interface, perfect for both novices and seasoned artists, making it easy to learn how to draw.
This app is your gateway to boundless creativity, seamlessly blending AR drawing technology to teach drawing effortlessly. Discover how to draw, trace anything, and turn your photos into captivating sketches.

bluejetty:00170671:ios.description:
Collect and curate officially licensed digital pins featuring beloved characters from Disney, Pixar and Star Wars™.
Revolving Storefront
Multiple variants of Open Edition pins are released for a short period of time, during which they may appear for direct sale in the Revolving Storefront. Check back frequently to find the pins you want, as once the timer runs out, the current pins will be removed from sale and different pins will become available.
Mystery Capsules
Limited Edition Mystery Capsules are announced in advance, and are only available until a limited fixed quantity sells out. Rare variants of pins can also be revealed in Open Edition Mystery Capsules if you're lucky!
Digital Pinbook
Your digital pins can be curated, artfully arranged and shown off in your digital Pinbook! Once you own pins, create and edit your Pinbook then share on social media for a chance to have your Pinbook featured to the whole Disney Pinnacle Community.

Magic Guide® – Your Essential Disneyland Companion
Experience Disneyland like never before with real-time wait times, interactive park maps, comprehensive dining guides, and GPS navigation.
INTERACTIVE PARK MAPS Navigate both Disneyland parks with stunning high quality maps for Disneyland Park and California Adventure. See live wait times and next show times directly on the map, pinpoint your exact location with GPS and compass, and quickly find attractions, restaurants, and restrooms with intuitive search and zoom controls.
COMPLETE DINING GUIDE Browse menus and details for all dining locations, from table-service restaurants to quick-service stands. Discover options by location, meal offerings, GPS proximity, or your saved favorites. Access discount information for Magic Key holders. Premium users can search across all menus to find specific foods and dietary options.

PARK SCHEDULES & EVENTS Plan your perfect day with up-to-date operating hours for both Disneyland parks, plus showtimes for parades, fireworks, and special events.
PLANS Build your own Calendar Plans and share them with friends and family.
WEATHER Park specific weather including per minute rain forecasts.
PREMIUM MAGIC GUIDE+ FEATURES
* Wait Time Forecasts per ride
* Daily Crowds Forecasts for the next year
* Looking Glass augmented reality viewer
* VIP Tour ride recommendations
* Wait Time Notification Alerts
* Wait Times and Park Hours on Apple Watch
* Ad-free experience
* Apple Family Sharing
Whether you're planning your first visit or you're a seasoned Magic Key holder, this app puts everything you need right at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00041051:ios.description:
Counter AI is a subscription-based calorie tracking app. A subscription is required to access all features.
How it works
 • Photo capture: snap your food for calorie + macro estimates powered by AI
 • Fast edits: fix portions or ingredients anytime
 • Barcode scanning: quick logging for packaged foods
 • Food database: search and add common foods fast
Why people stick with it
 • Macro diary: watch your daily targets update as you log
 • Progress tracking: simple trends that keep you consistent
 • Custom reminders: gentle nudges to drink water, move, or log snacks
Built for any goal
Cut, bulk, maintain, or just eat more intentionally. Set your calorie and macro targets your way and keep it simple day to day.
A quick note on accuracy
Photo-based logging provides estimates. You are always in control and can edit any entry to match what you actually ate. Body composition and metabolic rate values are estimates for informational purposes only and are not a substitute for professional medical advice.
Sources for health calculations
Basal Metabolic Rate: Mifflin-St Jeor equation — Mifflin MD, St Jeor ST, et al. "A new predictive equation for resting energy expenditure in healthy individuals." American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 1990;51(2):241–247. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2305711/
Total Daily Energy Expenditure: BMR × activity factor per the Institute of Medicine Dietary Reference Intakes (2005). https://nap.nationalacademies.org/read/10490/
Body fat percentage: U.S. Navy circumference method — Hodgdon JA, Beckett MB. "Prediction of percent body fat for U.S. Navy men and women from body circumferences and height." Naval Health Research Center, 1984. https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/citations/ADA143890
Macronutrient targets: Acceptable Macronutrient Distribution Ranges, Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020–2025. https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov
Subscription details
Options: Annual, Monthly and Weekly auto-renewing subscriptions
A free trial may be offered to new subscribers; after the trial, the subscription renews at the standard rate
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase
Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
Manage or cancel anytime in Apple ID account settings
Terms of Service: https://www.summitintelligence.io/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.summitintelligence.io/privacy-policy
Questions or ideas? Email support@insightlabs.ai

Welcome to a better way to manage your account with our customer mobile app. You can view and pay your bill, report an outage, check outage status, manage your accounts, view billing history, and more! Use the "Remember me" feature to make login a breeze. Everything is now at the touch of your fingertips.
Features include:
OUTAGE INFORMATION
- Report a power outage
- Check outage status and track restoration progress
- Easy access to view outage maps in your area
ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
- Choose "Remember me" to skip logging in each time you use the app*
- View your real-time account balance, payment due date, and balance details
- View and download your bill (PDF)
- Pay immediately for free from your bank account
- Make automatic or scheduled payments
- Other ways to pay (credit/debit card, in-person, by phone)
- Switch between multiple accounts
ENERGY USAGE
- Compare how your current usage compares to last month or the same time last year
SETTINGS 
- Enroll in and manage your paperless billing
- Add or delete your bank accounts
- Enroll in and manage billing and outage alerts
*Logging into the Appalachian Power app requires an active account that is registered online at AppalachianPower.com

bluejetty:00142568:ios.description:
Get the free Takko Friends app now and benefit from exclusive advantages!
You can expect:
# special surprises, promotions & discounts 
# shopping points for individual coupons (€1 purchase value = 100 points) 
# free deliveries from an online order value of €49,99
# free deliveries to your favourite Takko Fashion store from €19,99 order value
# a digital customer card & receipts 
# can only be used in Germany, Austria & the Netherlands 
# and much more ...
What are you waiting for? Becoming a Takko Friend is worth it!
Shop, earn points, save
It's that simple! Download the Takko Friends App for free, sign up, collect shopping points and exchange them for discount coupons  
Collect points
Nothing could be easier! Show your digital customer card when paying and collect 100 shopping points for every €1 spent. 
Redeem discount coupons
Every point counts! Simply activate your favourite coupon in the app with your collected points and show your digital customer card when paying.  
Your welcome voucher
We won't keep you waiting long! After your registration, you will receive your first discount* from us.
Your birthday surprise
Celebrate every year with a little gift from us!
And the Takko Friends app has even more to offer ... 
Free deliveries
Shop extensively and try on clothes comfortably at home? From an online order value of €49,99, we will deliver your favourite styles directly to your home free of charge. 
Even more benefits?
Of course, because Takko Friends save more! Look forward to further exclusive offers & numerous benefits. 
Unlimited shopping sun
Takko Friends shop smarter! With the digital receipt, you always have an eye on your expenses, both online and offline.
Never miss anything again!
What are the latest trends? Where can you find the best deal? With the news section in your app, you're always up-to-date. 
Always Close to You
How far is the nearest store from you? The store finder will show you!
*Valid for a purchase value of €20 or more. After complete registration, you will receive a one-time discount, which you can redeem both in the Takko Fashion online shop at takko.com and in Takko Fashion stores. The discount cannot be combined with other promotions or reductions. Not valid for gift cards. Cash payout is also not possible.
