bluejetty:00064524:ios.name: AIB Mobile
bluejetty:00064524:ios.summary:
Our mobile app is built to support you in the life you’re after. It includes features to support how you bank every day and new ways to manage your money and make quick and easy payments.  
The app offers a personalised everyday banking ex
bluejetty:00064524:ios.description:
Our mobile app is built to support you in the life you’re after. It includes features to support how you bank every day and new ways to manage your money and make quick and easy payments.  
The app offers a personalised everyday banking experience with a strong focus on your day-to-day banking.  
You can get better insight into your money with a clear picture of where your money is going, with detailed transactions and budgeting tools to help you understand your spending.   
With easy payments and more control to make the fast, secure SEPA Instant and Zippay payments you know and trust.    
Strong security & protection against fraud with enhanced security features, including Passkeys, which give you a fast and safe way to login to the app and an added layer of protection from fraudsters.  
The app offers support when and how you need it. Get help directly in the app - chat to our digital assistant Abi, check our FAQ’s or find other ways to contact us for the support you need.   
Your AIB mobile app home screen: 
Life is busy. Most days when you open the app, you just want to quickly check your balance and your spending.  
- To make your online banking easier, we’ve introduced spaces for your different accounts. 
- Your ‘Everyday’ space brings your current and credit card accounts, together in the one place.   
- Easily switch between your Savings, Loans, or Mortgages space. 
- See your balances, recent activity and upcoming payments at a glance.  
- Keep track of your spending and an eye on the budget you set. 
- In app messages help you stay up to date. 
- Ask Abi a question, call us or find your nearest branch.  
Spending & budgeting insights: 
Track your spending trends by getting a daily, weekly or monthly view.  
- See a breakdown of your spending by structured categories, so you know where your money is going. 
- Understand your habits by seeing where you spend most of your money. 
- Add your own tags to transactions to track spending in a way that works for you.  
- Set and manage budgets, track your progress and see what you’ve left against your budget target. 
Payments: 
Make & manage your payments simply and quickly. 
- Move your money between your AIB accounts. 
- Send, request or split payments with Zippay using your mobile contacts.  
- Send money to your family and friends whether they are in Ireland or the SEPA zone countries.  
- Use Selfie Check facial biometrics to let us check it’s really you making payments in the app. Once enrolled, you can make higher-value payments securely. 
- Pay your household or credit card bills.  
- Set up or cancel standing orders anytime.  
- View and manage your payees and set payment limits. 
Cards: 
You can easily and securely: 
- Freeze and unfreeze your cards. 
- Order a replacement card if yours is lost or stolen. 
- View your personal debit card PIN. 
Apply and open products: 
Open a new account, apply to borrow money, apply for a credit card or mortgage or get insurance. You can also plan for your future with AIB life. 
- New account: Open a new current or savings account on your own, all from within the app.  
- Borrow money: Apply for a Personal loan or top-up, a green loan, the SBCI Home Energy Upgrade Loan Scheme or a Personal overdraft.  
- Credit cards: Apply for a Click or Platinum credit card.  
- Mortgage: Easy access to calculate, apply and manage your mortgage application. 
- Insurance: Call us for a travel, home and/or car insurance quote.  
- AIB life: Start planning for your future by exploring ways to invest your money, grow your pension, get cover for your income or mortgage. 
For more information:  
We have more information on our website https://www.aib.ie/ways-to-bank/mobile-banking
For more information on our new app go to https://www.aib.ie/newapp
Allied Irish Banks, p.l.c. is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland.

Camarts is a photo gallery featuring a curated library of over 3,000 images created by photographer Dandy Tianxin Weng on his worldwide journeys in the past eighteen years.

apple-macos:6758214249.name: BBnotes: AI Notes & PDF Tutor
apple-macos:6758214249.description:
BBnotes is an AI notebook for international students studying in a second language. Follow lectures with live bilingual captions, translate PDFs side by side, handwrite with Apple Pencil and ask an AI tutor about the exact passage, formula or note on the page—all in one study workspace.
FOLLOW LECTURES IN TWO LANGUAGES
• Record a lecture and see bilingual captions as your lecturer speaks, on supported devices.
• Review a timestamped bilingual transcript after class.
• Jump back to the relevant moment instead of searching the entire recording.
SUMMARIZE A WHOLE LECTURE
• Turn a full recording into an overview and timestamped key points in one tap.
• Tap any key point to replay that moment in the recording and transcript.
READ AND TRANSLATE PDFs
• View the original text and its translation side by side.
• Scroll both versions together to keep the same passage aligned.
• Tap an unfamiliar word to save it to your word book with its meaning and source page.
ASK AI IN CONTEXT
• Circle a passage, formula or handwriting and ask directly from the page.
• Work through problems by hand while the AI tutor checks each step and hints at the next one.
• Keep each question and explanation connected to the source material.
WRITE, ORGANIZE AND REVIEW
• Take handwritten notes with Apple Pencil on iPad.
• Generate an outline to navigate long documents.
• Bring reading, writing, translation, lecture audio and AI support into one notebook, synced across iPhone, iPad and Mac.
BUILT AROUND THE STUDY DAY
Use BBnotes before class to prepare, during class to follow along, and after class to return to what was said and where it appeared in your notes.
Download BBnotes for free. New users get a 14-day Pro trial. Optional Pro plans and AI point packs are available as in-app purchases. Pricing is determined by your local App Store.
Available on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Live captions require iOS/iPadOS 26. Some features require compatible devices and system versions, and feature availability may vary by platform.
Terms of Use: https://bbnotes-legal.liushenpeng1.workers.dev/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://bbnotes-legal.liushenpeng1.workers.dev/privacy.html
